# The Map Room's color scales (common/journal_entries/te_journal_maps.txt): each map's factor, 0-1. Nearly every
# map is fitted to the world as it stands: its curve keeps its shape on the span from the world's low to its
# high (te_jmap_<map>_lo / _hi, stored by te_journal_map_ranges_generated.txt's effects on each pick and each
# month; the fixed curve's ends before the first). Change a shape or a row in the generator and re-run it;
# test_journal_map_scales.py fails when this file is stale. A value reading a figure runs with a STATE as root,
# once per state as the map paints; _lo, _hi and their kin read only globals, from any scope.

# Turmoil, the radicals' share: half the color by a fifth of the world's range, the rest more slowly.
# Fitted to the world; before the first measure, 0 to 1.
te_jmap_turmoil_input = {
	value = turmoil
}
te_jmap_turmoil_input_neg = {
	value = te_jmap_turmoil_input
	multiply = -1
}
te_jmap_turmoil_lo = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = te_jmap_rng_turmoil_lo }
		value = global_var:te_jmap_rng_turmoil_lo
	}
}
te_jmap_turmoil_hi = {
	value = 1
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = te_jmap_rng_turmoil_hi }
		value = global_var:te_jmap_rng_turmoil_hi
	}
	min = te_jmap_turmoil_hi_floor
}
te_jmap_turmoil_hi_floor = {
	value = te_jmap_turmoil_lo
	add = 0.1
}
te_jmap_turmoil_span = {
	value = te_jmap_turmoil_hi
	subtract = te_jmap_turmoil_lo
}
te_jmap_turmoil_k1 = {
	value = te_jmap_turmoil_span
	multiply = 0.2
	add = te_jmap_turmoil_lo
}
te_jmap_turmoil_d0 = {
	value = te_jmap_turmoil_span
	multiply = 0.4
}
te_jmap_turmoil_d1 = {
	value = te_jmap_turmoil_span
	multiply = 1.6
}
te_jmap_turmoil_lg_min = {
	value = te_jmap_turmoil_hi
	divide = 64
}
te_jmap_turmoil_lg_r = {
	value = turmoil
	multiply = 64
	divide = te_jmap_turmoil_hi

		limit = { te_jmap_turmoil_lo > te_jmap_turmoil_lg_min }
		value = turmoil
		divide = te_jmap_turmoil_lo
	}
}

te_jmap_turmoil_factor = {
	if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_scale = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { turmoil < te_jmap_turmoil_k1 }
			value = turmoil subtract = te_jmap_turmoil_lo divide = te_jmap_turmoil_d0
		}
		else = {
			value = turmoil subtract = te_jmap_turmoil_k1 divide = te_jmap_turmoil_d1 add = 0.5
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_scale = 1 }
		value = turmoil
		subtract = te_jmap_turmoil_lo
		divide = te_jmap_turmoil_span
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_scale = 2 }
		value = te_jmap_turmoil_lg_t
		divide = te_jmap_turmoil_lg_top
	}
	else = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = te_jmap_rank }
			value = var:te_jmap_rank
		}
	}
	min = 0
	max = 1
}

	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_urban_lg_r < 8 }
		value = te_jmap_urban_lg_r divide = 4 add = 1
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_urban_lg_r < 16 }
		value = te_jmap_urban_lg_r divide = 8 add = 2
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_urban_lg_r < 32 }
		value = te_jmap_urban_lg_r divide = 16 add = 3
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_urban_lg_r < 64 }
		value = te_jmap_urban_lg_r divide = 32 add = 4
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_urban_lg_r < 128 }
		value = te_jmap_urban_lg_r divide = 64 add = 5
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_urban_lg_r < 256 }
		value = te_jmap_urban_lg_r divide = 128 add = 6
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_urban_lg_r < 512 }
		value = te_jmap_urban_lg_r divide = 256 add = 7
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_urban_lg_r < 1024 }
		value = te_jmap_urban_lg_r divide = 512 add = 8
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_urban_lg_r < 2048 }
		value = te_jmap_urban_lg_r divide = 1024 add = 9
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_urban_lg_r < 4096 }
		value = te_jmap_urban_lg_r divide = 2048 add = 10
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_urban_lg_r < 8192 }
		value = te_jmap_urban_lg_r divide = 4096 add = 11
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_urban_lg_r < 16384 }
		value = te_jmap_urban_lg_r divide = 8192 add = 12
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_urban_lg_r < 32768 }
		value = te_jmap_urban_lg_r divide = 16384 add = 13
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_urban_lg_r < 65536 }
		value = te_jmap_urban_lg_r divide = 32768 add = 14
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_urban_lg_r < 131072 }
		value = te_jmap_urban_lg_r divide = 65536 add = 15
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_urban_lg_r < 262144 }
		value = te_jmap_urban_lg_r divide = 131072 add = 16
	}
	else_if = {

	}

		limit = { te_jmap_urban_lg_r < 1048576 }
		value = te_jmap_urban_lg_r divide = 524288 add = 18
	}
	else = {
		value = te_jmap_urban_lg_r divide = 1048576 add = 19
	}
}
te_jmap_urban_lg_span_r = {
	value = 64
	if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_urban_lo > te_jmap_urban_lg_min }
		value = te_jmap_urban_hi
		divide = te_jmap_urban_lo
	}
}
te_jmap_urban_lg_top = {
	if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_urban_lg_span_r < 2 }
		value = te_jmap_urban_lg_span_r subtract = 1
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_urban_lg_span_r < 4 }
		value = te_jmap_urban_lg_span_r divide = 2
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_urban_lg_span_r < 8 }
		value = te_jmap_urban_lg_span_r divide = 4 add = 1
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_urban_lg_span_r < 16 }
		value = te_jmap_urban_lg_span_r divide = 8 add = 2
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_urban_lg_span_r < 32 }
		value = te_jmap_urban_lg_span_r divide = 16 add = 3
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_urban_lg_span_r < 64 }
		value = te_jmap_urban_lg_span_r divide = 32 add = 4
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_urban_lg_span_r < 128 }
		value = te_jmap_urban_lg_span_r divide = 64 add = 5
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_urban_lg_span_r < 256 }

	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_urban_lg_span_r < 512 }
		value = te_jmap_urban_lg_span_r divide = 256 add = 7
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_urban_lg_span_r < 1024 }
		value = te_jmap_urban_lg_span_r divide = 512 add = 8
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_urban_lg_span_r < 2048 }
		value = te_jmap_urban_lg_span_r divide = 1024 add = 9
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_urban_lg_span_r < 4096 }
		value = te_jmap_urban_lg_span_r divide = 2048 add = 10
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_urban_lg_span_r < 8192 }
		value = te_jmap_urban_lg_span_r divide = 4096 add = 11
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_urban_lg_span_r < 16384 }
		value = te_jmap_urban_lg_span_r divide = 8192 add = 12
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_urban_lg_span_r < 32768 }
		value = te_jmap_urban_lg_span_r divide = 16384 add = 13
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_urban_lg_span_r < 65536 }
		value = te_jmap_urban_lg_span_r divide = 32768 add = 14
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_urban_lg_span_r < 131072 }
		value = te_jmap_urban_lg_span_r divide = 65536 add = 15
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_urban_lg_span_r < 262144 }
		value = te_jmap_urban_lg_span_r divide = 131072 add = 16
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_urban_lg_span_r < 524288 }
		value = te_jmap_urban_lg_span_r divide = 262144 add = 17
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_urban_lg_span_r < 1048576 }
		value = te_jmap_urban_lg_span_r divide = 524288 add = 18
	}
	else = {
		value = te_jmap_urban_lg_span_r divide = 1048576 add = 19
	}
	min = 0.001
}
te_jmap_urban_factor = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_dg_urban_share }
		if = {
			limit = { te_jmap_scale = 0 }
			value = var:te_dg_urban_share subtract = te_jmap_urban_lo divide = te_jmap_urban_d0
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { te_jmap_scale = 1 }
			value = var:te_dg_urban_share
			subtract = te_jmap_urban_lo
			divide = te_jmap_urban_span
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { te_jmap_scale = 2 }
			value = te_jmap_urban_lg_t
			divide = te_jmap_urban_lg_top
		}
		else = {
			value = 0
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = te_jmap_rank }
				value = var:te_jmap_rank
			}
		}
	}
	min = 0
	max = 1
}

# The state's shown Gini (the yearly walk's, 0.3-1); Britain in 1836 about 0.55.
# Fitted to the world; before the first measure, 0.3 to 0.8.
te_jmap_gini_input = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_dg_gini }
		value = var:te_dg_gini
	}
}
te_jmap_gini_input_neg = {
	value = te_jmap_gini_input
	multiply = -1
}
te_jmap_gini_lo = {
	value = 0.3
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = te_jmap_rng_gini_lo }
		value = global_var:te_jmap_rng_gini_lo
	}
}
te_jmap_gini_hi = {
	value = 0.8
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = te_jmap_rng_gini_hi }
		value = global_var:te_jmap_rng_gini_hi
	}
	min = te_jmap_gini_hi_floor
}
te_jmap_gini_hi_floor = {
	value = te_jmap_gini_lo
	add = 0.1
}
te_jmap_gini_span = {
	value = te_jmap_gini_hi
	subtract = te_jmap_gini_lo
}
te_jmap_gini_d0 = {
	value = te_jmap_gini_span
	multiply = 1
}
te_jmap_gini_lg_min = {
	value = te_jmap_gini_hi
	divide = 64
}
te_jmap_gini_lg_r = {
	value = var:te_dg_gini
	multiply = 64
	divide = te_jmap_gini_hi
	if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_gini_lo > te_jmap_gini_lg_min }
		value = var:te_dg_gini
		divide = te_jmap_gini_lo
	}
}
te_jmap_gini_lg_t = {
	if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_gini_lg_r < 2 }

		limit = { te_jmap_gini_lg_r < 4 }
		value = te_jmap_gini_lg_r divide = 2
	}

		limit = { te_jmap_gini_lg_r < 8 }
		value = te_jmap_gini_lg_r divide = 4 add = 1

		limit = { te_jmap_gini_lg_r < 64 }

	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_gini_lg_r < 128 }

	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_gini_lg_r < 256 }
		value = te_jmap_gini_lg_r divide = 128 add = 6
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_gini_lg_r < 512 }
		value = te_jmap_gini_lg_r divide = 256 add = 7
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_gini_lg_r < 1024 }
		value = te_jmap_gini_lg_r divide = 512 add = 8
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_gini_lg_r < 2048 }
		value = te_jmap_gini_lg_r divide = 1024 add = 9
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_gini_lg_r < 4096 }
		value = te_jmap_gini_lg_r divide = 2048 add = 10
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_gini_lg_r < 8192 }
		value = te_jmap_gini_lg_r divide = 4096 add = 11
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_gini_lg_r < 16384 }

	else_if = {

		value = te_jmap_gini_lg_r divide = 16384 add = 13
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_gini_lg_r < 65536 }
		value = te_jmap_gini_lg_r divide = 32768 add = 14

	else_if = {

	}
	else_if = {

	else_if = {

	else = {
		value = te_jmap_gini_lg_r divide = 1048576 add = 19
	}

# Dynastic Wealth, the state's score, split at 50, where its effects turn from dispersed to concentrated property.
# Fitted to the world on each side of 50; before the first measure, 0 to 100.

	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_dg_wc }
		value = var:te_dg_wc

	}
	else_if = {

	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_wc_sl_low_span_r < 4096 }
		value = te_jmap_wc_sl_low_span_r divide = 2048 add = 10

	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_wc_sl_low_span_r < 8192 }
		value = te_jmap_wc_sl_low_span_r divide = 4096 add = 11

	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_wc_sl_low_span_r < 16384 }

	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_wc_sl_low_span_r < 131072 }
		value = te_jmap_wc_sl_low_span_r divide = 65536 add = 15
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_wc_sl_low_span_r < 262144 }
		value = te_jmap_wc_sl_low_span_r divide = 131072 add = 16
	}
	else_if = {

		value = te_jmap_wc_sl_low_span_r divide = 262144 add = 17
	}
	else_if = {

	min = 1

te_jmap_wc_factor = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_dg_wc }
		if = {
			limit = { te_jmap_scale = 0 }
			if = {
				limit = { var:te_dg_wc < 50 }
				value = var:te_dg_wc subtract = te_jmap_wc_b divide = te_jmap_wc_l_d0 add = 0.5
				max = 0.5
			}
			else = {
				value = var:te_dg_wc subtract = te_jmap_wc_a divide = te_jmap_wc_u_d0 add = 0.5
				min = 0.5
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { te_jmap_scale = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { var:te_dg_wc < 50 }
				value = te_jmap_wc_b
				subtract = var:te_dg_wc
				divide = te_jmap_wc_span_low
				multiply = -0.5
				add = 0.5
				max = 0.5
			}
			else = {
				value = var:te_dg_wc
				subtract = te_jmap_wc_a
				divide = te_jmap_wc_span_up
				multiply = 0.5
				add = 0.5
				min = 0.5
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { te_jmap_scale = 2 }
			if = {
				limit = { var:te_dg_wc < 50 }
				value = te_jmap_wc_sl_low_t
				divide = te_jmap_wc_sl_low_top
				multiply = -0.5
				add = 0.5
				max = 0.5
			}
			else = {
				value = te_jmap_wc_sl_up_t
				divide = te_jmap_wc_sl_up_top
				multiply = 0.5
				add = 0.5
				min = 0.5
			}
		}
		else = {
			value = 0.5
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = te_jmap_rank }
				value = var:te_jmap_rank
			}
		}
	}
	min = 0
	max = 1
}
te_jmap_wc_factor_lower = {
	value = te_jmap_wc_factor
	multiply = 2
	min = 0
	max = 1
}
te_jmap_wc_factor_upper = {
	value = te_jmap_wc_factor
	multiply = 2
	subtract = 1
	min = 0
	max = 1
}

# Life expectancy at birth, split at the middle of the world's range.
# Fitted to the world; before the first measure, 25 to 80.
te_jmap_e0_input = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_dg_e0 }
		value = var:te_dg_e0
	}
}

	value = te_jmap_e0_input
	multiply = -1
}
te_jmap_e0_lo = {
	value = 25
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = te_jmap_rng_e0_lo }
		value = global_var:te_jmap_rng_e0_lo
	}
}
te_jmap_e0_hi = {
	value = 80
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = te_jmap_rng_e0_hi }
		value = global_var:te_jmap_rng_e0_hi
	}
	min = te_jmap_e0_hi_floor
}
te_jmap_e0_hi_floor = {
	value = te_jmap_e0_lo
	add = 10
}
te_jmap_e0_span = {
	value = te_jmap_e0_hi
	subtract = te_jmap_e0_lo
}

	value = te_jmap_e0_span
	multiply = 1
}

	divide = 64
}

		value = var:te_dg_e0
		divide = te_jmap_e0_lo
	}
}

			divide = te_jmap_e0_span
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { te_jmap_scale = 2 }
			value = te_jmap_e0_lg_t
			divide = te_jmap_e0_lg_top
		}
		else = {
			value = 0.5
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = te_jmap_rank }
				value = var:te_jmap_rank
			}
		}
	}
	min = 0
	max = 1
}
te_jmap_e0_factor_lower = {
	value = te_jmap_e0_factor
	multiply = 2
	min = 0
	max = 1
}
te_jmap_e0_factor_upper = {
	value = te_jmap_e0_factor
	multiply = 2
	subtract = 1
	min = 0
	max = 1
}

# Infant mortality per 1,000 births, split at the middle of the world's range; 300 an 1836 state's worst.
# Fitted to the world; before the first measure, 0 to 300.
te_jmap_imr_input = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_dg_imr }
		value = var:te_dg_imr
	}
}
te_jmap_imr_input_neg = {
	value = te_jmap_imr_input
	multiply = -1
}
te_jmap_imr_lo = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = te_jmap_rng_imr_lo }
		value = global_var:te_jmap_rng_imr_lo
	}
}
te_jmap_imr_hi = {
	value = 300
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = te_jmap_rng_imr_hi }
		value = global_var:te_jmap_rng_imr_hi
	}
	min = te_jmap_imr_hi_floor
}
te_jmap_imr_hi_floor = {
	value = te_jmap_imr_lo
	add = 20
}
te_jmap_imr_span = {
	value = te_jmap_imr_hi
	subtract = te_jmap_imr_lo
}
te_jmap_imr_d0 = {
	value = te_jmap_imr_span
	multiply = 1
}
te_jmap_imr_lg_min = {
	value = te_jmap_imr_hi
	divide = 64
}
te_jmap_imr_lg_r = {
	value = var:te_dg_imr
	multiply = 64
	divide = te_jmap_imr_hi
	if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_imr_lo > te_jmap_imr_lg_min }
		value = var:te_dg_imr
		divide = te_jmap_imr_lo
	}
}
te_jmap_imr_lg_t = {
	if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_imr_lg_r < 2 }
		value = te_jmap_imr_lg_r subtract = 1
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_imr_lg_r < 4 }
		value = te_jmap_imr_lg_r divide = 2
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_imr_lg_r < 8 }
		value = te_jmap_imr_lg_r divide = 4 add = 1
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_imr_lg_r < 16 }
		value = te_jmap_imr_lg_r divide = 8 add = 2
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_imr_lg_r < 32 }
		value = te_jmap_imr_lg_r divide = 16 add = 3
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_imr_lg_r < 64 }
		value = te_jmap_imr_lg_r divide = 32 add = 4
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_imr_lg_r < 128 }
		value = te_jmap_imr_lg_r divide = 64 add = 5
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_imr_lg_r < 256 }
		value = te_jmap_imr_lg_r divide = 128 add = 6
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_imr_lg_r < 512 }
		value = te_jmap_imr_lg_r divide = 256 add = 7
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_imr_lg_r < 1024 }
		value = te_jmap_imr_lg_r divide = 512 add = 8
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_imr_lg_r < 2048 }
		value = te_jmap_imr_lg_r divide = 1024 add = 9
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_imr_lg_r < 4096 }
		value = te_jmap_imr_lg_r divide = 2048 add = 10
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_imr_lg_r < 8192 }
		value = te_jmap_imr_lg_r divide = 4096 add = 11
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_imr_lg_r < 16384 }
		value = te_jmap_imr_lg_r divide = 8192 add = 12
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_imr_lg_r < 32768 }
		value = te_jmap_imr_lg_r divide = 16384 add = 13
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_imr_lg_r < 65536 }
		value = te_jmap_imr_lg_r divide = 32768 add = 14
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_imr_lg_r < 131072 }
		value = te_jmap_imr_lg_r divide = 65536 add = 15
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_imr_lg_r < 262144 }
		value = te_jmap_imr_lg_r divide = 131072 add = 16
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_imr_lg_r < 524288 }
		value = te_jmap_imr_lg_r divide = 262144 add = 17
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_imr_lg_r < 1048576 }
		value = te_jmap_imr_lg_r divide = 524288 add = 18
	}
	else = {
		value = te_jmap_imr_lg_r divide = 1048576 add = 19
	}
}
te_jmap_imr_lg_span_r = {
	value = 64
	if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_imr_lo > te_jmap_imr_lg_min }
		value = te_jmap_imr_hi
		divide = te_jmap_imr_lo
	}
}
te_jmap_imr_lg_top = {
	if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_imr_lg_span_r < 2 }
		value = te_jmap_imr_lg_span_r subtract = 1
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_imr_lg_span_r < 4 }
		value = te_jmap_imr_lg_span_r divide = 2
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_imr_lg_span_r < 8 }
		value = te_jmap_imr_lg_span_r divide = 4 add = 1
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_imr_lg_span_r < 16 }
		value = te_jmap_imr_lg_span_r divide = 8 add = 2
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_imr_lg_span_r < 32 }
		value = te_jmap_imr_lg_span_r divide = 16 add = 3
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_imr_lg_span_r < 64 }
		value = te_jmap_imr_lg_span_r divide = 32 add = 4
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_imr_lg_span_r < 128 }
		value = te_jmap_imr_lg_span_r divide = 64 add = 5
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_imr_lg_span_r < 256 }
		value = te_jmap_imr_lg_span_r divide = 128 add = 6
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_imr_lg_span_r < 512 }
		value = te_jmap_imr_lg_span_r divide = 256 add = 7
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_imr_lg_span_r < 1024 }
		value = te_jmap_imr_lg_span_r divide = 512 add = 8
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_imr_lg_span_r < 2048 }
		value = te_jmap_imr_lg_span_r divide = 1024 add = 9
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_imr_lg_span_r < 4096 }
		value = te_jmap_imr_lg_span_r divide = 2048 add = 10
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_imr_lg_span_r < 8192 }
		value = te_jmap_imr_lg_span_r divide = 4096 add = 11
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_imr_lg_span_r < 16384 }
		value = te_jmap_imr_lg_span_r divide = 8192 add = 12
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_imr_lg_span_r < 32768 }
		value = te_jmap_imr_lg_span_r divide = 16384 add = 13
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_imr_lg_span_r < 65536 }
		value = te_jmap_imr_lg_span_r divide = 32768 add = 14
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_imr_lg_span_r < 131072 }
		value = te_jmap_imr_lg_span_r divide = 65536 add = 15
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_imr_lg_span_r < 262144 }
		value = te_jmap_imr_lg_span_r divide = 131072 add = 16
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_imr_lg_span_r < 524288 }
		value = te_jmap_imr_lg_span_r divide = 262144 add = 17
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_imr_lg_span_r < 1048576 }
		value = te_jmap_imr_lg_span_r divide = 524288 add = 18
	}
	else = {
		value = te_jmap_imr_lg_span_r divide = 1048576 add = 19
	}
	min = 0.001
}
te_jmap_imr_factor = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_dg_imr }
		if = {
			limit = { te_jmap_scale = 0 }
			value = var:te_dg_imr subtract = te_jmap_imr_lo divide = te_jmap_imr_d0
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { te_jmap_scale = 1 }
			value = var:te_dg_imr
			subtract = te_jmap_imr_lo
			divide = te_jmap_imr_span
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { te_jmap_scale = 2 }
			value = te_jmap_imr_lg_t
			divide = te_jmap_imr_lg_top
		}
		else = {
			value = 0.5
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = te_jmap_rank }
				value = var:te_jmap_rank
			}
		}
	}
	min = 0
	max = 1
}
te_jmap_imr_factor_lower = {
	value = te_jmap_imr_factor
	multiply = 2
	min = 0
	max = 1
}
te_jmap_imr_factor_upper = {
	value = te_jmap_imr_factor
	multiply = 2
	subtract = 1
	min = 0
	max = 1
}

# Fertility, children a woman, split at replacement (2.1).
# Fitted to the world on each side of 2.1; before the first measure, 1 to 6.5.
te_jmap_tfr_input = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_dg_tfr }
		value = var:te_dg_tfr
	}

	value = te_jmap_tfr_input
	multiply = -1
}

	value = 1
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = te_jmap_rng_tfr_lo }
		value = global_var:te_jmap_rng_tfr_lo
	}
}

	value = 6.5
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = te_jmap_rng_tfr_hi }
		value = global_var:te_jmap_rng_tfr_hi
	}
	min = te_jmap_tfr_hi_floor
}
te_jmap_tfr_hi_floor = {
	value = te_jmap_tfr_lo
	add = 0.5
}

	value = te_jmap_tfr_hi
	max = 2.1
}
te_jmap_tfr_a = {
	value = te_jmap_tfr_lo
	min = 2.1
}

	value = te_jmap_tfr_b
	subtract = te_jmap_tfr_lo
	min = 0.5
}

	value = te_jmap_tfr_hi
	subtract = te_jmap_tfr_a
	min = 0.5
}

	value = te_jmap_tfr_span_low
	multiply = 2
}

	value = te_jmap_tfr_span_up
	multiply = 2
}

	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_tfr_sl_up_r < 32768 }
		value = te_jmap_tfr_sl_up_r divide = 16384 add = 13
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_tfr_sl_up_r < 65536 }
		value = te_jmap_tfr_sl_up_r divide = 32768 add = 14
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_tfr_sl_up_r < 131072 }
		value = te_jmap_tfr_sl_up_r divide = 65536 add = 15
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_tfr_sl_up_r < 262144 }
		value = te_jmap_tfr_sl_up_r divide = 131072 add = 16
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_tfr_sl_up_r < 524288 }
		value = te_jmap_tfr_sl_up_r divide = 262144 add = 17
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_tfr_sl_up_r < 1048576 }
		value = te_jmap_tfr_sl_up_r divide = 524288 add = 18
	}
	else = {
		value = te_jmap_tfr_sl_up_r divide = 1048576 add = 19
	}
	add = 1
}
te_jmap_tfr_sl_up_span_r = {
	value = te_jmap_tfr_span_up
	divide = 0.25
}
te_jmap_tfr_sl_up_top = {
	if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_tfr_sl_up_span_r < 2 }
		value = te_jmap_tfr_sl_up_span_r subtract = 1
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_tfr_sl_up_span_r < 4 }
		value = te_jmap_tfr_sl_up_span_r divide = 2
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_tfr_sl_up_span_r < 8 }
		value = te_jmap_tfr_sl_up_span_r divide = 4 add = 1
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_tfr_sl_up_span_r < 16 }
		value = te_jmap_tfr_sl_up_span_r divide = 8 add = 2
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_tfr_sl_up_span_r < 32 }
		value = te_jmap_tfr_sl_up_span_r divide = 16 add = 3
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_tfr_sl_up_span_r < 64 }
		value = te_jmap_tfr_sl_up_span_r divide = 32 add = 4
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_tfr_sl_up_span_r < 128 }
		value = te_jmap_tfr_sl_up_span_r divide = 64 add = 5
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_tfr_sl_up_span_r < 256 }
		value = te_jmap_tfr_sl_up_span_r divide = 128 add = 6
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_tfr_sl_up_span_r < 512 }
		value = te_jmap_tfr_sl_up_span_r divide = 256 add = 7
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_tfr_sl_up_span_r < 1024 }
		value = te_jmap_tfr_sl_up_span_r divide = 512 add = 8
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_tfr_sl_up_span_r < 2048 }
		value = te_jmap_tfr_sl_up_span_r divide = 1024 add = 9
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_tfr_sl_up_span_r < 4096 }
		value = te_jmap_tfr_sl_up_span_r divide = 2048 add = 10
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_tfr_sl_up_span_r < 8192 }
		value = te_jmap_tfr_sl_up_span_r divide = 4096 add = 11
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_tfr_sl_up_span_r < 16384 }
		value = te_jmap_tfr_sl_up_span_r divide = 8192 add = 12
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_tfr_sl_up_span_r < 32768 }
		value = te_jmap_tfr_sl_up_span_r divide = 16384 add = 13
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_tfr_sl_up_span_r < 65536 }
		value = te_jmap_tfr_sl_up_span_r divide = 32768 add = 14
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_tfr_sl_up_span_r < 131072 }
		value = te_jmap_tfr_sl_up_span_r divide = 65536 add = 15
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_tfr_sl_up_span_r < 262144 }
		value = te_jmap_tfr_sl_up_span_r divide = 131072 add = 16
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_tfr_sl_up_span_r < 524288 }
		value = te_jmap_tfr_sl_up_span_r divide = 262144 add = 17
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_tfr_sl_up_span_r < 1048576 }
		value = te_jmap_tfr_sl_up_span_r divide = 524288 add = 18
	}
	else = {
		value = te_jmap_tfr_sl_up_span_r divide = 1048576 add = 19
	}
	add = 1
	min = 1
}
te_jmap_tfr_factor = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_dg_tfr }
		if = {
			limit = { te_jmap_scale = 0 }
			if = {
				limit = { var:te_dg_tfr < 2.1 }
				value = var:te_dg_tfr subtract = te_jmap_tfr_b divide = te_jmap_tfr_l_d0 add = 0.5
				max = 0.5
			}
			else = {
				value = var:te_dg_tfr subtract = te_jmap_tfr_a divide = te_jmap_tfr_u_d0 add = 0.5
				min = 0.5
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { te_jmap_scale = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { var:te_dg_tfr < 2.1 }
				value = te_jmap_tfr_b
				subtract = var:te_dg_tfr
				divide = te_jmap_tfr_span_low
				multiply = -0.5
				add = 0.5
				max = 0.5
			}
			else = {
				value = var:te_dg_tfr
				subtract = te_jmap_tfr_a
				divide = te_jmap_tfr_span_up
				multiply = 0.5
				add = 0.5
				min = 0.5
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { te_jmap_scale = 2 }
			if = {
				limit = { var:te_dg_tfr < 2.1 }
				value = te_jmap_tfr_sl_low_t
				divide = te_jmap_tfr_sl_low_top
				multiply = -0.5
				add = 0.5
				max = 0.5
			}
			else = {
				value = te_jmap_tfr_sl_up_t
				divide = te_jmap_tfr_sl_up_top
				multiply = 0.5
				add = 0.5
				min = 0.5
			}
		}
		else = {
			value = 0.5
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = te_jmap_rank }
				value = var:te_jmap_rank
			}
		}
	}
	min = 0
	max = 1
}
te_jmap_tfr_factor_lower = {
	value = te_jmap_tfr_factor
	multiply = 2
	min = 0
	max = 1
}
te_jmap_tfr_factor_upper = {
	value = te_jmap_tfr_factor
	multiply = 2
	subtract = 1
	min = 0
	max = 1
}

# Median age, split at the middle of the world's range.
# Fitted to the world; before the first measure, 15 to 45.
te_jmap_median_input = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_dg_median }
		value = var:te_dg_median
	}
}
te_jmap_median_input_neg = {
	value = te_jmap_median_input
	multiply = -1
}
te_jmap_median_lo = {
	value = 15
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = te_jmap_rng_median_lo }
		value = global_var:te_jmap_rng_median_lo
	}
}
te_jmap_median_hi = {
	value = 45
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = te_jmap_rng_median_hi }
		value = global_var:te_jmap_rng_median_hi
	}
	min = te_jmap_median_hi_floor
}
te_jmap_median_hi_floor = {
	value = te_jmap_median_lo
	add = 5
}
te_jmap_median_span = {
	value = te_jmap_median_hi
	subtract = te_jmap_median_lo
}
te_jmap_median_d0 = {
	value = te_jmap_median_span
	multiply = 1
}
te_jmap_median_lg_min = {
	value = te_jmap_median_hi
	divide = 64
}
te_jmap_median_lg_r = {
	value = var:te_dg_median
	multiply = 64
	divide = te_jmap_median_hi
	if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_median_lo > te_jmap_median_lg_min }
		value = var:te_dg_median
		divide = te_jmap_median_lo
	}
}
te_jmap_median_lg_t = {
	if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_median_lg_r < 2 }
		value = te_jmap_median_lg_r subtract = 1
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_median_lg_r < 4 }
		value = te_jmap_median_lg_r divide = 2
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_median_lg_r < 8 }
		value = te_jmap_median_lg_r divide = 4 add = 1
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_median_lg_r < 16 }
		value = te_jmap_median_lg_r divide = 8 add = 2
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_median_lg_r < 32 }
		value = te_jmap_median_lg_r divide = 16 add = 3
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_median_lg_r < 64 }
		value = te_jmap_median_lg_r divide = 32 add = 4
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_median_lg_r < 128 }
		value = te_jmap_median_lg_r divide = 64 add = 5
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_median_lg_r < 256 }
		value = te_jmap_median_lg_r divide = 128 add = 6
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_median_lg_r < 512 }
		value = te_jmap_median_lg_r divide = 256 add = 7
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_median_lg_r < 1024 }
		value = te_jmap_median_lg_r divide = 512 add = 8
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_median_lg_r < 2048 }
		value = te_jmap_median_lg_r divide = 1024 add = 9
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_median_lg_r < 4096 }
		value = te_jmap_median_lg_r divide = 2048 add = 10
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_median_lg_r < 8192 }
		value = te_jmap_median_lg_r divide = 4096 add = 11
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_median_lg_r < 16384 }
		value = te_jmap_median_lg_r divide = 8192 add = 12
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_median_lg_r < 32768 }
		value = te_jmap_median_lg_r divide = 16384 add = 13
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_median_lg_r < 65536 }
		value = te_jmap_median_lg_r divide = 32768 add = 14
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_median_lg_r < 131072 }
		value = te_jmap_median_lg_r divide = 65536 add = 15
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_median_lg_r < 262144 }
		value = te_jmap_median_lg_r divide = 131072 add = 16
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_median_lg_r < 524288 }
		value = te_jmap_median_lg_r divide = 262144 add = 17
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_median_lg_r < 1048576 }
		value = te_jmap_median_lg_r divide = 524288 add = 18
	}
	else = {
		value = te_jmap_median_lg_r divide = 1048576 add = 19
	}
}
te_jmap_median_lg_span_r = {
	value = 64
	if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_median_lo > te_jmap_median_lg_min }
		value = te_jmap_median_hi
		divide = te_jmap_median_lo
	}
}
te_jmap_median_lg_top = {
	if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_median_lg_span_r < 2 }
		value = te_jmap_median_lg_span_r subtract = 1
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_median_lg_span_r < 4 }
		value = te_jmap_median_lg_span_r divide = 2
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_median_lg_span_r < 8 }
		value = te_jmap_median_lg_span_r divide = 4 add = 1

	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_median_lg_span_r < 16 }

	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_median_lg_span_r < 32 }

		limit = { te_jmap_median_lg_span_r < 64 }

	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_median_lg_span_r < 128 }

	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_median_lg_span_r < 256 }
		value = te_jmap_median_lg_span_r divide = 128 add = 6
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_median_lg_span_r < 512 }
		value = te_jmap_median_lg_span_r divide = 256 add = 7
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_median_lg_span_r < 1024 }
		value = te_jmap_median_lg_span_r divide = 512 add = 8
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_median_lg_span_r < 2048 }
		value = te_jmap_median_lg_span_r divide = 1024 add = 9
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_median_lg_span_r < 4096 }
		value = te_jmap_median_lg_span_r divide = 2048 add = 10
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_median_lg_span_r < 8192 }
		value = te_jmap_median_lg_span_r divide = 4096 add = 11
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_median_lg_span_r < 16384 }
		value = te_jmap_median_lg_span_r divide = 8192 add = 12
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_median_lg_span_r < 32768 }
		value = te_jmap_median_lg_span_r divide = 16384 add = 13
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_median_lg_span_r < 65536 }
		value = te_jmap_median_lg_span_r divide = 32768 add = 14
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_median_lg_span_r < 131072 }
		value = te_jmap_median_lg_span_r divide = 65536 add = 15
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_median_lg_span_r < 262144 }
		value = te_jmap_median_lg_span_r divide = 131072 add = 16
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_median_lg_span_r < 524288 }
		value = te_jmap_median_lg_span_r divide = 262144 add = 17
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_median_lg_span_r < 1048576 }
		value = te_jmap_median_lg_span_r divide = 524288 add = 18
	}
	else = {
		value = te_jmap_median_lg_span_r divide = 1048576 add = 19
	}
	min = 0.001
}
te_jmap_median_factor = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_dg_median }
		if = {
			limit = { te_jmap_scale = 0 }
			value = var:te_dg_median subtract = te_jmap_median_lo divide = te_jmap_median_d0
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { te_jmap_scale = 1 }
			value = var:te_dg_median
			subtract = te_jmap_median_lo
			divide = te_jmap_median_span
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { te_jmap_scale = 2 }
			value = te_jmap_median_lg_t
			divide = te_jmap_median_lg_top
		}
		else = {
			value = 0.5
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = te_jmap_rank }
				value = var:te_jmap_rank
			}
		}
	}
	min = 0
	max = 1
}
te_jmap_median_factor_lower = {
	value = te_jmap_median_factor
	multiply = 2
	min = 0
	max = 1
}
te_jmap_median_factor_upper = {
	value = te_jmap_median_factor
	multiply = 2
	subtract = 1
	min = 0
	max = 1
}

# Natural change per 1,000 people last year, split at none; famine and war run far below.
# Fitted to the world on each side of 0; before the first measure, -40 to 45.
te_jmap_natural_input = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_dg_cbr has_variable = te_dg_cdr }
		value = te_demog_natural_change
	}
}
te_jmap_natural_input_neg = {
	value = te_jmap_natural_input
	multiply = -1
}
te_jmap_natural_lo = {
	value = -40
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = te_jmap_rng_natural_lo }
		value = global_var:te_jmap_rng_natural_lo
	}
}
te_jmap_natural_hi = {
	value = 45
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = te_jmap_rng_natural_hi }
		value = global_var:te_jmap_rng_natural_hi
	}
	min = te_jmap_natural_hi_floor
}
te_jmap_natural_hi_floor = {
	value = te_jmap_natural_lo
	add = 5
}
te_jmap_natural_b = {
	value = te_jmap_natural_hi
	max = 0
}
te_jmap_natural_a = {
	value = te_jmap_natural_lo
	min = 0
}
te_jmap_natural_span_low = {
	value = te_jmap_natural_b
	subtract = te_jmap_natural_lo
	min = 5
}
te_jmap_natural_span_up = {
	value = te_jmap_natural_hi
	subtract = te_jmap_natural_a
	min = 5
}
te_jmap_natural_l_k1 = {
	value = te_jmap_natural_span_low
	multiply = -0.375
	add = te_jmap_natural_b
}
te_jmap_natural_l_d0 = {
	value = te_jmap_natural_span_low
	multiply = 1.0625
}
te_jmap_natural_l_d1 = {
	value = te_jmap_natural_span_low
	multiply = 4.25
}
te_jmap_natural_u_k1 = {
	value = te_jmap_natural_span_up
	multiply = 0.66667
	add = te_jmap_natural_a
}
te_jmap_natural_u_d0 = {
	value = te_jmap_natural_span_up
	multiply = 1.5
}
te_jmap_natural_u_d1 = {
	value = te_jmap_natural_span_up
	multiply = 6
}
te_jmap_natural_sl_low_r = {
	value = te_jmap_natural_b
	subtract = te_demog_natural_change
	divide = 2.5
}

		limit = { te_jmap_natural_sl_low_r < 2 }
		value = te_jmap_natural_sl_low_r subtract = 1
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_natural_sl_low_r < 4 }
		value = te_jmap_natural_sl_low_r divide = 2
	}

		limit = { te_jmap_natural_sl_low_r < 8 }
		value = te_jmap_natural_sl_low_r divide = 4 add = 1
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_natural_sl_low_r < 16 }

	}

		limit = { te_jmap_natural_sl_low_r < 32 }

		limit = { te_jmap_natural_sl_low_r < 64 }

	}

		limit = { te_jmap_natural_sl_low_r < 128 }

		value = te_jmap_natural_sl_low_r divide = 128 add = 6
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_natural_sl_low_r < 512 }
		value = te_jmap_natural_sl_low_r divide = 256 add = 7
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_natural_sl_low_r < 1024 }
		value = te_jmap_natural_sl_low_r divide = 512 add = 8
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_natural_sl_low_r < 2048 }
		value = te_jmap_natural_sl_low_r divide = 1024 add = 9
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_natural_sl_low_r < 4096 }
		value = te_jmap_natural_sl_low_r divide = 2048 add = 10
	}
	else_if = {

	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_natural_sl_low_r < 32768 }
		value = te_jmap_natural_sl_low_r divide = 16384 add = 13
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_natural_sl_low_r < 65536 }
		value = te_jmap_natural_sl_low_r divide = 32768 add = 14
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_natural_sl_low_r < 131072 }
		value = te_jmap_natural_sl_low_r divide = 65536 add = 15
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_natural_sl_low_r < 262144 }
		value = te_jmap_natural_sl_low_r divide = 131072 add = 16
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_natural_sl_low_r < 524288 }
		value = te_jmap_natural_sl_low_r divide = 262144 add = 17
	}

te_jmap_natural_factor = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_dg_cbr has_variable = te_dg_cdr }
		if = {
			limit = { te_jmap_scale = 0 }
			if = {
				limit = { te_demog_natural_change < 0 }
				if = {
					limit = { te_demog_natural_change > te_jmap_natural_l_k1 }
					value = te_demog_natural_change subtract = te_jmap_natural_b divide = te_jmap_natural_l_d0 add = 0.5
				}
				else = {
					value = te_demog_natural_change subtract = te_jmap_natural_l_k1 divide = te_jmap_natural_l_d1 add = 0.14706
				}
				max = 0.5
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = { te_demog_natural_change < te_jmap_natural_u_k1 }
					value = te_demog_natural_change subtract = te_jmap_natural_a divide = te_jmap_natural_u_d0 add = 0.5
				}
				else = {
					value = te_demog_natural_change subtract = te_jmap_natural_u_k1 divide = te_jmap_natural_u_d1 add = 0.94444
				}
				min = 0.5
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { te_jmap_scale = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { te_demog_natural_change < 0 }
				value = te_jmap_natural_b
				subtract = te_demog_natural_change
				divide = te_jmap_natural_span_low
				multiply = -0.5
				add = 0.5
				max = 0.5
			}
			else = {
				value = te_demog_natural_change
				subtract = te_jmap_natural_a
				divide = te_jmap_natural_span_up
				multiply = 0.5
				add = 0.5
				min = 0.5
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { te_jmap_scale = 2 }
			if = {
				limit = { te_demog_natural_change < 0 }
				value = te_jmap_natural_sl_low_t
				divide = te_jmap_natural_sl_low_top
				multiply = -0.5
				add = 0.5
				max = 0.5
			}
			else = {
				value = te_jmap_natural_sl_up_t
				divide = te_jmap_natural_sl_up_top
				multiply = 0.5
				add = 0.5
				min = 0.5
			}
		}
		else = {
			value = 0.5
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = te_jmap_rank }
				value = var:te_jmap_rank
			}
		}
	}
	min = 0
	max = 1
}
te_jmap_natural_factor_lower = {
	value = te_jmap_natural_factor
	multiply = 2
	min = 0
	max = 1
}
te_jmap_natural_factor_upper = {
	value = te_jmap_natural_factor
	multiply = 2
	subtract = 1
	min = 0
	max = 1
}

# Deaths per 1,000 people last year, 70% of the color by 37% of the world's range; famine and war run far above.
# Fitted to the world; before the first measure, 5 to 100.
te_jmap_cdr_input = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_dg_cdr }
		value = var:te_dg_cdr
	}
}

	value = te_jmap_cdr_input
	multiply = -1
}
te_jmap_cdr_lo = {
	value = 5
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = te_jmap_rng_cdr_lo }
		value = global_var:te_jmap_rng_cdr_lo
	}
}

	value = 100
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = te_jmap_rng_cdr_hi }
		value = global_var:te_jmap_rng_cdr_hi
	}
	min = te_jmap_cdr_hi_floor
}

	value = te_jmap_cdr_lo
	add = 5
}

	subtract = te_jmap_cdr_lo
}

	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_cdr_lg_span_r < 131072 }
		value = te_jmap_cdr_lg_span_r divide = 65536 add = 15
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_cdr_lg_span_r < 262144 }
		value = te_jmap_cdr_lg_span_r divide = 131072 add = 16
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_cdr_lg_span_r < 524288 }
		value = te_jmap_cdr_lg_span_r divide = 262144 add = 17
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_cdr_lg_span_r < 1048576 }
		value = te_jmap_cdr_lg_span_r divide = 524288 add = 18
	}
	else = {
		value = te_jmap_cdr_lg_span_r divide = 1048576 add = 19
	}
	min = 0.001
}
te_jmap_cdr_factor = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_dg_cdr }
		if = {
			limit = { te_jmap_scale = 0 }
			if = {
				limit = { var:te_dg_cdr < te_jmap_cdr_k1 }
				value = var:te_dg_cdr subtract = te_jmap_cdr_lo divide = te_jmap_cdr_d0
			}
			else = {
				value = var:te_dg_cdr subtract = te_jmap_cdr_k1 divide = te_jmap_cdr_d1 add = 0.7
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { te_jmap_scale = 1 }
			value = var:te_dg_cdr
			subtract = te_jmap_cdr_lo
			divide = te_jmap_cdr_span
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { te_jmap_scale = 2 }
			value = te_jmap_cdr_lg_t
			divide = te_jmap_cdr_lg_top
		}
		else = {
			value = 0
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = te_jmap_rank }
				value = var:te_jmap_rank
			}
		}
	}
	min = 0
	max = 1
}

# Births per 1,000 people last year.
# Fitted to the world; before the first measure, 8 to 50.
te_jmap_cbr_input = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_dg_cbr }
		value = var:te_dg_cbr
	}
}
te_jmap_cbr_input_neg = {
	value = te_jmap_cbr_input
	multiply = -1
}
te_jmap_cbr_lo = {
	value = 8
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = te_jmap_rng_cbr_lo }
		value = global_var:te_jmap_rng_cbr_lo
	}
}
te_jmap_cbr_hi = {
	value = 50
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = te_jmap_rng_cbr_hi }
		value = global_var:te_jmap_rng_cbr_hi
	}
	min = te_jmap_cbr_hi_floor
}
te_jmap_cbr_hi_floor = {
	value = te_jmap_cbr_lo
	add = 5
}
te_jmap_cbr_span = {
	value = te_jmap_cbr_hi
	subtract = te_jmap_cbr_lo
}
te_jmap_cbr_d0 = {
	value = te_jmap_cbr_span
	multiply = 1
}
te_jmap_cbr_lg_min = {
	value = te_jmap_cbr_hi
	divide = 64
}
te_jmap_cbr_lg_r = {
	value = var:te_dg_cbr
	multiply = 64
	divide = te_jmap_cbr_hi
	if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_cbr_lo > te_jmap_cbr_lg_min }
		value = var:te_dg_cbr
		divide = te_jmap_cbr_lo
	}
}
te_jmap_cbr_lg_t = {
	if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_cbr_lg_r < 2 }
		value = te_jmap_cbr_lg_r subtract = 1
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_cbr_lg_r < 4 }
		value = te_jmap_cbr_lg_r divide = 2
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_cbr_lg_r < 8 }
		value = te_jmap_cbr_lg_r divide = 4 add = 1
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_cbr_lg_r < 16 }
		value = te_jmap_cbr_lg_r divide = 8 add = 2
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_cbr_lg_r < 32 }
		value = te_jmap_cbr_lg_r divide = 16 add = 3
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_cbr_lg_r < 64 }
		value = te_jmap_cbr_lg_r divide = 32 add = 4
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_cbr_lg_r < 128 }
		value = te_jmap_cbr_lg_r divide = 64 add = 5
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_cbr_lg_r < 256 }
		value = te_jmap_cbr_lg_r divide = 128 add = 6
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_cbr_lg_r < 512 }
		value = te_jmap_cbr_lg_r divide = 256 add = 7
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_cbr_lg_r < 1024 }
		value = te_jmap_cbr_lg_r divide = 512 add = 8
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_cbr_lg_r < 2048 }
		value = te_jmap_cbr_lg_r divide = 1024 add = 9
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_cbr_lg_r < 4096 }
		value = te_jmap_cbr_lg_r divide = 2048 add = 10
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_cbr_lg_r < 8192 }
		value = te_jmap_cbr_lg_r divide = 4096 add = 11
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_cbr_lg_r < 16384 }
		value = te_jmap_cbr_lg_r divide = 8192 add = 12
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_cbr_lg_r < 32768 }
		value = te_jmap_cbr_lg_r divide = 16384 add = 13
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_cbr_lg_r < 65536 }
		value = te_jmap_cbr_lg_r divide = 32768 add = 14
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_cbr_lg_r < 131072 }
		value = te_jmap_cbr_lg_r divide = 65536 add = 15
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_cbr_lg_r < 262144 }
		value = te_jmap_cbr_lg_r divide = 131072 add = 16
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_cbr_lg_r < 524288 }
		value = te_jmap_cbr_lg_r divide = 262144 add = 17
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_cbr_lg_r < 1048576 }
		value = te_jmap_cbr_lg_r divide = 524288 add = 18
	}
	else = {
		value = te_jmap_cbr_lg_r divide = 1048576 add = 19
	}
}
te_jmap_cbr_lg_span_r = {
	value = 64
	if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_cbr_lo > te_jmap_cbr_lg_min }
		value = te_jmap_cbr_hi
		divide = te_jmap_cbr_lo
	}

# Sex balance, men per 100 women aged 20-59, split at 100.
# Fitted to the world on each side of 100; before the first measure, 80 to 130.
te_jmap_sex_input = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_dg_sex_balance }
		value = var:te_dg_sex_balance
	}

	value = te_jmap_sex_input
	multiply = -1
}

	value = 80
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = te_jmap_rng_sex_lo }
		value = global_var:te_jmap_rng_sex_lo
	}
}
te_jmap_sex_hi = {
	value = 130
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = te_jmap_rng_sex_hi }
		value = global_var:te_jmap_rng_sex_hi
	}
	min = te_jmap_sex_hi_floor
}
te_jmap_sex_hi_floor = {
	value = te_jmap_sex_lo
	add = 5
}
te_jmap_sex_b = {
	value = te_jmap_sex_hi
	max = 100
}
te_jmap_sex_a = {
	value = te_jmap_sex_lo
	min = 100
}
te_jmap_sex_span_low = {
	value = te_jmap_sex_b
	subtract = te_jmap_sex_lo
	min = 5
}
te_jmap_sex_span_up = {
	value = te_jmap_sex_hi
	subtract = te_jmap_sex_a
	min = 5
}
te_jmap_sex_l_d0 = {
	value = te_jmap_sex_span_low
	multiply = 2
}

te_jmap_sex_factor = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_dg_sex_balance }
		if = {
			limit = { te_jmap_scale = 0 }
			if = {
				limit = { var:te_dg_sex_balance < 100 }
				value = var:te_dg_sex_balance subtract = te_jmap_sex_b divide = te_jmap_sex_l_d0 add = 0.5
				max = 0.5
			}
			else = {
				value = var:te_dg_sex_balance subtract = te_jmap_sex_a divide = te_jmap_sex_u_d0 add = 0.5
				min = 0.5
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { te_jmap_scale = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { var:te_dg_sex_balance < 100 }
				value = te_jmap_sex_b
				subtract = var:te_dg_sex_balance
				divide = te_jmap_sex_span_low
				multiply = -0.5
				add = 0.5
				max = 0.5
			}
			else = {
				value = var:te_dg_sex_balance
				subtract = te_jmap_sex_a
				divide = te_jmap_sex_span_up
				multiply = 0.5
				add = 0.5
				min = 0.5
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { te_jmap_scale = 2 }
			if = {
				limit = { var:te_dg_sex_balance < 100 }
				value = te_jmap_sex_sl_low_t
				divide = te_jmap_sex_sl_low_top
				multiply = -0.5
				add = 0.5
				max = 0.5
			}
			else = {
				value = te_jmap_sex_sl_up_t
				divide = te_jmap_sex_sl_up_top
				multiply = 0.5
				add = 0.5
				min = 0.5
			}
		}
		else = {
			value = 0.5
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = te_jmap_rank }
				value = var:te_jmap_rank
			}
		}
	}
	min = 0
	max = 1
}
te_jmap_sex_factor_lower = {
	value = te_jmap_sex_factor
	multiply = 2
	min = 0
	max = 1
}
te_jmap_sex_factor_upper = {
	value = te_jmap_sex_factor
	multiply = 2
	subtract = 1
	min = 0
	max = 1
}

# Net migration per 1,000 people last year, split at none.
# Fitted to the world on each side of 0; before the first measure, -60 to 60.
te_jmap_mig_input = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_dg_mig_rate }
		value = var:te_dg_mig_rate
	}
}
te_jmap_mig_input_neg = {
	value = te_jmap_mig_input
	multiply = -1
}
te_jmap_mig_lo = {
	value = -60
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = te_jmap_rng_mig_lo }
		value = global_var:te_jmap_rng_mig_lo
	}
}
te_jmap_mig_hi = {
	value = 60
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = te_jmap_rng_mig_hi }
		value = global_var:te_jmap_rng_mig_hi
	}
	min = te_jmap_mig_hi_floor
}
te_jmap_mig_hi_floor = {
	value = te_jmap_mig_lo
	add = 5
}

	value = te_jmap_mig_hi
	max = 0
}

	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_mig_sl_low_r < 524288 }
		value = te_jmap_mig_sl_low_r divide = 262144 add = 17
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_mig_sl_low_r < 1048576 }
		value = te_jmap_mig_sl_low_r divide = 524288 add = 18
	}
	else = {
		value = te_jmap_mig_sl_low_r divide = 1048576 add = 19
	}
	add = 1
}

te_jmap_mig_factor = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_dg_mig_rate }
		if = {
			limit = { te_jmap_scale = 0 }
			if = {
				limit = { var:te_dg_mig_rate < 0 }
				if = {
					limit = { var:te_dg_mig_rate > te_jmap_mig_l_k1 }
					value = var:te_dg_mig_rate subtract = te_jmap_mig_b divide = te_jmap_mig_l_d0 add = 0.5
				}
				else = {
					value = var:te_dg_mig_rate subtract = te_jmap_mig_l_k1 divide = te_jmap_mig_l_d1 add = 0.16667
				}
				max = 0.5
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = { var:te_dg_mig_rate < te_jmap_mig_u_k1 }
					value = var:te_dg_mig_rate subtract = te_jmap_mig_a divide = te_jmap_mig_u_d0 add = 0.5
				}
				else = {
					value = var:te_dg_mig_rate subtract = te_jmap_mig_u_k1 divide = te_jmap_mig_u_d1 add = 0.83333
				}
				min = 0.5
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { te_jmap_scale = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { var:te_dg_mig_rate < 0 }
				value = te_jmap_mig_b
				subtract = var:te_dg_mig_rate
				divide = te_jmap_mig_span_low
				multiply = -0.5
				add = 0.5
				max = 0.5
			}
			else = {
				value = var:te_dg_mig_rate
				subtract = te_jmap_mig_a
				divide = te_jmap_mig_span_up
				multiply = 0.5
				add = 0.5
				min = 0.5
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { te_jmap_scale = 2 }
			if = {
				limit = { var:te_dg_mig_rate < 0 }
				value = te_jmap_mig_sl_low_t
				divide = te_jmap_mig_sl_low_top
				multiply = -0.5
				add = 0.5
				max = 0.5
			}
			else = {
				value = te_jmap_mig_sl_up_t
				divide = te_jmap_mig_sl_up_top
				multiply = 0.5
				add = 0.5
				min = 0.5
			}
		}
		else = {
			value = 0.5
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = te_jmap_rank }
				value = var:te_jmap_rank
			}
		}
	}
	min = 0
	max = 1
}
te_jmap_mig_factor_lower = {
	value = te_jmap_mig_factor
	multiply = 2
	min = 0
	max = 1
}
te_jmap_mig_factor_upper = {
	value = te_jmap_mig_factor
	multiply = 2
	subtract = 1
	min = 0
	max = 1
}

# The leading cause of death's share of last year's deaths, its color pale at 30% and full at 90%: with seven causes the lead takes at least a seventh, and states ran 31-97% in 1838, 1940 and 2020 saves. Fixed: the map is categorical, and this only fades each cause's color.
# Fixed. Knots: 0.3 -> 0, 0.9 -> 1.
te_jmap_cause_factor = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_dg_dc_total has_variable = te_dg_dc_lead }
		value = te_demog_dc_lead_share subtract = 0.3 divide = 0.6
	}
	min = 0
	max = 1
}

# Global Warming: the state's share of the world's emissions last year (a share, owner 2026-11-06): half the color by a fifth of the world's range; a thousand-odd states average 0.1%.
# Fitted to the world; before the first measure, 0 to 0.05.
te_jmap_gw_input = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = gw_state_emis }
		value = te_jmap_gw_share
	}
}
te_jmap_gw_input_neg = {
	value = te_jmap_gw_input
	multiply = -1
}
te_jmap_gw_lo = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = te_jmap_rng_gw_lo }
		value = global_var:te_jmap_rng_gw_lo
	}
}
te_jmap_gw_hi = {
	value = 0.05
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = te_jmap_rng_gw_hi }
		value = global_var:te_jmap_rng_gw_hi
	}
	min = te_jmap_gw_hi_floor
}
te_jmap_gw_hi_floor = {
	value = te_jmap_gw_lo
	add = 0.005
}
te_jmap_gw_span = {
	value = te_jmap_gw_hi
	subtract = te_jmap_gw_lo
}
te_jmap_gw_k1 = {
	value = te_jmap_gw_span
	multiply = 0.2
	add = te_jmap_gw_lo
}
te_jmap_gw_d0 = {
	value = te_jmap_gw_span
	multiply = 0.4
}
te_jmap_gw_d1 = {
	value = te_jmap_gw_span
	multiply = 1.6
}
te_jmap_gw_factor = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = gw_state_emis }
		if = {
			limit = { te_jmap_gw_share < te_jmap_gw_k1 }
			value = te_jmap_gw_share subtract = te_jmap_gw_lo divide = te_jmap_gw_d0
		}
		else = {
			value = te_jmap_gw_share subtract = te_jmap_gw_k1 divide = te_jmap_gw_d1 add = 0.5
		}
	}
	min = 0
	max = 1
}

# Global Warming: the state's share of the world's emissions last year (a share, owner 2026-11-06): half the color by a fifth of the world's range; a thousand-odd states average 0.1%.
# The Map Room's own copy of te_jmap_gw_*: its range follows the Map Room's options, the entry's doesn't.
# Fitted to the world; before its first measure, the entry's range.
te_jmap_gw_room_input = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = gw_state_emis }
		value = te_jmap_gw_share
	}

	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = te_jmap_rng_gw_room_lo }

	value = te_jmap_gw_hi
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = te_jmap_rng_gw_room_hi }
		value = global_var:te_jmap_rng_gw_room_hi
	}
	min = te_jmap_gw_room_hi_floor
}

	value = te_jmap_gw_room_lo
	add = 0.005

	subtract = te_jmap_gw_room_lo

	multiply = 0.2
	add = te_jmap_gw_room_lo

	value = te_jmap_gw_room_span
	multiply = 0.4
}

	value = te_jmap_gw_room_span
	multiply = 1.6
}

	value = te_jmap_gw_room_hi
	divide = 64
}
te_jmap_gw_room_lg_r = {
	value = te_jmap_gw_share
	multiply = 64
	divide = te_jmap_gw_room_hi
	if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_gw_room_lo > te_jmap_gw_room_lg_min }
		value = te_jmap_gw_share
		divide = te_jmap_gw_room_lo
	}
}

		limit = { te_jmap_gw_room_lg_r < 2 }

		limit = { te_jmap_gw_room_lg_r < 4 }

		value = te_jmap_gw_room_lg_r divide = 16384 add = 13

	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_gw_room_lg_r < 65536 }
		value = te_jmap_gw_room_lg_r divide = 32768 add = 14
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_gw_room_lg_r < 131072 }
		value = te_jmap_gw_room_lg_r divide = 65536 add = 15
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_gw_room_lg_r < 262144 }
		value = te_jmap_gw_room_lg_r divide = 131072 add = 16
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_gw_room_lg_r < 524288 }
		value = te_jmap_gw_room_lg_r divide = 262144 add = 17
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_gw_room_lg_r < 1048576 }
		value = te_jmap_gw_room_lg_r divide = 524288 add = 18
	}
	else = {
		value = te_jmap_gw_room_lg_r divide = 1048576 add = 19
	}
}
te_jmap_gw_room_lg_span_r = {
	value = 64
	if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_gw_room_lo > te_jmap_gw_room_lg_min }
		value = te_jmap_gw_room_hi
		divide = te_jmap_gw_room_lo
	}
}
te_jmap_gw_room_lg_top = {
	if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_gw_room_lg_span_r < 2 }
		value = te_jmap_gw_room_lg_span_r subtract = 1
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_gw_room_lg_span_r < 4 }
		value = te_jmap_gw_room_lg_span_r divide = 2
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_gw_room_lg_span_r < 8 }
		value = te_jmap_gw_room_lg_span_r divide = 4 add = 1
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_gw_room_lg_span_r < 16 }
		value = te_jmap_gw_room_lg_span_r divide = 8 add = 2
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_gw_room_lg_span_r < 32 }
		value = te_jmap_gw_room_lg_span_r divide = 16 add = 3
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_gw_room_lg_span_r < 64 }
		value = te_jmap_gw_room_lg_span_r divide = 32 add = 4
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_gw_room_lg_span_r < 128 }
		value = te_jmap_gw_room_lg_span_r divide = 64 add = 5
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_gw_room_lg_span_r < 256 }

	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_gw_room_lg_span_r < 512 }
		value = te_jmap_gw_room_lg_span_r divide = 256 add = 7
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_gw_room_lg_span_r < 1024 }
		value = te_jmap_gw_room_lg_span_r divide = 512 add = 8
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_gw_room_lg_span_r < 2048 }
		value = te_jmap_gw_room_lg_span_r divide = 1024 add = 9
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_gw_room_lg_span_r < 4096 }
		value = te_jmap_gw_room_lg_span_r divide = 2048 add = 10
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_gw_room_lg_span_r < 8192 }
		value = te_jmap_gw_room_lg_span_r divide = 4096 add = 11
	}
	else_if = {

	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_gw_room_lg_span_r < 32768 }

te_jmap_gw_room_factor = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = gw_state_emis }
		if = {
			limit = { te_jmap_scale = 0 }
			if = {
				limit = { te_jmap_gw_share < te_jmap_gw_room_k1 }
				value = te_jmap_gw_share subtract = te_jmap_gw_room_lo divide = te_jmap_gw_room_d0
			}
			else = {
				value = te_jmap_gw_share subtract = te_jmap_gw_room_k1 divide = te_jmap_gw_room_d1 add = 0.5
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { te_jmap_scale = 1 }
			value = te_jmap_gw_share
			subtract = te_jmap_gw_room_lo
			divide = te_jmap_gw_room_span
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { te_jmap_scale = 2 }
			value = te_jmap_gw_room_lg_t
			divide = te_jmap_gw_room_lg_top
		}
		else = {
			value = 0
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = te_jmap_rank }
				value = var:te_jmap_rank
			}
		}
	}
	min = 0
	max = 1
}

# Covert Warfare: the viewer's network in the state's owner, 0-100 (intel tiers at 50 and 75). Fixed: the tiers are what the map shows.
# Fixed. Knots: 0 -> 0, 100 -> 1.
te_jmap_net_factor = {
	value = te_jmap_net_strength divide = 100
	min = 0
	max = 1
}

# Grand Monuments: the state's grandeur, two-thirds of the color by a third of the world's range.
# Fitted to the world; before the first measure, 0 to 225.
te_jmap_gm_input = {
	value = gm_state_grandeur
}
te_jmap_gm_input_neg = {
	value = te_jmap_gm_input
	multiply = -1
}
te_jmap_gm_lo = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = te_jmap_rng_gm_lo }
		value = global_var:te_jmap_rng_gm_lo
	}
}
te_jmap_gm_hi = {
	value = 225
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = te_jmap_rng_gm_hi }
		value = global_var:te_jmap_rng_gm_hi
	}
	min = te_jmap_gm_hi_floor
}
te_jmap_gm_hi_floor = {
	value = te_jmap_gm_lo
	add = 25
}
te_jmap_gm_span = {
	value = te_jmap_gm_hi
	subtract = te_jmap_gm_lo
}
te_jmap_gm_k1 = {
	value = te_jmap_gm_span
	multiply = 0.33333
	add = te_jmap_gm_lo
}
te_jmap_gm_d0 = {
	value = te_jmap_gm_span
	multiply = 0.5
}
te_jmap_gm_d1 = {
	value = te_jmap_gm_span
	multiply = 2
}
te_jmap_gm_factor = {
	if = {
		limit = { gm_state_grandeur < te_jmap_gm_k1 }
		value = gm_state_grandeur subtract = te_jmap_gm_lo divide = te_jmap_gm_d0
	}
	else = {
		value = gm_state_grandeur subtract = te_jmap_gm_k1 divide = te_jmap_gm_d1 add = 0.66667
	}
	min = 0
	max = 1
}

# Tourism's Base Appeal, the state panel's row, 0-1 (stored monthly by te_update_tourism_modifier); 0.2 is the score of a region the table doesn't list.

		limit = { te_jmap_tourism_lg_r < 16384 }
		value = te_jmap_tourism_lg_r divide = 8192 add = 12
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_tourism_lg_r < 32768 }
		value = te_jmap_tourism_lg_r divide = 16384 add = 13
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_tourism_lg_r < 65536 }
		value = te_jmap_tourism_lg_r divide = 32768 add = 14
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_tourism_lg_r < 131072 }
		value = te_jmap_tourism_lg_r divide = 65536 add = 15
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_tourism_lg_r < 262144 }
		value = te_jmap_tourism_lg_r divide = 131072 add = 16
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_tourism_lg_r < 524288 }
		value = te_jmap_tourism_lg_r divide = 262144 add = 17
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_tourism_lg_r < 1048576 }
		value = te_jmap_tourism_lg_r divide = 524288 add = 18
	}
	else = {
		value = te_jmap_tourism_lg_r divide = 1048576 add = 19
	}
}
te_jmap_tourism_lg_span_r = {
	value = 64
	if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_tourism_lo > te_jmap_tourism_lg_min }
		value = te_jmap_tourism_hi
		divide = te_jmap_tourism_lo
	}
}
te_jmap_tourism_lg_top = {
	if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_tourism_lg_span_r < 2 }
		value = te_jmap_tourism_lg_span_r subtract = 1
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_tourism_lg_span_r < 4 }
		value = te_jmap_tourism_lg_span_r divide = 2
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_tourism_lg_span_r < 8 }
		value = te_jmap_tourism_lg_span_r divide = 4 add = 1
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_tourism_lg_span_r < 16 }

	else_if = {

	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_tourism_lg_span_r < 64 }

	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_tourism_lg_span_r < 128 }

	else_if = {

	else_if = {

	}
	else_if = {

	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_tourism_lg_span_r < 2048 }
		value = te_jmap_tourism_lg_span_r divide = 1024 add = 9
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_tourism_lg_span_r < 4096 }
		value = te_jmap_tourism_lg_span_r divide = 2048 add = 10
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_tourism_lg_span_r < 8192 }

	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_tourism_lg_span_r < 16384 }
		value = te_jmap_tourism_lg_span_r divide = 8192 add = 12
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_tourism_lg_span_r < 32768 }

	}

	}

		value = te_jmap_tourism_lg_span_r divide = 524288 add = 18
	}
	else = {
		value = te_jmap_tourism_lg_span_r divide = 1048576 add = 19
	}
	min = 0.001
}
te_jmap_tourism_factor = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_tourism_base_appeal }
		if = {
			limit = { te_jmap_scale = 0 }
			value = var:te_tourism_base_appeal subtract = te_jmap_tourism_lo divide = te_jmap_tourism_d0
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { te_jmap_scale = 1 }
			value = var:te_tourism_base_appeal
			subtract = te_jmap_tourism_lo
			divide = te_jmap_tourism_span
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { te_jmap_scale = 2 }
			value = te_jmap_tourism_lg_t
			divide = te_jmap_tourism_lg_top
		}
		else = {
			value = 0
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = te_jmap_rank }
				value = var:te_jmap_rank
			}
		}
	}
	min = 0
	max = 1
}

# Local Climate's penalty before any relief, percent of migration attraction (stored yearly), split at none.
# Fitted to the world on each side of 0; before the first measure, -10.8 to 80.
te_jmap_comfort_base_input = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_climate_base_penalty }
		value = var:te_climate_base_penalty
	}
}
te_jmap_comfort_base_input_neg = {
	value = te_jmap_comfort_base_input
	multiply = -1
}
te_jmap_comfort_base_lo = {
	value = -10.8
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = te_jmap_rng_comfort_base_lo }
		value = global_var:te_jmap_rng_comfort_base_lo
	}
}
te_jmap_comfort_base_hi = {
	value = 80
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = te_jmap_rng_comfort_base_hi }
		value = global_var:te_jmap_rng_comfort_base_hi
	}
	min = te_jmap_comfort_base_hi_floor
}
te_jmap_comfort_base_hi_floor = {
	value = te_jmap_comfort_base_lo
	add = 3
}
te_jmap_comfort_base_b = {
	value = te_jmap_comfort_base_hi
	max = 0
}
te_jmap_comfort_base_a = {
	value = te_jmap_comfort_base_lo
	min = 0
}

	value = te_jmap_comfort_base_b
	subtract = te_jmap_comfort_base_lo
	min = 3
}
te_jmap_comfort_base_span_up = {
	value = te_jmap_comfort_base_hi
	subtract = te_jmap_comfort_base_a
	min = 3
}

}

		value = te_jmap_comfort_base_sl_up_span_r divide = 16384 add = 13
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_comfort_base_sl_up_span_r < 65536 }
		value = te_jmap_comfort_base_sl_up_span_r divide = 32768 add = 14
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_comfort_base_sl_up_span_r < 131072 }
		value = te_jmap_comfort_base_sl_up_span_r divide = 65536 add = 15
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_comfort_base_sl_up_span_r < 262144 }
		value = te_jmap_comfort_base_sl_up_span_r divide = 131072 add = 16
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_comfort_base_sl_up_span_r < 524288 }
		value = te_jmap_comfort_base_sl_up_span_r divide = 262144 add = 17
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_comfort_base_sl_up_span_r < 1048576 }
		value = te_jmap_comfort_base_sl_up_span_r divide = 524288 add = 18
	}
	else = {
		value = te_jmap_comfort_base_sl_up_span_r divide = 1048576 add = 19
	}
	add = 1
	min = 1
}
te_jmap_comfort_base_factor = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_climate_base_penalty }
		if = {
			limit = { te_jmap_scale = 0 }
			if = {
				limit = { var:te_climate_base_penalty < 0 }
				value = var:te_climate_base_penalty subtract = te_jmap_comfort_base_b divide = te_jmap_comfort_base_l_d0 add = 0.5
				max = 0.5
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = { var:te_climate_base_penalty < te_jmap_comfort_base_u_k1 }
					value = var:te_climate_base_penalty subtract = te_jmap_comfort_base_a divide = te_jmap_comfort_base_u_d0 add = 0.5
				}
				else = {
					value = var:te_climate_base_penalty subtract = te_jmap_comfort_base_u_k1 divide = te_jmap_comfort_base_u_d1 add = 0.85294
				}
				min = 0.5
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { te_jmap_scale = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { var:te_climate_base_penalty < 0 }
				value = te_jmap_comfort_base_b
				subtract = var:te_climate_base_penalty
				divide = te_jmap_comfort_base_span_low
				multiply = -0.5
				add = 0.5
				max = 0.5
			}
			else = {
				value = var:te_climate_base_penalty
				subtract = te_jmap_comfort_base_a
				divide = te_jmap_comfort_base_span_up
				multiply = 0.5
				add = 0.5
				min = 0.5
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { te_jmap_scale = 2 }
			if = {
				limit = { var:te_climate_base_penalty < 0 }
				value = te_jmap_comfort_base_sl_low_t
				divide = te_jmap_comfort_base_sl_low_top
				multiply = -0.5
				add = 0.5
				max = 0.5
			}
			else = {
				value = te_jmap_comfort_base_sl_up_t
				divide = te_jmap_comfort_base_sl_up_top
				multiply = 0.5
				add = 0.5
				min = 0.5
			}
		}
		else = {
			value = 0.5
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = te_jmap_rank }
				value = var:te_jmap_rank
			}
		}
	}
	min = 0
	max = 1
}
te_jmap_comfort_base_factor_lower = {
	value = te_jmap_comfort_base_factor
	multiply = 2
	min = 0
	max = 1
}
te_jmap_comfort_base_factor_upper = {
	value = te_jmap_comfort_base_factor
	multiply = 2
	subtract = 1
	min = 0
	max = 1
}

# Local Climate's penalty in force, after the relief its owner's technologies give (stored yearly), split at none, on Base Comfort's range.
# Fitted to the world on each side of 0; before the first measure, -10.8 to 80.
te_jmap_comfort_input = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_climate_penalty_applied }
		value = var:te_climate_penalty_applied
	}
}

	value = te_jmap_comfort_input
	multiply = -1
}

}

	value = te_jmap_comfort_base_hi

	value = te_jmap_comfort_lo
	min = 0

	subtract = te_jmap_comfort_a

	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_climate_penalty_applied }
		if = {
			limit = { te_jmap_scale = 0 }
			if = {
				limit = { var:te_climate_penalty_applied < 0 }
				value = var:te_climate_penalty_applied subtract = te_jmap_comfort_b divide = te_jmap_comfort_l_d0 add = 0.5
				max = 0.5
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = { var:te_climate_penalty_applied < te_jmap_comfort_u_k1 }
					value = var:te_climate_penalty_applied subtract = te_jmap_comfort_a divide = te_jmap_comfort_u_d0 add = 0.5
				}
				else = {
					value = var:te_climate_penalty_applied subtract = te_jmap_comfort_u_k1 divide = te_jmap_comfort_u_d1 add = 0.85294
				}
				min = 0.5
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { te_jmap_scale = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { var:te_climate_penalty_applied < 0 }
				value = te_jmap_comfort_b
				subtract = var:te_climate_penalty_applied
				divide = te_jmap_comfort_span_low
				multiply = -0.5
				add = 0.5
				max = 0.5
			}
			else = {
				value = var:te_climate_penalty_applied
				subtract = te_jmap_comfort_a
				divide = te_jmap_comfort_span_up
				multiply = 0.5
				add = 0.5
				min = 0.5
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { te_jmap_scale = 2 }
			if = {
				limit = { var:te_climate_penalty_applied < 0 }
				value = te_jmap_comfort_sl_low_t
				divide = te_jmap_comfort_sl_low_top
				multiply = -0.5

				max = 0.5

				value = te_jmap_comfort_sl_up_t

				multiply = 0.5
				add = 0.5
				min = 0.5
			}
		}
		else = {
			value = 0.5
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = te_jmap_rank }
				value = var:te_jmap_rank
			}
		}
	}
	min = 0
	max = 1
}
te_jmap_comfort_factor_lower = {
	value = te_jmap_comfort_factor
	multiply = 2
	min = 0
	max = 1
}
te_jmap_comfort_factor_upper = {
	value = te_jmap_comfort_factor
	multiply = 2
	subtract = 1
	min = 0
	max = 1
}

# GDP per capita, a year's GDP per person in pounds: the same share of the color for each doubling from the world's low to its high (a rich country about 1 in 1836, 8 in 1917, 60 today).
# A doubling at a time, fitted to the world; before the first measure, 0.25 to 256.
te_jmap_gdppc_input = {
	value = gdp_per_capita
}
te_jmap_gdppc_input_neg = {
	value = te_jmap_gdppc_input
	multiply = -1
}
te_jmap_gdppc_lo = {
	value = 0.25
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = te_jmap_rng_gdppc_lo }
		value = global_var:te_jmap_rng_gdppc_lo
	}
	min = 0.01
}
te_jmap_gdppc_hi = {
	value = 256
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = te_jmap_rng_gdppc_hi }
		value = global_var:te_jmap_rng_gdppc_hi
	}
	min = te_jmap_gdppc_hi_floor
}
te_jmap_gdppc_hi_floor = {
	value = te_jmap_gdppc_lo
	multiply = 4
}
te_jmap_gdppc_ratio = {
	value = gdp_per_capita
	divide = te_jmap_gdppc_lo
}
te_jmap_gdppc_log = {
	if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_gdppc_ratio < 2 }
		value = te_jmap_gdppc_ratio subtract = 1
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_gdppc_ratio < 4 }
		value = te_jmap_gdppc_ratio divide = 2
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_gdppc_ratio < 8 }
		value = te_jmap_gdppc_ratio divide = 4 add = 1
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_gdppc_ratio < 16 }
		value = te_jmap_gdppc_ratio divide = 8 add = 2
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_gdppc_ratio < 32 }
		value = te_jmap_gdppc_ratio divide = 16 add = 3
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_gdppc_ratio < 64 }
		value = te_jmap_gdppc_ratio divide = 32 add = 4
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_gdppc_ratio < 128 }
		value = te_jmap_gdppc_ratio divide = 64 add = 5
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_gdppc_ratio < 256 }
		value = te_jmap_gdppc_ratio divide = 128 add = 6
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_gdppc_ratio < 512 }
		value = te_jmap_gdppc_ratio divide = 256 add = 7
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_gdppc_ratio < 1024 }
		value = te_jmap_gdppc_ratio divide = 512 add = 8
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_gdppc_ratio < 2048 }
		value = te_jmap_gdppc_ratio divide = 1024 add = 9
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_gdppc_ratio < 4096 }
		value = te_jmap_gdppc_ratio divide = 2048 add = 10
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_gdppc_ratio < 8192 }
		value = te_jmap_gdppc_ratio divide = 4096 add = 11
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_gdppc_ratio < 16384 }
		value = te_jmap_gdppc_ratio divide = 8192 add = 12
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_gdppc_ratio < 32768 }
		value = te_jmap_gdppc_ratio divide = 16384 add = 13
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_gdppc_ratio < 65536 }
		value = te_jmap_gdppc_ratio divide = 32768 add = 14
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_gdppc_ratio < 131072 }
		value = te_jmap_gdppc_ratio divide = 65536 add = 15
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_gdppc_ratio < 262144 }
		value = te_jmap_gdppc_ratio divide = 131072 add = 16
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_gdppc_ratio < 524288 }
		value = te_jmap_gdppc_ratio divide = 262144 add = 17
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_gdppc_ratio < 1048576 }
		value = te_jmap_gdppc_ratio divide = 524288 add = 18
	}
	else = {
		value = te_jmap_gdppc_ratio divide = 1048576 add = 19
	}
}
te_jmap_gdppc_span_ratio = {
	value = te_jmap_gdppc_hi
	divide = te_jmap_gdppc_lo
}

		limit = { te_jmap_gdppc_span_ratio < 1024 }

	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_gdppc_span_ratio < 2048 }
		value = te_jmap_gdppc_span_ratio divide = 1024 add = 9
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_gdppc_span_ratio < 4096 }
		value = te_jmap_gdppc_span_ratio divide = 2048 add = 10
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_gdppc_span_ratio < 8192 }
		value = te_jmap_gdppc_span_ratio divide = 4096 add = 11

	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_gdppc_span_ratio < 16384 }

		limit = { te_jmap_gdppc_span_ratio < 32768 }

	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_gdppc_span_ratio < 65536 }
		value = te_jmap_gdppc_span_ratio divide = 32768 add = 14

	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_gdppc_span_ratio < 131072 }
		value = te_jmap_gdppc_span_ratio divide = 65536 add = 15
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_gdppc_span_ratio < 262144 }
		value = te_jmap_gdppc_span_ratio divide = 131072 add = 16
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_gdppc_span_ratio < 524288 }
		value = te_jmap_gdppc_span_ratio divide = 262144 add = 17
	}

		limit = { te_jmap_gdppc_span_ratio < 1048576 }
		value = te_jmap_gdppc_span_ratio divide = 524288 add = 18
	}
	else = {
		value = te_jmap_gdppc_span_ratio divide = 1048576 add = 19
	}
	min = 1
}
te_jmap_gdppc_span = {
	value = te_jmap_gdppc_hi
	subtract = te_jmap_gdppc_lo
}
te_jmap_gdppc_factor = {
	if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_scale = 0 }
		value = te_jmap_gdppc_log
		divide = te_jmap_gdppc_log_span
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_scale = 1 }
		value = gdp_per_capita
		subtract = te_jmap_gdppc_lo
		divide = te_jmap_gdppc_span
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_scale = 2 }
		value = te_jmap_gdppc_log
		divide = te_jmap_gdppc_log_span
	}
	else = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = te_jmap_rank }
			value = var:te_jmap_rank
		}
	}
	min = 0
	max = 1
}

# Migration Crowding's cut to migration attraction, 0-1 and past it, as the state panel's tile shows it: two-thirds of the color by 31% of the world's range.
# Fitted to the world; before the first measure, 0 to 1.45.
te_jmap_crowding_input = {
	value = migration_crowding_pull_pct
}
te_jmap_crowding_input_neg = {
	value = te_jmap_crowding_input
	multiply = -1
}
te_jmap_crowding_lo = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = te_jmap_rng_crowding_lo }
		value = global_var:te_jmap_rng_crowding_lo
	}
}
te_jmap_crowding_hi = {
	value = 1.45
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = te_jmap_rng_crowding_hi }
		value = global_var:te_jmap_rng_crowding_hi
	}
	min = te_jmap_crowding_hi_floor
}
te_jmap_crowding_hi_floor = {
	value = te_jmap_crowding_lo
	add = 0.1
}
te_jmap_crowding_span = {
	value = te_jmap_crowding_hi
	subtract = te_jmap_crowding_lo
}
te_jmap_crowding_k1 = {
	value = te_jmap_crowding_span
	multiply = 0.31034
	add = te_jmap_crowding_lo
}
te_jmap_crowding_d0 = {
	value = te_jmap_crowding_span
	multiply = 0.48276
}
te_jmap_crowding_d1 = {
	value = te_jmap_crowding_span
	multiply = 1.93103
}
te_jmap_crowding_lg_min = {
	value = te_jmap_crowding_hi
	divide = 64
}
te_jmap_crowding_lg_r = {
	value = migration_crowding_pull_pct
	multiply = 64
	divide = te_jmap_crowding_hi
	if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_crowding_lo > te_jmap_crowding_lg_min }
		value = migration_crowding_pull_pct
		divide = te_jmap_crowding_lo
	}
}
te_jmap_crowding_lg_t = {
	if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_crowding_lg_r < 2 }
		value = te_jmap_crowding_lg_r subtract = 1
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_crowding_lg_r < 4 }
		value = te_jmap_crowding_lg_r divide = 2
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_crowding_lg_r < 8 }
		value = te_jmap_crowding_lg_r divide = 4 add = 1
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_crowding_lg_r < 16 }
		value = te_jmap_crowding_lg_r divide = 8 add = 2
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_crowding_lg_r < 32 }
		value = te_jmap_crowding_lg_r divide = 16 add = 3
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_crowding_lg_r < 64 }
		value = te_jmap_crowding_lg_r divide = 32 add = 4
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_crowding_lg_r < 128 }
		value = te_jmap_crowding_lg_r divide = 64 add = 5
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_crowding_lg_r < 256 }
		value = te_jmap_crowding_lg_r divide = 128 add = 6
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_crowding_lg_r < 512 }
		value = te_jmap_crowding_lg_r divide = 256 add = 7
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_crowding_lg_r < 1024 }
		value = te_jmap_crowding_lg_r divide = 512 add = 8
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_crowding_lg_r < 2048 }
		value = te_jmap_crowding_lg_r divide = 1024 add = 9
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_crowding_lg_r < 4096 }
		value = te_jmap_crowding_lg_r divide = 2048 add = 10
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_crowding_lg_r < 8192 }
		value = te_jmap_crowding_lg_r divide = 4096 add = 11
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_crowding_lg_r < 16384 }
		value = te_jmap_crowding_lg_r divide = 8192 add = 12
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_crowding_lg_r < 32768 }
		value = te_jmap_crowding_lg_r divide = 16384 add = 13
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_crowding_lg_r < 65536 }
		value = te_jmap_crowding_lg_r divide = 32768 add = 14
	}

		limit = { te_jmap_crowding_lg_r < 131072 }
		value = te_jmap_crowding_lg_r divide = 65536 add = 15
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_crowding_lg_r < 262144 }

	}

	}
	else = {
		value = te_jmap_crowding_lg_r divide = 1048576 add = 19
	}
}
te_jmap_crowding_lg_span_r = {
	value = 64
	if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_crowding_lo > te_jmap_crowding_lg_min }
		value = te_jmap_crowding_hi
		divide = te_jmap_crowding_lo
	}
}
te_jmap_crowding_lg_top = {
	if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_crowding_lg_span_r < 2 }
		value = te_jmap_crowding_lg_span_r subtract = 1
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_crowding_lg_span_r < 4 }
		value = te_jmap_crowding_lg_span_r divide = 2
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_crowding_lg_span_r < 8 }
		value = te_jmap_crowding_lg_span_r divide = 4 add = 1
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_crowding_lg_span_r < 16 }
		value = te_jmap_crowding_lg_span_r divide = 8 add = 2
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_crowding_lg_span_r < 32 }
		value = te_jmap_crowding_lg_span_r divide = 16 add = 3
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_crowding_lg_span_r < 64 }
		value = te_jmap_crowding_lg_span_r divide = 32 add = 4
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_crowding_lg_span_r < 128 }
		value = te_jmap_crowding_lg_span_r divide = 64 add = 5
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_crowding_lg_span_r < 256 }
		value = te_jmap_crowding_lg_span_r divide = 128 add = 6
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_crowding_lg_span_r < 512 }
		value = te_jmap_crowding_lg_span_r divide = 256 add = 7
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_crowding_lg_span_r < 1024 }
		value = te_jmap_crowding_lg_span_r divide = 512 add = 8
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_crowding_lg_span_r < 2048 }
		value = te_jmap_crowding_lg_span_r divide = 1024 add = 9
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_crowding_lg_span_r < 4096 }
		value = te_jmap_crowding_lg_span_r divide = 2048 add = 10
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_crowding_lg_span_r < 8192 }
		value = te_jmap_crowding_lg_span_r divide = 4096 add = 11
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_crowding_lg_span_r < 16384 }
		value = te_jmap_crowding_lg_span_r divide = 8192 add = 12
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_crowding_lg_span_r < 32768 }
		value = te_jmap_crowding_lg_span_r divide = 16384 add = 13
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_crowding_lg_span_r < 65536 }
		value = te_jmap_crowding_lg_span_r divide = 32768 add = 14
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_crowding_lg_span_r < 131072 }
		value = te_jmap_crowding_lg_span_r divide = 65536 add = 15
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_crowding_lg_span_r < 262144 }
		value = te_jmap_crowding_lg_span_r divide = 131072 add = 16
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_crowding_lg_span_r < 524288 }
		value = te_jmap_crowding_lg_span_r divide = 262144 add = 17
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_crowding_lg_span_r < 1048576 }
		value = te_jmap_crowding_lg_span_r divide = 524288 add = 18
	}
	else = {
		value = te_jmap_crowding_lg_span_r divide = 1048576 add = 19
	}
	min = 0.001
}
te_jmap_crowding_factor = {
	if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_scale = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { migration_crowding_pull_pct < te_jmap_crowding_k1 }
			value = migration_crowding_pull_pct subtract = te_jmap_crowding_lo divide = te_jmap_crowding_d0
		}
		else = {
			value = migration_crowding_pull_pct subtract = te_jmap_crowding_k1 divide = te_jmap_crowding_d1 add = 0.64286
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_scale = 1 }
		value = migration_crowding_pull_pct
		subtract = te_jmap_crowding_lo
		divide = te_jmap_crowding_span
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_scale = 2 }
		value = te_jmap_crowding_lg_t
		divide = te_jmap_crowding_lg_top
	}
	else = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = te_jmap_rank }
			value = var:te_jmap_rank
		}
	}
	min = 0
	max = 1
}

# City Rank, the world's 20 largest cities, by the Cities bonus tourism gives them (tourism_bonus_from_urban_centers): +5% at 20th to +100% at 1st. Fixed: the bonus is what it shows.
# Fixed. Knots: 0.05 -> 0, 1 -> 1.
te_jmap_city_top_factor = {
	value = tourism_bonus_from_urban_centers subtract = 0.05 divide = 0.95
	min = 0
	max = 1
}

# City Rank past 20th: the same share of the color for each doubling of the rank from 20th (the ranking stops at 501st). Fixed: a rank is already the state's place in the world.
# Fixed. Knots: 20 -> 0, 40 -> 0.2, 80 -> 0.4, 160 -> 0.6, 320 -> 0.8, 640 -> 1.
te_jmap_city_rest_factor = {
	if = {
		limit = { city_size_rank < 40 }
		value = city_size_rank subtract = 20 divide = 100
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { city_size_rank < 80 }
		value = city_size_rank subtract = 40 divide = 200 add = 0.2
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { city_size_rank < 160 }
		value = city_size_rank subtract = 80 divide = 400 add = 0.4
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { city_size_rank < 320 }
		value = city_size_rank subtract = 160 divide = 800 add = 0.6
	}
	else = {
		value = city_size_rank subtract = 320 divide = 1600 add = 0.8
	}
	min = 0
	max = 1
}

# Armed Forces, the state's Soldiers and Officers (the yearly walk's): the same share of the color for each doubling from the world's low (at least 100 people) to its high.
# A doubling at a time, fitted to the world; before the first measure, 500 to 64000.
te_jmap_soldiers_input = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_dg_soldiers }
		value = var:te_dg_soldiers
	}
}

	value = te_jmap_soldiers_input
	multiply = -1
}

	value = 500
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = te_jmap_rng_soldiers_lo }
		value = global_var:te_jmap_rng_soldiers_lo
	}
	min = 100
}
