	value = 64000
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = te_jmap_rng_soldiers_hi }
		value = global_var:te_jmap_rng_soldiers_hi
	}
	min = te_jmap_soldiers_hi_floor
}
te_jmap_soldiers_hi_floor = {
	value = te_jmap_soldiers_lo
	multiply = 4
}
te_jmap_soldiers_ratio = {
	value = var:te_dg_soldiers
	divide = te_jmap_soldiers_lo
}
te_jmap_soldiers_log = {
	if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_soldiers_ratio < 2 }
		value = te_jmap_soldiers_ratio subtract = 1
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_soldiers_ratio < 4 }
		value = te_jmap_soldiers_ratio divide = 2
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_soldiers_ratio < 8 }
		value = te_jmap_soldiers_ratio divide = 4 add = 1
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_soldiers_ratio < 16 }
		value = te_jmap_soldiers_ratio divide = 8 add = 2
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_soldiers_ratio < 32 }

	}

		limit = { te_jmap_soldiers_ratio < 64 }
		value = te_jmap_soldiers_ratio divide = 32 add = 4

te_jmap_soldiers_span = {
	value = te_jmap_soldiers_hi
	subtract = te_jmap_soldiers_lo
}
te_jmap_soldiers_factor = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_dg_soldiers }
		if = {
			limit = { te_jmap_scale = 0 }
			value = te_jmap_soldiers_log
			divide = te_jmap_soldiers_log_span
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { te_jmap_scale = 1 }
			value = var:te_dg_soldiers
			subtract = te_jmap_soldiers_lo
			divide = te_jmap_soldiers_span
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { te_jmap_scale = 2 }
			value = te_jmap_soldiers_log
			divide = te_jmap_soldiers_log_span
		}
		else = {
			value = 0
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = te_jmap_rank }
				value = var:te_jmap_rank
			}
		}
	}
	min = 0
	max = 1
}

# Company Headquarters, their weekly profit summed: the same share of the color for each doubling from the world's low (at least 1) to its high; a loss is red, apart from the scale.
# A doubling at a time, fitted to the world; before the first measure, 100 to 25600.
te_jmap_hq_input = {
	value = te_jmap_hq_profit
}

	value = te_jmap_hq_input
	multiply = -1
}

	value = 100
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = te_jmap_rng_hq_lo }

	min = 1

		limit = { te_jmap_war_dead_span_ratio < 262144 }
		value = te_jmap_war_dead_span_ratio divide = 131072 add = 16
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_war_dead_span_ratio < 524288 }
		value = te_jmap_war_dead_span_ratio divide = 262144 add = 17
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_war_dead_span_ratio < 1048576 }
		value = te_jmap_war_dead_span_ratio divide = 524288 add = 18
	}
	else = {
		value = te_jmap_war_dead_span_ratio divide = 1048576 add = 19
	}
	min = 1
}
te_jmap_war_dead_span = {
	value = te_jmap_war_dead_hi
	subtract = te_jmap_war_dead_lo
}
te_jmap_war_dead_factor = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_dg_dc_war }
		if = {
			limit = { te_jmap_scale = 0 }
			value = te_jmap_war_dead_log
			divide = te_jmap_war_dead_log_span
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { te_jmap_scale = 1 }
			value = var:te_dg_dc_war
			subtract = te_jmap_war_dead_lo
			divide = te_jmap_war_dead_span
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { te_jmap_scale = 2 }
			value = te_jmap_war_dead_log
			divide = te_jmap_war_dead_log_span
		}
		else = {
			value = 0
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = te_jmap_rank }
				value = var:te_jmap_rank
			}
		}
	}
	min = 0
	max = 1
}

# Ownership, the leading holder's share of the state's capital levels (private, their own workers', the state's), its color pale at 40% and full at 100%. Fixed: the map is categorical, and this only fades each holder's color, as the leading cause's.
# Fixed. Knots: 0.4 -> 0, 1 -> 1.
te_jmap_own_factor = {
	value = te_jmap_own_lead_share subtract = 0.4 divide = 0.6
	min = 0
	max = 1
}

# Population Growth, the change in people from one yearly walk to the next per 1,000, split at none; war, famine and land changing hands run far out.
# Fitted to the world on each side of 0; before the first measure, -80 to 100.
te_jmap_growth_input = {
	value = te_jmap_pop_growth
}
te_jmap_growth_input_neg = {
	value = te_jmap_growth_input
	multiply = -1
}
te_jmap_growth_lo = {
	value = -80
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = te_jmap_rng_growth_lo }
		value = global_var:te_jmap_rng_growth_lo
	}
}
te_jmap_growth_hi = {
	value = 100
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = te_jmap_rng_growth_hi }
		value = global_var:te_jmap_rng_growth_hi
	}
	min = te_jmap_growth_hi_floor
}
te_jmap_growth_hi_floor = {
	value = te_jmap_growth_lo
	add = 5
}
te_jmap_growth_b = {
	value = te_jmap_growth_hi
	max = 0
}
te_jmap_growth_a = {
	value = te_jmap_growth_lo
	min = 0
}
te_jmap_growth_span_low = {
	value = te_jmap_growth_b
	subtract = te_jmap_growth_lo
	min = 5
}
te_jmap_growth_span_up = {
	value = te_jmap_growth_hi
	subtract = te_jmap_growth_a
	min = 5
}

		limit = { te_jmap_growth_sl_up_span_r < 2 }
		value = te_jmap_growth_sl_up_span_r subtract = 1
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_growth_sl_up_span_r < 4 }

	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_growth_sl_up_span_r < 8 }
		value = te_jmap_growth_sl_up_span_r divide = 4 add = 1
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_growth_sl_up_span_r < 16 }

	}

	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_growth_sl_up_span_r < 64 }
		value = te_jmap_growth_sl_up_span_r divide = 32 add = 4
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_growth_sl_up_span_r < 128 }
		value = te_jmap_growth_sl_up_span_r divide = 64 add = 5
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_growth_sl_up_span_r < 256 }

	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_growth_sl_up_span_r < 512 }
		value = te_jmap_growth_sl_up_span_r divide = 256 add = 7

	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_growth_sl_up_span_r < 1024 }
		value = te_jmap_growth_sl_up_span_r divide = 512 add = 8
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_growth_sl_up_span_r < 2048 }
		value = te_jmap_growth_sl_up_span_r divide = 1024 add = 9
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_growth_sl_up_span_r < 4096 }
		value = te_jmap_growth_sl_up_span_r divide = 2048 add = 10
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_growth_sl_up_span_r < 8192 }
		value = te_jmap_growth_sl_up_span_r divide = 4096 add = 11
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_growth_sl_up_span_r < 16384 }
		value = te_jmap_growth_sl_up_span_r divide = 8192 add = 12
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_growth_sl_up_span_r < 32768 }
		value = te_jmap_growth_sl_up_span_r divide = 16384 add = 13
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_growth_sl_up_span_r < 65536 }
		value = te_jmap_growth_sl_up_span_r divide = 32768 add = 14
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_growth_sl_up_span_r < 131072 }
		value = te_jmap_growth_sl_up_span_r divide = 65536 add = 15
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_growth_sl_up_span_r < 262144 }
		value = te_jmap_growth_sl_up_span_r divide = 131072 add = 16
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_growth_sl_up_span_r < 524288 }
		value = te_jmap_growth_sl_up_span_r divide = 262144 add = 17
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_growth_sl_up_span_r < 1048576 }
		value = te_jmap_growth_sl_up_span_r divide = 524288 add = 18
	}
	else = {
		value = te_jmap_growth_sl_up_span_r divide = 1048576 add = 19
	}
	add = 1
	min = 1
}
te_jmap_growth_factor = {
	if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_scale = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { te_jmap_pop_growth < 0 }
			if = {
				limit = { te_jmap_pop_growth > te_jmap_growth_l_k1 }
				value = te_jmap_pop_growth subtract = te_jmap_growth_b divide = te_jmap_growth_l_d0 add = 0.5
			}
			else = {
				value = te_jmap_pop_growth subtract = te_jmap_growth_l_k1 divide = te_jmap_growth_l_d1 add = 0.21429
			}
			max = 0.5
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = { te_jmap_pop_growth < te_jmap_growth_u_k1 }
				value = te_jmap_pop_growth subtract = te_jmap_growth_a divide = te_jmap_growth_u_d0 add = 0.5
			}
			else = {
				value = te_jmap_pop_growth subtract = te_jmap_growth_u_k1 divide = te_jmap_growth_u_d1 add = 0.86364
			}
			min = 0.5
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_scale = 1 }
		if = {
			limit = { te_jmap_pop_growth < 0 }
			value = te_jmap_growth_b
			subtract = te_jmap_pop_growth
			divide = te_jmap_growth_span_low
			multiply = -0.5
			add = 0.5
			max = 0.5
		}
		else = {
			value = te_jmap_pop_growth
			subtract = te_jmap_growth_a
			divide = te_jmap_growth_span_up
			multiply = 0.5
			add = 0.5
			min = 0.5
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_scale = 2 }
		if = {
			limit = { te_jmap_pop_growth < 0 }
			value = te_jmap_growth_sl_low_t
			divide = te_jmap_growth_sl_low_top
			multiply = -0.5
			add = 0.5
			max = 0.5
		}
		else = {
			value = te_jmap_growth_sl_up_t
			divide = te_jmap_growth_sl_up_top
			multiply = 0.5
			add = 0.5
			min = 0.5
		}
	}
	else = {
		value = 0.5
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = te_jmap_rank }
			value = var:te_jmap_rank
		}
	}
	min = 0
	max = 1
}
te_jmap_growth_factor_lower = {
	value = te_jmap_growth_factor
	multiply = 2
	min = 0
	max = 1
}
te_jmap_growth_factor_upper = {
	value = te_jmap_growth_factor
	multiply = 2
	subtract = 1
	min = 0
	max = 1
}

# Family Planning, the census's means to plan a family, 0-1: the share of the gap to the family size people want that they can close.
# Fitted to the world; before the first measure, 0 to 1.
te_jmap_means_input = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_dg_means }
		value = var:te_dg_means
	}
}
te_jmap_means_input_neg = {
	value = te_jmap_means_input
	multiply = -1
}
te_jmap_means_lo = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = te_jmap_rng_means_lo }
		value = global_var:te_jmap_rng_means_lo
	}
}
te_jmap_means_hi = {
	value = 1
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = te_jmap_rng_means_hi }
		value = global_var:te_jmap_rng_means_hi
	}
	min = te_jmap_means_hi_floor
}
te_jmap_means_hi_floor = {
	value = te_jmap_means_lo
	add = 0.1
}
te_jmap_means_span = {
	value = te_jmap_means_hi
	subtract = te_jmap_means_lo
}
te_jmap_means_d0 = {
	value = te_jmap_means_span
	multiply = 1
}
te_jmap_means_lg_min = {
	value = te_jmap_means_hi
	divide = 64
}
te_jmap_means_lg_r = {
	value = var:te_dg_means
	multiply = 64
	divide = te_jmap_means_hi
	if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_means_lo > te_jmap_means_lg_min }
		value = var:te_dg_means
		divide = te_jmap_means_lo
	}
}
te_jmap_means_lg_t = {
	if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_means_lg_r < 2 }
		value = te_jmap_means_lg_r subtract = 1
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_means_lg_r < 4 }
		value = te_jmap_means_lg_r divide = 2
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_means_lg_r < 8 }
		value = te_jmap_means_lg_r divide = 4 add = 1
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_means_lg_r < 16 }
		value = te_jmap_means_lg_r divide = 8 add = 2
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_means_lg_r < 32 }
		value = te_jmap_means_lg_r divide = 16 add = 3
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_means_lg_r < 64 }
		value = te_jmap_means_lg_r divide = 32 add = 4
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_means_lg_r < 128 }
		value = te_jmap_means_lg_r divide = 64 add = 5
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_means_lg_r < 256 }
		value = te_jmap_means_lg_r divide = 128 add = 6
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_means_lg_r < 512 }
		value = te_jmap_means_lg_r divide = 256 add = 7
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_means_lg_r < 1024 }
		value = te_jmap_means_lg_r divide = 512 add = 8
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_means_lg_r < 2048 }
		value = te_jmap_means_lg_r divide = 1024 add = 9
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_means_lg_r < 4096 }
		value = te_jmap_means_lg_r divide = 2048 add = 10
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_means_lg_r < 8192 }
		value = te_jmap_means_lg_r divide = 4096 add = 11
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_means_lg_r < 16384 }
		value = te_jmap_means_lg_r divide = 8192 add = 12
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_means_lg_r < 32768 }
		value = te_jmap_means_lg_r divide = 16384 add = 13
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_means_lg_r < 65536 }
		value = te_jmap_means_lg_r divide = 32768 add = 14
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_means_lg_r < 131072 }
		value = te_jmap_means_lg_r divide = 65536 add = 15
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_means_lg_r < 262144 }
		value = te_jmap_means_lg_r divide = 131072 add = 16
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_means_lg_r < 524288 }
		value = te_jmap_means_lg_r divide = 262144 add = 17
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_means_lg_r < 1048576 }
		value = te_jmap_means_lg_r divide = 524288 add = 18
	}
	else = {
		value = te_jmap_means_lg_r divide = 1048576 add = 19
	}
}
te_jmap_means_lg_span_r = {
	value = 64
	if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_means_lo > te_jmap_means_lg_min }
		value = te_jmap_means_hi
		divide = te_jmap_means_lo
	}
}
te_jmap_means_lg_top = {
	if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_means_lg_span_r < 2 }
		value = te_jmap_means_lg_span_r subtract = 1
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_means_lg_span_r < 4 }
		value = te_jmap_means_lg_span_r divide = 2
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_means_lg_span_r < 8 }
		value = te_jmap_means_lg_span_r divide = 4 add = 1
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_means_lg_span_r < 16 }
		value = te_jmap_means_lg_span_r divide = 8 add = 2
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_means_lg_span_r < 32 }
		value = te_jmap_means_lg_span_r divide = 16 add = 3
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_means_lg_span_r < 64 }
		value = te_jmap_means_lg_span_r divide = 32 add = 4
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_means_lg_span_r < 128 }
		value = te_jmap_means_lg_span_r divide = 64 add = 5
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_means_lg_span_r < 256 }
		value = te_jmap_means_lg_span_r divide = 128 add = 6
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_means_lg_span_r < 512 }
		value = te_jmap_means_lg_span_r divide = 256 add = 7
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_means_lg_span_r < 1024 }
		value = te_jmap_means_lg_span_r divide = 512 add = 8
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_means_lg_span_r < 2048 }
		value = te_jmap_means_lg_span_r divide = 1024 add = 9
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_means_lg_span_r < 4096 }
		value = te_jmap_means_lg_span_r divide = 2048 add = 10
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_means_lg_span_r < 8192 }
		value = te_jmap_means_lg_span_r divide = 4096 add = 11
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_means_lg_span_r < 16384 }
		value = te_jmap_means_lg_span_r divide = 8192 add = 12
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_means_lg_span_r < 32768 }
		value = te_jmap_means_lg_span_r divide = 16384 add = 13
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_means_lg_span_r < 65536 }
		value = te_jmap_means_lg_span_r divide = 32768 add = 14
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_means_lg_span_r < 131072 }
		value = te_jmap_means_lg_span_r divide = 65536 add = 15
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_means_lg_span_r < 262144 }
		value = te_jmap_means_lg_span_r divide = 131072 add = 16
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_means_lg_span_r < 524288 }
		value = te_jmap_means_lg_span_r divide = 262144 add = 17
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_means_lg_span_r < 1048576 }
		value = te_jmap_means_lg_span_r divide = 524288 add = 18
	}
	else = {
		value = te_jmap_means_lg_span_r divide = 1048576 add = 19
	}
	min = 0.001
}
te_jmap_means_factor = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_dg_means }
		if = {
			limit = { te_jmap_scale = 0 }
			value = var:te_dg_means subtract = te_jmap_means_lo divide = te_jmap_means_d0
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { te_jmap_scale = 1 }
			value = var:te_dg_means
			subtract = te_jmap_means_lo
			divide = te_jmap_means_span
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { te_jmap_scale = 2 }
			value = te_jmap_means_lg_t
			divide = te_jmap_means_lg_top
		}
		else = {
			value = 0
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = te_jmap_rank }
				value = var:te_jmap_rank
			}
		}
	}
	min = 0
	max = 1
}

# Health Care, the census's health-care access, the share of the people medicine reaches (0.4 from markets and charity everywhere, to 1).

		limit = { has_variable = te_dg_acc }
		value = var:te_dg_acc
	}

	multiply = -1

	}
}
te_jmap_fam_lg_span_r = {
	value = 64
	if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_fam_lo > te_jmap_fam_lg_min }
		value = te_jmap_fam_hi
		divide = te_jmap_fam_lo
	}
}
te_jmap_fam_lg_top = {
	if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_fam_lg_span_r < 2 }
		value = te_jmap_fam_lg_span_r subtract = 1
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_fam_lg_span_r < 4 }
		value = te_jmap_fam_lg_span_r divide = 2
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_fam_lg_span_r < 8 }
		value = te_jmap_fam_lg_span_r divide = 4 add = 1
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_fam_lg_span_r < 16 }
		value = te_jmap_fam_lg_span_r divide = 8 add = 2
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_fam_lg_span_r < 32 }
		value = te_jmap_fam_lg_span_r divide = 16 add = 3
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_fam_lg_span_r < 64 }
		value = te_jmap_fam_lg_span_r divide = 32 add = 4
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_fam_lg_span_r < 128 }
		value = te_jmap_fam_lg_span_r divide = 64 add = 5
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_fam_lg_span_r < 256 }
		value = te_jmap_fam_lg_span_r divide = 128 add = 6
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_fam_lg_span_r < 512 }
		value = te_jmap_fam_lg_span_r divide = 256 add = 7
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_fam_lg_span_r < 1024 }
		value = te_jmap_fam_lg_span_r divide = 512 add = 8
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_fam_lg_span_r < 2048 }
		value = te_jmap_fam_lg_span_r divide = 1024 add = 9
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_fam_lg_span_r < 4096 }
		value = te_jmap_fam_lg_span_r divide = 2048 add = 10
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_fam_lg_span_r < 8192 }
		value = te_jmap_fam_lg_span_r divide = 4096 add = 11
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_fam_lg_span_r < 16384 }
		value = te_jmap_fam_lg_span_r divide = 8192 add = 12
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_fam_lg_span_r < 32768 }
		value = te_jmap_fam_lg_span_r divide = 16384 add = 13
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_fam_lg_span_r < 65536 }
		value = te_jmap_fam_lg_span_r divide = 32768 add = 14
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_fam_lg_span_r < 131072 }
		value = te_jmap_fam_lg_span_r divide = 65536 add = 15
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_fam_lg_span_r < 262144 }
		value = te_jmap_fam_lg_span_r divide = 131072 add = 16
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_fam_lg_span_r < 524288 }
		value = te_jmap_fam_lg_span_r divide = 262144 add = 17
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_fam_lg_span_r < 1048576 }
		value = te_jmap_fam_lg_span_r divide = 524288 add = 18
	}
	else = {
		value = te_jmap_fam_lg_span_r divide = 1048576 add = 19
	}
	min = 0.001
}
te_jmap_fam_factor = {
	if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_scale = 0 }
		value = te_demog_fam_share subtract = te_jmap_fam_lo divide = te_jmap_fam_d0
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_scale = 1 }
		value = te_demog_fam_share
		subtract = te_jmap_fam_lo
		divide = te_jmap_fam_span
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_scale = 2 }
		value = te_jmap_fam_lg_t
		divide = te_jmap_fam_lg_top
	}
	else = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = te_jmap_rank }
			value = var:te_jmap_rank
		}
	}
	min = 0
	max = 1
}

		limit = { te_jmap_density_ratio < 16 }
		value = te_jmap_density_ratio divide = 8 add = 2
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_density_ratio < 32 }
		value = te_jmap_density_ratio divide = 16 add = 3
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_density_ratio < 64 }
		value = te_jmap_density_ratio divide = 32 add = 4
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_density_ratio < 128 }
		value = te_jmap_density_ratio divide = 64 add = 5
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_density_ratio < 256 }
		value = te_jmap_density_ratio divide = 128 add = 6
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_density_ratio < 512 }
		value = te_jmap_density_ratio divide = 256 add = 7
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_density_ratio < 1024 }
		value = te_jmap_density_ratio divide = 512 add = 8
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_density_ratio < 2048 }
		value = te_jmap_density_ratio divide = 1024 add = 9
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_density_ratio < 4096 }
		value = te_jmap_density_ratio divide = 2048 add = 10
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_density_ratio < 8192 }
		value = te_jmap_density_ratio divide = 4096 add = 11
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_density_ratio < 16384 }
		value = te_jmap_density_ratio divide = 8192 add = 12
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_density_ratio < 32768 }
		value = te_jmap_density_ratio divide = 16384 add = 13
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_density_ratio < 65536 }
		value = te_jmap_density_ratio divide = 32768 add = 14
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_density_ratio < 131072 }
		value = te_jmap_density_ratio divide = 65536 add = 15
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_density_ratio < 262144 }
		value = te_jmap_density_ratio divide = 131072 add = 16
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_density_ratio < 524288 }
		value = te_jmap_density_ratio divide = 262144 add = 17
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_density_ratio < 1048576 }
		value = te_jmap_density_ratio divide = 524288 add = 18
	}
	else = {
		value = te_jmap_density_ratio divide = 1048576 add = 19
	}
}
te_jmap_density_span_ratio = {
	value = te_jmap_density_hi
	divide = te_jmap_density_lo
}
te_jmap_density_log_span = {
	if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_density_span_ratio < 2 }
		value = te_jmap_density_span_ratio subtract = 1
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_density_span_ratio < 4 }
		value = te_jmap_density_span_ratio divide = 2
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_density_span_ratio < 8 }
		value = te_jmap_density_span_ratio divide = 4 add = 1
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_density_span_ratio < 16 }
		value = te_jmap_density_span_ratio divide = 8 add = 2
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_density_span_ratio < 32 }
		value = te_jmap_density_span_ratio divide = 16 add = 3
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_density_span_ratio < 64 }
		value = te_jmap_density_span_ratio divide = 32 add = 4
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_density_span_ratio < 128 }
		value = te_jmap_density_span_ratio divide = 64 add = 5
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_density_span_ratio < 256 }
		value = te_jmap_density_span_ratio divide = 128 add = 6
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_density_span_ratio < 512 }
		value = te_jmap_density_span_ratio divide = 256 add = 7
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_density_span_ratio < 1024 }
		value = te_jmap_density_span_ratio divide = 512 add = 8
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_density_span_ratio < 2048 }
		value = te_jmap_density_span_ratio divide = 1024 add = 9
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_density_span_ratio < 4096 }
		value = te_jmap_density_span_ratio divide = 2048 add = 10
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_density_span_ratio < 8192 }
		value = te_jmap_density_span_ratio divide = 4096 add = 11
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_density_span_ratio < 16384 }
		value = te_jmap_density_span_ratio divide = 8192 add = 12
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_density_span_ratio < 32768 }
		value = te_jmap_density_span_ratio divide = 16384 add = 13
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_density_span_ratio < 65536 }
		value = te_jmap_density_span_ratio divide = 32768 add = 14
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_density_span_ratio < 131072 }
		value = te_jmap_density_span_ratio divide = 65536 add = 15
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_density_span_ratio < 262144 }
		value = te_jmap_density_span_ratio divide = 131072 add = 16
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_density_span_ratio < 524288 }
		value = te_jmap_density_span_ratio divide = 262144 add = 17
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_density_span_ratio < 1048576 }
		value = te_jmap_density_span_ratio divide = 524288 add = 18
	}
	else = {
		value = te_jmap_density_span_ratio divide = 1048576 add = 19
	}
	min = 1
}
te_jmap_density_span = {
	value = te_jmap_density_hi
	subtract = te_jmap_density_lo
}
te_jmap_density_factor = {
	if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_scale = 0 }
		value = te_jmap_density_log
		divide = te_jmap_density_log_span
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_scale = 1 }
		value = te_jmap_density
		subtract = te_jmap_density_lo
		divide = te_jmap_density_span
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_scale = 2 }
		value = te_jmap_density_log
		divide = te_jmap_density_log_span
	}
	else = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = te_jmap_rank }
			value = var:te_jmap_rank
		}
	}
	min = 0
	max = 1
}

# Standard of Living, the state's people's mean at the yearly walk.
# Fitted to the world; before the first measure, 5 to 25.
te_jmap_sol_input = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_dg_sol }
		value = var:te_dg_sol
	}
}
te_jmap_sol_input_neg = {
	value = te_jmap_sol_input
	multiply = -1
}
te_jmap_sol_lo = {
	value = 5
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = te_jmap_rng_sol_lo }
		value = global_var:te_jmap_rng_sol_lo
	}
}
te_jmap_sol_hi = {
	value = 25
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = te_jmap_rng_sol_hi }
		value = global_var:te_jmap_rng_sol_hi
	}
	min = te_jmap_sol_hi_floor
}
te_jmap_sol_hi_floor = {
	value = te_jmap_sol_lo
	add = 2
}
te_jmap_sol_span = {
	value = te_jmap_sol_hi
	subtract = te_jmap_sol_lo
}
te_jmap_sol_d0 = {
	value = te_jmap_sol_span
	multiply = 1
}
te_jmap_sol_lg_min = {
	value = te_jmap_sol_hi
	divide = 64
}
te_jmap_sol_lg_r = {
	value = var:te_dg_sol
	multiply = 64
	divide = te_jmap_sol_hi
	if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_sol_lo > te_jmap_sol_lg_min }
		value = var:te_dg_sol
		divide = te_jmap_sol_lo
	}
}
te_jmap_sol_lg_t = {
	if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_sol_lg_r < 2 }
		value = te_jmap_sol_lg_r subtract = 1
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_sol_lg_r < 4 }
		value = te_jmap_sol_lg_r divide = 2
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_sol_lg_r < 8 }
		value = te_jmap_sol_lg_r divide = 4 add = 1
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_sol_lg_r < 16 }
		value = te_jmap_sol_lg_r divide = 8 add = 2
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_sol_lg_r < 32 }
		value = te_jmap_sol_lg_r divide = 16 add = 3
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_sol_lg_r < 64 }
		value = te_jmap_sol_lg_r divide = 32 add = 4
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_sol_lg_r < 128 }
		value = te_jmap_sol_lg_r divide = 64 add = 5
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_sol_lg_r < 256 }
		value = te_jmap_sol_lg_r divide = 128 add = 6
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_sol_lg_r < 512 }
		value = te_jmap_sol_lg_r divide = 256 add = 7
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_sol_lg_r < 1024 }
		value = te_jmap_sol_lg_r divide = 512 add = 8
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_sol_lg_r < 2048 }
		value = te_jmap_sol_lg_r divide = 1024 add = 9
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_sol_lg_r < 4096 }
		value = te_jmap_sol_lg_r divide = 2048 add = 10
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_sol_lg_r < 8192 }
		value = te_jmap_sol_lg_r divide = 4096 add = 11
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_sol_lg_r < 16384 }
		value = te_jmap_sol_lg_r divide = 8192 add = 12
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_sol_lg_r < 32768 }
		value = te_jmap_sol_lg_r divide = 16384 add = 13
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_sol_lg_r < 65536 }
		value = te_jmap_sol_lg_r divide = 32768 add = 14
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_sol_lg_r < 131072 }
		value = te_jmap_sol_lg_r divide = 65536 add = 15
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_sol_lg_r < 262144 }
		value = te_jmap_sol_lg_r divide = 131072 add = 16
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_sol_lg_r < 524288 }
		value = te_jmap_sol_lg_r divide = 262144 add = 17
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_sol_lg_r < 1048576 }
		value = te_jmap_sol_lg_r divide = 524288 add = 18
	}
	else = {
		value = te_jmap_sol_lg_r divide = 1048576 add = 19
	}
}
te_jmap_sol_lg_span_r = {
	value = 64
	if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_sol_lo > te_jmap_sol_lg_min }
		value = te_jmap_sol_hi
		divide = te_jmap_sol_lo
	}
}
te_jmap_sol_lg_top = {
	if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_sol_lg_span_r < 2 }
		value = te_jmap_sol_lg_span_r subtract = 1
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_sol_lg_span_r < 4 }
		value = te_jmap_sol_lg_span_r divide = 2
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_sol_lg_span_r < 8 }
		value = te_jmap_sol_lg_span_r divide = 4 add = 1
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_sol_lg_span_r < 16 }
		value = te_jmap_sol_lg_span_r divide = 8 add = 2
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_sol_lg_span_r < 32 }
		value = te_jmap_sol_lg_span_r divide = 16 add = 3
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_sol_lg_span_r < 64 }
		value = te_jmap_sol_lg_span_r divide = 32 add = 4
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_sol_lg_span_r < 128 }
		value = te_jmap_sol_lg_span_r divide = 64 add = 5
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_sol_lg_span_r < 256 }
		value = te_jmap_sol_lg_span_r divide = 128 add = 6
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_sol_lg_span_r < 512 }
		value = te_jmap_sol_lg_span_r divide = 256 add = 7
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_sol_lg_span_r < 1024 }
		value = te_jmap_sol_lg_span_r divide = 512 add = 8
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_sol_lg_span_r < 2048 }
		value = te_jmap_sol_lg_span_r divide = 1024 add = 9
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_sol_lg_span_r < 4096 }
		value = te_jmap_sol_lg_span_r divide = 2048 add = 10
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_sol_lg_span_r < 8192 }
		value = te_jmap_sol_lg_span_r divide = 4096 add = 11
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_sol_lg_span_r < 16384 }
		value = te_jmap_sol_lg_span_r divide = 8192 add = 12
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_sol_lg_span_r < 32768 }
		value = te_jmap_sol_lg_span_r divide = 16384 add = 13
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_sol_lg_span_r < 65536 }
		value = te_jmap_sol_lg_span_r divide = 32768 add = 14
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_sol_lg_span_r < 131072 }
		value = te_jmap_sol_lg_span_r divide = 65536 add = 15
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_sol_lg_span_r < 262144 }
		value = te_jmap_sol_lg_span_r divide = 131072 add = 16
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_sol_lg_span_r < 524288 }
		value = te_jmap_sol_lg_span_r divide = 262144 add = 17
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_sol_lg_span_r < 1048576 }
		value = te_jmap_sol_lg_span_r divide = 524288 add = 18
	}
	else = {
		value = te_jmap_sol_lg_span_r divide = 1048576 add = 19
	}
	min = 0.001
}
te_jmap_sol_factor = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_dg_sol }
		if = {
			limit = { te_jmap_scale = 0 }
			value = var:te_dg_sol subtract = te_jmap_sol_lo divide = te_jmap_sol_d0
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { te_jmap_scale = 1 }
			value = var:te_dg_sol
			subtract = te_jmap_sol_lo
			divide = te_jmap_sol_span
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { te_jmap_scale = 2 }
			value = te_jmap_sol_lg_t
			divide = te_jmap_sol_lg_top
		}
		else = {
			value = 0
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = te_jmap_rank }
				value = var:te_jmap_rank
			}
		}
	}
	min = 0
	max = 1
}

	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_wealth_lg_span_r < 2048 }
		value = te_jmap_wealth_lg_span_r divide = 1024 add = 9
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_wealth_lg_span_r < 4096 }
		value = te_jmap_wealth_lg_span_r divide = 2048 add = 10
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_wealth_lg_span_r < 8192 }
		value = te_jmap_wealth_lg_span_r divide = 4096 add = 11
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_wealth_lg_span_r < 16384 }
		value = te_jmap_wealth_lg_span_r divide = 8192 add = 12
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_wealth_lg_span_r < 32768 }
		value = te_jmap_wealth_lg_span_r divide = 16384 add = 13
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_wealth_lg_span_r < 65536 }
		value = te_jmap_wealth_lg_span_r divide = 32768 add = 14
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_wealth_lg_span_r < 131072 }
		value = te_jmap_wealth_lg_span_r divide = 65536 add = 15
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_wealth_lg_span_r < 262144 }
		value = te_jmap_wealth_lg_span_r divide = 131072 add = 16
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_wealth_lg_span_r < 524288 }
		value = te_jmap_wealth_lg_span_r divide = 262144 add = 17
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_wealth_lg_span_r < 1048576 }
		value = te_jmap_wealth_lg_span_r divide = 524288 add = 18
	}
	else = {
		value = te_jmap_wealth_lg_span_r divide = 1048576 add = 19
	}
	min = 0.001
}
te_jmap_wealth_factor = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_dg_wealth }
		if = {
			limit = { te_jmap_scale = 0 }
			value = var:te_dg_wealth subtract = te_jmap_wealth_lo divide = te_jmap_wealth_d0
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { te_jmap_scale = 1 }
			value = var:te_dg_wealth
			subtract = te_jmap_wealth_lo
			divide = te_jmap_wealth_span
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { te_jmap_scale = 2 }
			value = te_jmap_wealth_lg_t
			divide = te_jmap_wealth_lg_top
		}
		else = {
			value = 0
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = te_jmap_rank }
				value = var:te_jmap_rank
			}
		}
	}
	min = 0
	max = 1
}

# Standard of Living less Wealth, the yearly walk's, split at none.
# Fitted to the world on each side of 0; before the first measure, -5 to 5.
te_jmap_sol_wealth_input = {
	value = te_jmap_sol_wealth
}
te_jmap_sol_wealth_input_neg = {
	value = te_jmap_sol_wealth_input
	multiply = -1
}
te_jmap_sol_wealth_lo = {
	value = -5
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = te_jmap_rng_sol_wealth_lo }
		value = global_var:te_jmap_rng_sol_wealth_lo
	}
}
te_jmap_sol_wealth_hi = {
	value = 5
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = te_jmap_rng_sol_wealth_hi }
		value = global_var:te_jmap_rng_sol_wealth_hi
	}
	min = te_jmap_sol_wealth_hi_floor
}
te_jmap_sol_wealth_hi_floor = {
	value = te_jmap_sol_wealth_lo
	add = 1
}
te_jmap_sol_wealth_b = {
	value = te_jmap_sol_wealth_hi
	max = 0
}
te_jmap_sol_wealth_a = {
	value = te_jmap_sol_wealth_lo
	min = 0
}
te_jmap_sol_wealth_span_low = {
	value = te_jmap_sol_wealth_b
	subtract = te_jmap_sol_wealth_lo
	min = 1
}
te_jmap_sol_wealth_span_up = {
	value = te_jmap_sol_wealth_hi
	subtract = te_jmap_sol_wealth_a
	min = 1
}
te_jmap_sol_wealth_l_d0 = {
	value = te_jmap_sol_wealth_span_low
	multiply = 2
}
te_jmap_sol_wealth_u_d0 = {
	value = te_jmap_sol_wealth_span_up
	multiply = 2
}
te_jmap_sol_wealth_sl_low_r = {
	value = te_jmap_sol_wealth_b
	subtract = te_jmap_sol_wealth
	divide = 0.5
}
te_jmap_sol_wealth_sl_low_t = {

		limit = { te_jmap_sol_wealth_sl_low_r < 2 }
		value = te_jmap_sol_wealth_sl_low_r subtract = 1
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_sol_wealth_sl_low_r < 4 }
		value = te_jmap_sol_wealth_sl_low_r divide = 2
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_sol_wealth_sl_low_r < 8 }
		value = te_jmap_sol_wealth_sl_low_r divide = 4 add = 1
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_sol_wealth_sl_low_r < 16 }
		value = te_jmap_sol_wealth_sl_low_r divide = 8 add = 2
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_sol_wealth_sl_low_r < 32 }
		value = te_jmap_sol_wealth_sl_low_r divide = 16 add = 3
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_sol_wealth_sl_low_r < 64 }
		value = te_jmap_sol_wealth_sl_low_r divide = 32 add = 4
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_sol_wealth_sl_low_r < 128 }

	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_sol_wealth_sl_low_r < 256 }
		value = te_jmap_sol_wealth_sl_low_r divide = 128 add = 6
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_sol_wealth_sl_low_r < 512 }
		value = te_jmap_sol_wealth_sl_low_r divide = 256 add = 7
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_sol_wealth_sl_low_r < 1024 }
		value = te_jmap_sol_wealth_sl_low_r divide = 512 add = 8
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_sol_wealth_sl_low_r < 2048 }
		value = te_jmap_sol_wealth_sl_low_r divide = 1024 add = 9
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_sol_wealth_sl_low_r < 4096 }
		value = te_jmap_sol_wealth_sl_low_r divide = 2048 add = 10
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_sol_wealth_sl_low_r < 8192 }
		value = te_jmap_sol_wealth_sl_low_r divide = 4096 add = 11
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_sol_wealth_sl_low_r < 16384 }
		value = te_jmap_sol_wealth_sl_low_r divide = 8192 add = 12
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_sol_wealth_sl_low_r < 32768 }

	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_sol_wealth_sl_low_r < 65536 }

	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_sol_wealth_sl_low_r < 131072 }
		value = te_jmap_sol_wealth_sl_low_r divide = 65536 add = 15
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_sol_wealth_sl_low_r < 262144 }
		value = te_jmap_sol_wealth_sl_low_r divide = 131072 add = 16
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_sol_wealth_sl_low_r < 524288 }
		value = te_jmap_sol_wealth_sl_low_r divide = 262144 add = 17
	}
	else_if = {

	}
	else = {

	}

te_jmap_sol_wealth_factor = {
	if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_scale = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { te_jmap_sol_wealth < 0 }
			value = te_jmap_sol_wealth subtract = te_jmap_sol_wealth_b divide = te_jmap_sol_wealth_l_d0 add = 0.5
			max = 0.5
		}
		else = {
			value = te_jmap_sol_wealth subtract = te_jmap_sol_wealth_a divide = te_jmap_sol_wealth_u_d0 add = 0.5
			min = 0.5
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_scale = 1 }
		if = {
			limit = { te_jmap_sol_wealth < 0 }
			value = te_jmap_sol_wealth_b
			subtract = te_jmap_sol_wealth
			divide = te_jmap_sol_wealth_span_low
			multiply = -0.5
			add = 0.5
			max = 0.5
		}
		else = {
			value = te_jmap_sol_wealth
			subtract = te_jmap_sol_wealth_a
			divide = te_jmap_sol_wealth_span_up
			multiply = 0.5
			add = 0.5
			min = 0.5
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_scale = 2 }
		if = {
			limit = { te_jmap_sol_wealth < 0 }
			value = te_jmap_sol_wealth_sl_low_t
			divide = te_jmap_sol_wealth_sl_low_top
			multiply = -0.5
			add = 0.5
			max = 0.5
		}
		else = {
			value = te_jmap_sol_wealth_sl_up_t
			divide = te_jmap_sol_wealth_sl_up_top
			multiply = 0.5
			add = 0.5
			min = 0.5
		}
	}
	else = {
		value = 0.5
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = te_jmap_rank }
			value = var:te_jmap_rank
		}
	}
	min = 0
	max = 1
}
te_jmap_sol_wealth_factor_lower = {
	value = te_jmap_sol_wealth_factor
	multiply = 2
	min = 0
	max = 1
}
te_jmap_sol_wealth_factor_upper = {
	value = te_jmap_sol_wealth_factor
	multiply = 2
	subtract = 1
	min = 0
	max = 1
}

# Standard of Living against the expected one, live (average_sol less average_expected_sol), split at none.
# Fitted to the world on each side of 0; before the first measure, -5 to 5.
te_jmap_sol_expected_input = {
	value = te_jmap_sol_expected
}
te_jmap_sol_expected_input_neg = {
	value = te_jmap_sol_expected_input
	multiply = -1
}

	value = -5
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = te_jmap_rng_sol_expected_lo }
		value = global_var:te_jmap_rng_sol_expected_lo
	}
}
te_jmap_sol_expected_hi = {
	value = 5
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = te_jmap_rng_sol_expected_hi }
		value = global_var:te_jmap_rng_sol_expected_hi
	}
	min = te_jmap_sol_expected_hi_floor
}

	value = te_jmap_sol_expected_lo
	add = 1
}

	value = te_jmap_sol_expected_hi
	max = 0
}

	value = te_jmap_sol_expected_lo
	min = 0
}

te_jmap_sol_expected_factor = {
	if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_scale = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { te_jmap_sol_expected < 0 }
			value = te_jmap_sol_expected subtract = te_jmap_sol_expected_b divide = te_jmap_sol_expected_l_d0 add = 0.5
			max = 0.5
		}
		else = {
			value = te_jmap_sol_expected subtract = te_jmap_sol_expected_a divide = te_jmap_sol_expected_u_d0 add = 0.5
			min = 0.5
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_scale = 1 }
		if = {
			limit = { te_jmap_sol_expected < 0 }
			value = te_jmap_sol_expected_b
			subtract = te_jmap_sol_expected
			divide = te_jmap_sol_expected_span_low
			multiply = -0.5
			add = 0.5
			max = 0.5
		}
		else = {
			value = te_jmap_sol_expected
			subtract = te_jmap_sol_expected_a
			divide = te_jmap_sol_expected_span_up
			multiply = 0.5
			add = 0.5
			min = 0.5
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_scale = 2 }
		if = {
			limit = { te_jmap_sol_expected < 0 }
			value = te_jmap_sol_expected_sl_low_t
			divide = te_jmap_sol_expected_sl_low_top
			multiply = -0.5
			add = 0.5
			max = 0.5
		}
		else = {
			value = te_jmap_sol_expected_sl_up_t
			divide = te_jmap_sol_expected_sl_up_top
			multiply = 0.5
			add = 0.5
			min = 0.5
		}
	}
	else = {
		value = 0.5
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = te_jmap_rank }
			value = var:te_jmap_rank
		}
	}
	min = 0
	max = 1
}
te_jmap_sol_expected_factor_lower = {
	value = te_jmap_sol_expected_factor
	multiply = 2
	min = 0
	max = 1
}
te_jmap_sol_expected_factor_upper = {
	value = te_jmap_sol_expected_factor
	multiply = 2
	subtract = 1
	min = 0
	max = 1
}

# Literacy, the state's people's, 0-1, live.
# Fitted to the world; before the first measure, 0 to 1.
te_jmap_literacy_input = {
	value = literacy_rate
}
te_jmap_literacy_input_neg = {
	value = te_jmap_literacy_input
	multiply = -1
}
te_jmap_literacy_lo = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = te_jmap_rng_literacy_lo }
		value = global_var:te_jmap_rng_literacy_lo
	}
}
te_jmap_literacy_hi = {
	value = 1
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = te_jmap_rng_literacy_hi }
		value = global_var:te_jmap_rng_literacy_hi
	}
	min = te_jmap_literacy_hi_floor
}
te_jmap_literacy_hi_floor = {
	value = te_jmap_literacy_lo
	add = 0.1
}
te_jmap_literacy_span = {
	value = te_jmap_literacy_hi
	subtract = te_jmap_literacy_lo
}
te_jmap_literacy_d0 = {
	value = te_jmap_literacy_span
	multiply = 1
}
te_jmap_literacy_lg_min = {
	value = te_jmap_literacy_hi
	divide = 64
}
te_jmap_literacy_lg_r = {
	value = literacy_rate
	multiply = 64
	divide = te_jmap_literacy_hi
	if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_literacy_lo > te_jmap_literacy_lg_min }
		value = literacy_rate
		divide = te_jmap_literacy_lo
	}
}
te_jmap_literacy_lg_t = {
	if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_literacy_lg_r < 2 }
		value = te_jmap_literacy_lg_r subtract = 1
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_literacy_lg_r < 4 }
		value = te_jmap_literacy_lg_r divide = 2
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_literacy_lg_r < 8 }
		value = te_jmap_literacy_lg_r divide = 4 add = 1
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_literacy_lg_r < 16 }
		value = te_jmap_literacy_lg_r divide = 8 add = 2
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_literacy_lg_r < 32 }
		value = te_jmap_literacy_lg_r divide = 16 add = 3
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_literacy_lg_r < 64 }
		value = te_jmap_literacy_lg_r divide = 32 add = 4
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_literacy_lg_r < 128 }
		value = te_jmap_literacy_lg_r divide = 64 add = 5
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_literacy_lg_r < 256 }
		value = te_jmap_literacy_lg_r divide = 128 add = 6
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_literacy_lg_r < 512 }
		value = te_jmap_literacy_lg_r divide = 256 add = 7
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_literacy_lg_r < 1024 }
		value = te_jmap_literacy_lg_r divide = 512 add = 8
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_literacy_lg_r < 2048 }
		value = te_jmap_literacy_lg_r divide = 1024 add = 9
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_literacy_lg_r < 4096 }
		value = te_jmap_literacy_lg_r divide = 2048 add = 10
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_literacy_lg_r < 8192 }
		value = te_jmap_literacy_lg_r divide = 4096 add = 11
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_literacy_lg_r < 16384 }
		value = te_jmap_literacy_lg_r divide = 8192 add = 12
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_literacy_lg_r < 32768 }
		value = te_jmap_literacy_lg_r divide = 16384 add = 13
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_literacy_lg_r < 65536 }
		value = te_jmap_literacy_lg_r divide = 32768 add = 14
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_literacy_lg_r < 131072 }
		value = te_jmap_literacy_lg_r divide = 65536 add = 15
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_literacy_lg_r < 262144 }
		value = te_jmap_literacy_lg_r divide = 131072 add = 16
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_literacy_lg_r < 524288 }
		value = te_jmap_literacy_lg_r divide = 262144 add = 17
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_literacy_lg_r < 1048576 }
		value = te_jmap_literacy_lg_r divide = 524288 add = 18
	}
	else = {
		value = te_jmap_literacy_lg_r divide = 1048576 add = 19
	}
}
te_jmap_literacy_lg_span_r = {
	value = 64
	if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_literacy_lo > te_jmap_literacy_lg_min }
		value = te_jmap_literacy_hi
		divide = te_jmap_literacy_lo
	}
}
te_jmap_literacy_lg_top = {
	if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_literacy_lg_span_r < 2 }
		value = te_jmap_literacy_lg_span_r subtract = 1
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_literacy_lg_span_r < 4 }
		value = te_jmap_literacy_lg_span_r divide = 2
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_literacy_lg_span_r < 8 }
		value = te_jmap_literacy_lg_span_r divide = 4 add = 1
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_literacy_lg_span_r < 16 }
		value = te_jmap_literacy_lg_span_r divide = 8 add = 2
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_literacy_lg_span_r < 32 }
		value = te_jmap_literacy_lg_span_r divide = 16 add = 3
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_literacy_lg_span_r < 64 }
		value = te_jmap_literacy_lg_span_r divide = 32 add = 4
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_literacy_lg_span_r < 128 }
		value = te_jmap_literacy_lg_span_r divide = 64 add = 5
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_literacy_lg_span_r < 256 }
		value = te_jmap_literacy_lg_span_r divide = 128 add = 6
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_literacy_lg_span_r < 512 }
		value = te_jmap_literacy_lg_span_r divide = 256 add = 7
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_literacy_lg_span_r < 1024 }
		value = te_jmap_literacy_lg_span_r divide = 512 add = 8
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_literacy_lg_span_r < 2048 }
		value = te_jmap_literacy_lg_span_r divide = 1024 add = 9
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_literacy_lg_span_r < 4096 }
		value = te_jmap_literacy_lg_span_r divide = 2048 add = 10
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_literacy_lg_span_r < 8192 }
		value = te_jmap_literacy_lg_span_r divide = 4096 add = 11
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_literacy_lg_span_r < 16384 }
		value = te_jmap_literacy_lg_span_r divide = 8192 add = 12
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_literacy_lg_span_r < 32768 }
		value = te_jmap_literacy_lg_span_r divide = 16384 add = 13
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_literacy_lg_span_r < 65536 }
		value = te_jmap_literacy_lg_span_r divide = 32768 add = 14
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_literacy_lg_span_r < 131072 }
		value = te_jmap_literacy_lg_span_r divide = 65536 add = 15
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_literacy_lg_span_r < 262144 }
		value = te_jmap_literacy_lg_span_r divide = 131072 add = 16
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_literacy_lg_span_r < 524288 }
		value = te_jmap_literacy_lg_span_r divide = 262144 add = 17
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_literacy_lg_span_r < 1048576 }
		value = te_jmap_literacy_lg_span_r divide = 524288 add = 18
	}
	else = {
		value = te_jmap_literacy_lg_span_r divide = 1048576 add = 19
	}
	min = 0.001
}
te_jmap_literacy_factor = {
	if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_scale = 0 }
		value = literacy_rate subtract = te_jmap_literacy_lo divide = te_jmap_literacy_d0
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_scale = 1 }
		value = literacy_rate
		subtract = te_jmap_literacy_lo
		divide = te_jmap_literacy_span
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_scale = 2 }
		value = te_jmap_literacy_lg_t
		divide = te_jmap_literacy_lg_top
	}
	else = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = te_jmap_rank }
			value = var:te_jmap_rank
		}
	}
	min = 0
	max = 1
}

# Unemployment, the share of the state's workforce without work: two-thirds of the color by a third of the world's range.
# Fitted to the world; before the first measure, 0 to 0.6.
te_jmap_unemp_input = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_jmap_unemp }
		value = var:te_jmap_unemp
	}
}
te_jmap_unemp_input_neg = {
	value = te_jmap_unemp_input
	multiply = -1
}
te_jmap_unemp_lo = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = te_jmap_rng_unemp_lo }
		value = global_var:te_jmap_rng_unemp_lo
	}
}
te_jmap_unemp_hi = {
	value = 0.6
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = te_jmap_rng_unemp_hi }
		value = global_var:te_jmap_rng_unemp_hi
	}
	min = te_jmap_unemp_hi_floor
}
te_jmap_unemp_hi_floor = {
	value = te_jmap_unemp_lo
	add = 0.05
}
te_jmap_unemp_span = {
	value = te_jmap_unemp_hi
	subtract = te_jmap_unemp_lo
}
te_jmap_unemp_k1 = {
	value = te_jmap_unemp_span
	multiply = 0.33333
	add = te_jmap_unemp_lo
}
te_jmap_unemp_d0 = {
	value = te_jmap_unemp_span
	multiply = 0.5
}
te_jmap_unemp_d1 = {
	value = te_jmap_unemp_span
	multiply = 2
}
te_jmap_unemp_lg_min = {
	value = te_jmap_unemp_hi
	divide = 64
}
te_jmap_unemp_lg_r = {
	value = var:te_jmap_unemp
	multiply = 64
	divide = te_jmap_unemp_hi
	if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_unemp_lo > te_jmap_unemp_lg_min }
		value = var:te_jmap_unemp
		divide = te_jmap_unemp_lo
	}
}
te_jmap_unemp_lg_t = {
	if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_unemp_lg_r < 2 }
		value = te_jmap_unemp_lg_r subtract = 1
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_unemp_lg_r < 4 }
		value = te_jmap_unemp_lg_r divide = 2
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_unemp_lg_r < 8 }
		value = te_jmap_unemp_lg_r divide = 4 add = 1
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_unemp_lg_r < 16 }
		value = te_jmap_unemp_lg_r divide = 8 add = 2
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_unemp_lg_r < 32 }
		value = te_jmap_unemp_lg_r divide = 16 add = 3
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_unemp_lg_r < 64 }
		value = te_jmap_unemp_lg_r divide = 32 add = 4
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_unemp_lg_r < 128 }
		value = te_jmap_unemp_lg_r divide = 64 add = 5
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_unemp_lg_r < 256 }
		value = te_jmap_unemp_lg_r divide = 128 add = 6
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_unemp_lg_r < 512 }
		value = te_jmap_unemp_lg_r divide = 256 add = 7
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_unemp_lg_r < 1024 }
		value = te_jmap_unemp_lg_r divide = 512 add = 8
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_unemp_lg_r < 2048 }
		value = te_jmap_unemp_lg_r divide = 1024 add = 9
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_unemp_lg_r < 4096 }
		value = te_jmap_unemp_lg_r divide = 2048 add = 10
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_unemp_lg_r < 8192 }
		value = te_jmap_unemp_lg_r divide = 4096 add = 11
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_unemp_lg_r < 16384 }
		value = te_jmap_unemp_lg_r divide = 8192 add = 12
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_unemp_lg_r < 32768 }
		value = te_jmap_unemp_lg_r divide = 16384 add = 13
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_unemp_lg_r < 65536 }
		value = te_jmap_unemp_lg_r divide = 32768 add = 14
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_unemp_lg_r < 131072 }
		value = te_jmap_unemp_lg_r divide = 65536 add = 15
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_unemp_lg_r < 262144 }
		value = te_jmap_unemp_lg_r divide = 131072 add = 16
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_unemp_lg_r < 524288 }
		value = te_jmap_unemp_lg_r divide = 262144 add = 17
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_unemp_lg_r < 1048576 }
		value = te_jmap_unemp_lg_r divide = 524288 add = 18
	}
	else = {
		value = te_jmap_unemp_lg_r divide = 1048576 add = 19
	}
}
te_jmap_unemp_lg_span_r = {
	value = 64
	if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_unemp_lo > te_jmap_unemp_lg_min }
		value = te_jmap_unemp_hi
		divide = te_jmap_unemp_lo
	}
}
te_jmap_unemp_lg_top = {
	if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_unemp_lg_span_r < 2 }
		value = te_jmap_unemp_lg_span_r subtract = 1
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_unemp_lg_span_r < 4 }
		value = te_jmap_unemp_lg_span_r divide = 2
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_unemp_lg_span_r < 8 }
		value = te_jmap_unemp_lg_span_r divide = 4 add = 1
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_unemp_lg_span_r < 16 }
		value = te_jmap_unemp_lg_span_r divide = 8 add = 2
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_unemp_lg_span_r < 32 }
		value = te_jmap_unemp_lg_span_r divide = 16 add = 3
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_unemp_lg_span_r < 64 }
		value = te_jmap_unemp_lg_span_r divide = 32 add = 4
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_unemp_lg_span_r < 128 }
		value = te_jmap_unemp_lg_span_r divide = 64 add = 5
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_unemp_lg_span_r < 256 }
		value = te_jmap_unemp_lg_span_r divide = 128 add = 6
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_unemp_lg_span_r < 512 }
		value = te_jmap_unemp_lg_span_r divide = 256 add = 7
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_unemp_lg_span_r < 1024 }
		value = te_jmap_unemp_lg_span_r divide = 512 add = 8
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_unemp_lg_span_r < 2048 }
		value = te_jmap_unemp_lg_span_r divide = 1024 add = 9
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_unemp_lg_span_r < 4096 }
		value = te_jmap_unemp_lg_span_r divide = 2048 add = 10
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_unemp_lg_span_r < 8192 }
		value = te_jmap_unemp_lg_span_r divide = 4096 add = 11
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_unemp_lg_span_r < 16384 }
		value = te_jmap_unemp_lg_span_r divide = 8192 add = 12
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_unemp_lg_span_r < 32768 }
		value = te_jmap_unemp_lg_span_r divide = 16384 add = 13
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_unemp_lg_span_r < 65536 }
		value = te_jmap_unemp_lg_span_r divide = 32768 add = 14
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_unemp_lg_span_r < 131072 }
		value = te_jmap_unemp_lg_span_r divide = 65536 add = 15
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_unemp_lg_span_r < 262144 }
		value = te_jmap_unemp_lg_span_r divide = 131072 add = 16
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_unemp_lg_span_r < 524288 }
		value = te_jmap_unemp_lg_span_r divide = 262144 add = 17
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_unemp_lg_span_r < 1048576 }
		value = te_jmap_unemp_lg_span_r divide = 524288 add = 18
	}
	else = {
		value = te_jmap_unemp_lg_span_r divide = 1048576 add = 19
	}
	min = 0.001
}
te_jmap_unemp_factor = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_jmap_unemp }
		if = {
			limit = { te_jmap_scale = 0 }
			if = {
				limit = { var:te_jmap_unemp < te_jmap_unemp_k1 }
				value = var:te_jmap_unemp subtract = te_jmap_unemp_lo divide = te_jmap_unemp_d0
			}
			else = {
				value = var:te_jmap_unemp subtract = te_jmap_unemp_k1 divide = te_jmap_unemp_d1 add = 0.66667
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { te_jmap_scale = 1 }
			value = var:te_jmap_unemp
			subtract = te_jmap_unemp_lo
			divide = te_jmap_unemp_span
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { te_jmap_scale = 2 }
			value = te_jmap_unemp_lg_t
			divide = te_jmap_unemp_lg_top
		}
		else = {
			value = 0
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = te_jmap_rank }
				value = var:te_jmap_rank
			}
		}
	}
	min = 0
	max = 1
}

# Population, the state's people: the same share of the color for each doubling from the world's low (at least 100 people) to its high.
# A doubling at a time, fitted to the world; before the first measure, 16000 to 4096000.
te_jmap_people_input = {
	value = state_population
}
te_jmap_people_input_neg = {
	value = te_jmap_people_input
	multiply = -1
}
te_jmap_people_lo = {
	value = 16000
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = te_jmap_rng_people_lo }
		value = global_var:te_jmap_rng_people_lo
	}
	min = 100
}
te_jmap_people_hi = {
	value = 4096000
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = te_jmap_rng_people_hi }
		value = global_var:te_jmap_rng_people_hi
	}
	min = te_jmap_people_hi_floor
}
te_jmap_people_hi_floor = {
	value = te_jmap_people_lo
	multiply = 4
}
te_jmap_people_ratio = {
	value = state_population
	divide = te_jmap_people_lo
}
te_jmap_people_log = {
	if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_people_ratio < 2 }
		value = te_jmap_people_ratio subtract = 1
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_people_ratio < 4 }
		value = te_jmap_people_ratio divide = 2
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_people_ratio < 8 }
		value = te_jmap_people_ratio divide = 4 add = 1
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_people_ratio < 16 }
		value = te_jmap_people_ratio divide = 8 add = 2
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_people_ratio < 32 }
		value = te_jmap_people_ratio divide = 16 add = 3

	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_people_ratio < 64 }
		value = te_jmap_people_ratio divide = 32 add = 4
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_people_ratio < 128 }
		value = te_jmap_people_ratio divide = 64 add = 5
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_people_ratio < 256 }
		value = te_jmap_people_ratio divide = 128 add = 6
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_people_ratio < 512 }
		value = te_jmap_people_ratio divide = 256 add = 7
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_people_ratio < 1024 }
		value = te_jmap_people_ratio divide = 512 add = 8
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_people_ratio < 2048 }
		value = te_jmap_people_ratio divide = 1024 add = 9
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_people_ratio < 4096 }
		value = te_jmap_people_ratio divide = 2048 add = 10
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_people_ratio < 8192 }
		value = te_jmap_people_ratio divide = 4096 add = 11
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_people_ratio < 16384 }
		value = te_jmap_people_ratio divide = 8192 add = 12
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_people_ratio < 32768 }
		value = te_jmap_people_ratio divide = 16384 add = 13
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_people_ratio < 65536 }
		value = te_jmap_people_ratio divide = 32768 add = 14

		value = te_jmap_people_ratio divide = 524288 add = 18
	}
	else = {
		value = te_jmap_people_ratio divide = 1048576 add = 19
	}
}
te_jmap_people_span_ratio = {
	value = te_jmap_people_hi
	divide = te_jmap_people_lo
}

	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_people_span_ratio < 16384 }
		value = te_jmap_people_span_ratio divide = 8192 add = 12
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_people_span_ratio < 32768 }
		value = te_jmap_people_span_ratio divide = 16384 add = 13
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_people_span_ratio < 65536 }
		value = te_jmap_people_span_ratio divide = 32768 add = 14
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_people_span_ratio < 131072 }
		value = te_jmap_people_span_ratio divide = 65536 add = 15
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_people_span_ratio < 262144 }
		value = te_jmap_people_span_ratio divide = 131072 add = 16
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_people_span_ratio < 524288 }
		value = te_jmap_people_span_ratio divide = 262144 add = 17
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_people_span_ratio < 1048576 }
		value = te_jmap_people_span_ratio divide = 524288 add = 18
	}
	else = {
		value = te_jmap_people_span_ratio divide = 1048576 add = 19
	}
	min = 1
}
te_jmap_people_span = {
	value = te_jmap_people_hi
	subtract = te_jmap_people_lo
}
te_jmap_people_factor = {
	if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_scale = 0 }
		value = te_jmap_people_log
		divide = te_jmap_people_log_span
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_scale = 1 }
		value = state_population
		subtract = te_jmap_people_lo
		divide = te_jmap_people_span
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_scale = 2 }
		value = te_jmap_people_log
		divide = te_jmap_people_log_span
	}
	else = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = te_jmap_rank }
			value = var:te_jmap_rank
		}
	}
	min = 0
	max = 1
}

# GDP, the state's yearly GDP in pounds: the same share of the color for each doubling from the world's low (at least 1) to its high.
# A doubling at a time, fitted to the world; before the first measure, 8000 to 8192000.
te_jmap_gdp_input = {
	value = te_jmap_gdp_value
}
te_jmap_gdp_input_neg = {
	value = te_jmap_gdp_input
	multiply = -1
}

	value = 8000
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = te_jmap_rng_gdp_lo }
		value = global_var:te_jmap_rng_gdp_lo
	}
	min = 1
}

	value = 8192000

		limit = { has_global_variable = te_jmap_rng_gdp_hi }

	multiply = 4
}

	divide = te_jmap_gdp_lo
}

	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_gdp_ratio < 16384 }

	}
	else = {
		value = te_jmap_infra_sl_up_r divide = 1048576 add = 19
	}
	add = 1

te_jmap_infra_factor = {
	if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_scale = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { te_jmap_infra_balance < 0 }
			value = te_jmap_infra_balance subtract = te_jmap_infra_b divide = te_jmap_infra_l_d0 add = 0.5
			max = 0.5
		}
		else = {
			value = te_jmap_infra_balance subtract = te_jmap_infra_a divide = te_jmap_infra_u_d0 add = 0.5
			min = 0.5
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_scale = 1 }
		if = {
			limit = { te_jmap_infra_balance < 0 }
			value = te_jmap_infra_b
			subtract = te_jmap_infra_balance
			divide = te_jmap_infra_span_low
			multiply = -0.5
			add = 0.5
			max = 0.5
		}
		else = {
			value = te_jmap_infra_balance
			subtract = te_jmap_infra_a
			divide = te_jmap_infra_span_up
			multiply = 0.5
			add = 0.5
			min = 0.5
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_scale = 2 }
		if = {
			limit = { te_jmap_infra_balance < 0 }
			value = te_jmap_infra_sl_low_t
			divide = te_jmap_infra_sl_low_top
			multiply = -0.5
			add = 0.5
			max = 0.5
		}
		else = {
			value = te_jmap_infra_sl_up_t
			divide = te_jmap_infra_sl_up_top
			multiply = 0.5
			add = 0.5
			min = 0.5
		}
	}
	else = {
		value = 0.5
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = te_jmap_rank }
			value = var:te_jmap_rank
		}
	}
	min = 0
	max = 1
}
te_jmap_infra_factor_lower = {
	value = te_jmap_infra_factor
	multiply = 2
	min = 0
	max = 1
}
te_jmap_infra_factor_upper = {
	value = te_jmap_infra_factor
	multiply = 2
	subtract = 1
	min = 0
	max = 1
}

		limit = { te_jmap_loyal_sl_up_span_r < 262144 }
		value = te_jmap_loyal_sl_up_span_r divide = 131072 add = 16
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_loyal_sl_up_span_r < 524288 }
		value = te_jmap_loyal_sl_up_span_r divide = 262144 add = 17
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_loyal_sl_up_span_r < 1048576 }
		value = te_jmap_loyal_sl_up_span_r divide = 524288 add = 18
	}
	else = {
		value = te_jmap_loyal_sl_up_span_r divide = 1048576 add = 19
	}
	add = 1
	min = 1
}
te_jmap_loyal_factor = {
	if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_scale = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { te_jmap_loyal_net < 0 }
			value = te_jmap_loyal_net subtract = te_jmap_loyal_b divide = te_jmap_loyal_l_d0 add = 0.5
			max = 0.5
		}
		else = {
			value = te_jmap_loyal_net subtract = te_jmap_loyal_a divide = te_jmap_loyal_u_d0 add = 0.5
			min = 0.5
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_scale = 1 }
		if = {
			limit = { te_jmap_loyal_net < 0 }
			value = te_jmap_loyal_b
			subtract = te_jmap_loyal_net
			divide = te_jmap_loyal_span_low
			multiply = -0.5
			add = 0.5
			max = 0.5
		}
		else = {
			value = te_jmap_loyal_net
			subtract = te_jmap_loyal_a
			divide = te_jmap_loyal_span_up
			multiply = 0.5
			add = 0.5
			min = 0.5
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_scale = 2 }
		if = {
			limit = { te_jmap_loyal_net < 0 }
			value = te_jmap_loyal_sl_low_t
			divide = te_jmap_loyal_sl_low_top
			multiply = -0.5
			add = 0.5
			max = 0.5
		}
		else = {
			value = te_jmap_loyal_sl_up_t
			divide = te_jmap_loyal_sl_up_top
			multiply = 0.5
			add = 0.5
			min = 0.5
		}
	}
	else = {
		value = 0.5
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = te_jmap_rank }
			value = var:te_jmap_rank
		}
	}
	min = 0
	max = 1
}
te_jmap_loyal_factor_lower = {
	value = te_jmap_loyal_factor
	multiply = 2
	min = 0
	max = 1
}
te_jmap_loyal_factor_upper = {
	value = te_jmap_loyal_factor
	multiply = 2
	subtract = 1
	min = 0
	max = 1
}

# Market access, the state's, 0-1, live: min(infrastructure, usage) over usage.
# Fitted to the world; before the first measure, 0 to 1.
te_jmap_access_input = {
	value = te_jmap_market_access
}
te_jmap_access_input_neg = {
	value = te_jmap_access_input
	multiply = -1
}
te_jmap_access_lo = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = te_jmap_rng_access_lo }
		value = global_var:te_jmap_rng_access_lo
	}
}
te_jmap_access_hi = {
	value = 1
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = te_jmap_rng_access_hi }
		value = global_var:te_jmap_rng_access_hi
	}
	min = te_jmap_access_hi_floor
}
te_jmap_access_hi_floor = {
	value = te_jmap_access_lo
	add = 0.1
}
te_jmap_access_span = {
	value = te_jmap_access_hi
	subtract = te_jmap_access_lo
}
te_jmap_access_d0 = {
	value = te_jmap_access_span
	multiply = 1
}
te_jmap_access_lg_min = {
	value = te_jmap_access_hi
	divide = 64
}
te_jmap_access_lg_r = {
	value = te_jmap_market_access
	multiply = 64
	divide = te_jmap_access_hi
	if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_access_lo > te_jmap_access_lg_min }
		value = te_jmap_market_access
		divide = te_jmap_access_lo
	}
}
te_jmap_access_lg_t = {
	if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_access_lg_r < 2 }
		value = te_jmap_access_lg_r subtract = 1
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_access_lg_r < 4 }
		value = te_jmap_access_lg_r divide = 2
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_access_lg_r < 8 }
		value = te_jmap_access_lg_r divide = 4 add = 1
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_access_lg_r < 16 }
		value = te_jmap_access_lg_r divide = 8 add = 2
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_access_lg_r < 32 }
		value = te_jmap_access_lg_r divide = 16 add = 3
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_access_lg_r < 64 }
		value = te_jmap_access_lg_r divide = 32 add = 4
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_access_lg_r < 128 }
		value = te_jmap_access_lg_r divide = 64 add = 5
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_access_lg_r < 256 }
		value = te_jmap_access_lg_r divide = 128 add = 6
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_access_lg_r < 512 }
		value = te_jmap_access_lg_r divide = 256 add = 7
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_access_lg_r < 1024 }
		value = te_jmap_access_lg_r divide = 512 add = 8
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_access_lg_r < 2048 }
		value = te_jmap_access_lg_r divide = 1024 add = 9
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_access_lg_r < 4096 }
		value = te_jmap_access_lg_r divide = 2048 add = 10
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_access_lg_r < 8192 }
		value = te_jmap_access_lg_r divide = 4096 add = 11
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_access_lg_r < 16384 }
		value = te_jmap_access_lg_r divide = 8192 add = 12
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_access_lg_r < 32768 }
		value = te_jmap_access_lg_r divide = 16384 add = 13
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_access_lg_r < 65536 }
		value = te_jmap_access_lg_r divide = 32768 add = 14
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_access_lg_r < 131072 }
		value = te_jmap_access_lg_r divide = 65536 add = 15
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_access_lg_r < 262144 }
		value = te_jmap_access_lg_r divide = 131072 add = 16
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_access_lg_r < 524288 }
		value = te_jmap_access_lg_r divide = 262144 add = 17
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_access_lg_r < 1048576 }
		value = te_jmap_access_lg_r divide = 524288 add = 18
	}
	else = {
		value = te_jmap_access_lg_r divide = 1048576 add = 19
	}
}

	}

		value = te_jmap_market_access
		subtract = te_jmap_access_lo
		divide = te_jmap_access_span

		divide = te_jmap_access_lg_top

		}

	min = 0
	max = 1
}

# Pollution, the state region's, 0-255, live: two-thirds of the color by a third of the world's range.

	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_pollution_lg_span_r < 1024 }

	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_pollution_lg_span_r < 2048 }
		value = te_jmap_pollution_lg_span_r divide = 1024 add = 9
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_pollution_lg_span_r < 4096 }
		value = te_jmap_pollution_lg_span_r divide = 2048 add = 10
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_pollution_lg_span_r < 8192 }
		value = te_jmap_pollution_lg_span_r divide = 4096 add = 11
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_pollution_lg_span_r < 16384 }
		value = te_jmap_pollution_lg_span_r divide = 8192 add = 12

	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_pollution_lg_span_r < 262144 }

	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_pollution_lg_span_r < 524288 }
		value = te_jmap_pollution_lg_span_r divide = 262144 add = 17
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_pollution_lg_span_r < 1048576 }
		value = te_jmap_pollution_lg_span_r divide = 524288 add = 18
	}
	else = {
		value = te_jmap_pollution_lg_span_r divide = 1048576 add = 19
	}
	min = 0.001
}
te_jmap_pollution_factor = {
	if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_scale = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { te_jmap_pollution < te_jmap_pollution_k1 }
			value = te_jmap_pollution subtract = te_jmap_pollution_lo divide = te_jmap_pollution_d0
		}
		else = {
			value = te_jmap_pollution subtract = te_jmap_pollution_k1 divide = te_jmap_pollution_d1 add = 0.66667
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_scale = 1 }
		value = te_jmap_pollution
		subtract = te_jmap_pollution_lo
		divide = te_jmap_pollution_span
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_scale = 2 }
		value = te_jmap_pollution_lg_t
		divide = te_jmap_pollution_lg_top
	}
	else = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = te_jmap_rank }
			value = var:te_jmap_rank
		}
	}
	min = 0
	max = 1
}

# Vacant Jobs, the jobs open in the state's buildings other than subsistence farms: the same share of the color for each doubling from the world's low (at least 10) to its high.
# A doubling at a time, fitted to the world; before the first measure, 1000 to 512000.
te_jmap_jobs_input = {
	value = te_jmap_vacant_jobs
}
te_jmap_jobs_input_neg = {
	value = te_jmap_jobs_input
	multiply = -1
}
te_jmap_jobs_lo = {
	value = 1000
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = te_jmap_rng_jobs_lo }
		value = global_var:te_jmap_rng_jobs_lo
	}
	min = 10
}
te_jmap_jobs_hi = {
	value = 512000
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = te_jmap_rng_jobs_hi }
		value = global_var:te_jmap_rng_jobs_hi
	}
	min = te_jmap_jobs_hi_floor
}
te_jmap_jobs_hi_floor = {
	value = te_jmap_jobs_lo
	multiply = 4
}
te_jmap_jobs_ratio = {
	value = te_jmap_vacant_jobs
	divide = te_jmap_jobs_lo
}
te_jmap_jobs_log = {
	if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_jobs_ratio < 2 }
		value = te_jmap_jobs_ratio subtract = 1
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_jobs_ratio < 4 }
		value = te_jmap_jobs_ratio divide = 2
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_jobs_ratio < 8 }
		value = te_jmap_jobs_ratio divide = 4 add = 1
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_jobs_ratio < 16 }
		value = te_jmap_jobs_ratio divide = 8 add = 2
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_jobs_ratio < 32 }
		value = te_jmap_jobs_ratio divide = 16 add = 3
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_jobs_ratio < 64 }
		value = te_jmap_jobs_ratio divide = 32 add = 4
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_jobs_ratio < 128 }
		value = te_jmap_jobs_ratio divide = 64 add = 5
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_jobs_ratio < 256 }
		value = te_jmap_jobs_ratio divide = 128 add = 6
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_jobs_ratio < 512 }
		value = te_jmap_jobs_ratio divide = 256 add = 7
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_jobs_ratio < 1024 }
		value = te_jmap_jobs_ratio divide = 512 add = 8
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_jobs_ratio < 2048 }
		value = te_jmap_jobs_ratio divide = 1024 add = 9
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_jobs_ratio < 4096 }
		value = te_jmap_jobs_ratio divide = 2048 add = 10
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_jobs_ratio < 8192 }
		value = te_jmap_jobs_ratio divide = 4096 add = 11
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_jobs_ratio < 16384 }
		value = te_jmap_jobs_ratio divide = 8192 add = 12
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_jobs_ratio < 32768 }
		value = te_jmap_jobs_ratio divide = 16384 add = 13
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_jobs_ratio < 65536 }
		value = te_jmap_jobs_ratio divide = 32768 add = 14
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_jobs_ratio < 131072 }
		value = te_jmap_jobs_ratio divide = 65536 add = 15
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_jobs_ratio < 262144 }
		value = te_jmap_jobs_ratio divide = 131072 add = 16
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_jobs_ratio < 524288 }
		value = te_jmap_jobs_ratio divide = 262144 add = 17
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_jobs_ratio < 1048576 }
		value = te_jmap_jobs_ratio divide = 524288 add = 18
	}
	else = {
		value = te_jmap_jobs_ratio divide = 1048576 add = 19
	}
}
te_jmap_jobs_span_ratio = {
	value = te_jmap_jobs_hi
	divide = te_jmap_jobs_lo
}
te_jmap_jobs_log_span = {
	if = {

		limit = { te_jmap_jobs_span_ratio < 16 }

		limit = { te_jmap_jobs_span_ratio < 512 }

	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_jobs_span_ratio < 1024 }
		value = te_jmap_jobs_span_ratio divide = 512 add = 8
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_jobs_span_ratio < 2048 }
		value = te_jmap_jobs_span_ratio divide = 1024 add = 9
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_jobs_span_ratio < 4096 }
		value = te_jmap_jobs_span_ratio divide = 2048 add = 10
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_jobs_span_ratio < 8192 }
		value = te_jmap_jobs_span_ratio divide = 4096 add = 11
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_jobs_span_ratio < 16384 }
		value = te_jmap_jobs_span_ratio divide = 8192 add = 12
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_jobs_span_ratio < 32768 }
		value = te_jmap_jobs_span_ratio divide = 16384 add = 13
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_jobs_span_ratio < 65536 }

		limit = { te_jmap_jobs_span_ratio < 131072 }

		limit = { te_jmap_jobs_span_ratio < 262144 }
		value = te_jmap_jobs_span_ratio divide = 131072 add = 16
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_jobs_span_ratio < 524288 }
		value = te_jmap_jobs_span_ratio divide = 262144 add = 17
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_jobs_span_ratio < 1048576 }
		value = te_jmap_jobs_span_ratio divide = 524288 add = 18
	}
	else = {
		value = te_jmap_jobs_span_ratio divide = 1048576 add = 19
	}
	min = 1
}
te_jmap_jobs_span = {
	value = te_jmap_jobs_hi
	subtract = te_jmap_jobs_lo
}
te_jmap_jobs_factor = {
	if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_scale = 0 }
		value = te_jmap_jobs_log
		divide = te_jmap_jobs_log_span
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_scale = 1 }
		value = te_jmap_vacant_jobs
		subtract = te_jmap_jobs_lo
		divide = te_jmap_jobs_span
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_scale = 2 }
		value = te_jmap_jobs_log
		divide = te_jmap_jobs_log_span
	}
	else = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = te_jmap_rank }
			value = var:te_jmap_rank
		}
	}
	min = 0
	max = 1
}

# The share of the state's people below their expected standard of living, 0-1, live.
# Fitted to the world; before the first measure, 0 to 1.
te_jmap_below_sol_input = {
	value = te_jmap_below_expected
}
te_jmap_below_sol_input_neg = {
	value = te_jmap_below_sol_input
	multiply = -1
}
te_jmap_below_sol_lo = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = te_jmap_rng_below_sol_lo }
		value = global_var:te_jmap_rng_below_sol_lo
	}
}
te_jmap_below_sol_hi = {
	value = 1
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = te_jmap_rng_below_sol_hi }
		value = global_var:te_jmap_rng_below_sol_hi
	}
	min = te_jmap_below_sol_hi_floor
}
te_jmap_below_sol_hi_floor = {
	value = te_jmap_below_sol_lo
	add = 0.1
}
te_jmap_below_sol_span = {
	value = te_jmap_below_sol_hi
	subtract = te_jmap_below_sol_lo
}
te_jmap_below_sol_d0 = {
	value = te_jmap_below_sol_span
	multiply = 1
}
te_jmap_below_sol_lg_min = {
	value = te_jmap_below_sol_hi
	divide = 64
}
te_jmap_below_sol_lg_r = {
	value = te_jmap_below_expected
	multiply = 64
	divide = te_jmap_below_sol_hi
	if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_below_sol_lo > te_jmap_below_sol_lg_min }
		value = te_jmap_below_expected
		divide = te_jmap_below_sol_lo
	}
}
te_jmap_below_sol_lg_t = {
	if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_below_sol_lg_r < 2 }
		value = te_jmap_below_sol_lg_r subtract = 1
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_below_sol_lg_r < 4 }
		value = te_jmap_below_sol_lg_r divide = 2
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_below_sol_lg_r < 8 }
		value = te_jmap_below_sol_lg_r divide = 4 add = 1
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_below_sol_lg_r < 16 }
		value = te_jmap_below_sol_lg_r divide = 8 add = 2
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_below_sol_lg_r < 32 }
		value = te_jmap_below_sol_lg_r divide = 16 add = 3
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_below_sol_lg_r < 64 }
		value = te_jmap_below_sol_lg_r divide = 32 add = 4
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_below_sol_lg_r < 128 }
		value = te_jmap_below_sol_lg_r divide = 64 add = 5
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_below_sol_lg_r < 256 }
		value = te_jmap_below_sol_lg_r divide = 128 add = 6
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_below_sol_lg_r < 512 }
		value = te_jmap_below_sol_lg_r divide = 256 add = 7
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_below_sol_lg_r < 1024 }
		value = te_jmap_below_sol_lg_r divide = 512 add = 8
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_below_sol_lg_r < 2048 }
		value = te_jmap_below_sol_lg_r divide = 1024 add = 9
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_below_sol_lg_r < 4096 }
		value = te_jmap_below_sol_lg_r divide = 2048 add = 10
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_below_sol_lg_r < 8192 }
		value = te_jmap_below_sol_lg_r divide = 4096 add = 11
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_below_sol_lg_r < 16384 }
		value = te_jmap_below_sol_lg_r divide = 8192 add = 12
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_below_sol_lg_r < 32768 }
		value = te_jmap_below_sol_lg_r divide = 16384 add = 13
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_below_sol_lg_r < 65536 }
		value = te_jmap_below_sol_lg_r divide = 32768 add = 14
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_below_sol_lg_r < 131072 }
		value = te_jmap_below_sol_lg_r divide = 65536 add = 15
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_below_sol_lg_r < 262144 }
		value = te_jmap_below_sol_lg_r divide = 131072 add = 16
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_below_sol_lg_r < 524288 }
		value = te_jmap_below_sol_lg_r divide = 262144 add = 17
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_below_sol_lg_r < 1048576 }
		value = te_jmap_below_sol_lg_r divide = 524288 add = 18
	}
	else = {
		value = te_jmap_below_sol_lg_r divide = 1048576 add = 19
	}
}
te_jmap_below_sol_lg_span_r = {
	value = 64
	if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_below_sol_lo > te_jmap_below_sol_lg_min }
		value = te_jmap_below_sol_hi
		divide = te_jmap_below_sol_lo
	}
}
te_jmap_below_sol_lg_top = {
	if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_below_sol_lg_span_r < 2 }
		value = te_jmap_below_sol_lg_span_r subtract = 1
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_below_sol_lg_span_r < 4 }
		value = te_jmap_below_sol_lg_span_r divide = 2
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_below_sol_lg_span_r < 8 }
		value = te_jmap_below_sol_lg_span_r divide = 4 add = 1
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_below_sol_lg_span_r < 16 }
		value = te_jmap_below_sol_lg_span_r divide = 8 add = 2
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_below_sol_lg_span_r < 32 }
		value = te_jmap_below_sol_lg_span_r divide = 16 add = 3
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_below_sol_lg_span_r < 64 }
		value = te_jmap_below_sol_lg_span_r divide = 32 add = 4
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_below_sol_lg_span_r < 128 }
		value = te_jmap_below_sol_lg_span_r divide = 64 add = 5
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_below_sol_lg_span_r < 256 }
		value = te_jmap_below_sol_lg_span_r divide = 128 add = 6
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_below_sol_lg_span_r < 512 }
		value = te_jmap_below_sol_lg_span_r divide = 256 add = 7
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_below_sol_lg_span_r < 1024 }
		value = te_jmap_below_sol_lg_span_r divide = 512 add = 8
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_below_sol_lg_span_r < 2048 }
		value = te_jmap_below_sol_lg_span_r divide = 1024 add = 9
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_below_sol_lg_span_r < 4096 }
		value = te_jmap_below_sol_lg_span_r divide = 2048 add = 10
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_below_sol_lg_span_r < 8192 }
		value = te_jmap_below_sol_lg_span_r divide = 4096 add = 11
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_below_sol_lg_span_r < 16384 }
		value = te_jmap_below_sol_lg_span_r divide = 8192 add = 12
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_below_sol_lg_span_r < 32768 }
		value = te_jmap_below_sol_lg_span_r divide = 16384 add = 13
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_below_sol_lg_span_r < 65536 }
		value = te_jmap_below_sol_lg_span_r divide = 32768 add = 14
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_below_sol_lg_span_r < 131072 }
		value = te_jmap_below_sol_lg_span_r divide = 65536 add = 15
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_below_sol_lg_span_r < 262144 }
		value = te_jmap_below_sol_lg_span_r divide = 131072 add = 16
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_below_sol_lg_span_r < 524288 }
		value = te_jmap_below_sol_lg_span_r divide = 262144 add = 17
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_below_sol_lg_span_r < 1048576 }
		value = te_jmap_below_sol_lg_span_r divide = 524288 add = 18
	}
	else = {
		value = te_jmap_below_sol_lg_span_r divide = 1048576 add = 19
	}
	min = 0.001
}
te_jmap_below_sol_factor = {
	if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_scale = 0 }
		value = te_jmap_below_expected subtract = te_jmap_below_sol_lo divide = te_jmap_below_sol_d0
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_scale = 1 }
		value = te_jmap_below_expected
		subtract = te_jmap_below_sol_lo
		divide = te_jmap_below_sol_span
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_scale = 2 }
		value = te_jmap_below_sol_lg_t
		divide = te_jmap_below_sol_lg_top
	}
	else = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = te_jmap_rank }
			value = var:te_jmap_rank
		}
	}
	min = 0
	max = 1
}
