	}
}
te_jmap_unacc_lg_top = {
	if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_unacc_lg_span_r < 2 }
		value = te_jmap_unacc_lg_span_r subtract = 1
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_unacc_lg_span_r < 4 }
		value = te_jmap_unacc_lg_span_r divide = 2
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_unacc_lg_span_r < 8 }
		value = te_jmap_unacc_lg_span_r divide = 4 add = 1
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_unacc_lg_span_r < 16 }
		value = te_jmap_unacc_lg_span_r divide = 8 add = 2
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_unacc_lg_span_r < 32 }
		value = te_jmap_unacc_lg_span_r divide = 16 add = 3
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_unacc_lg_span_r < 64 }
		value = te_jmap_unacc_lg_span_r divide = 32 add = 4
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_unacc_lg_span_r < 128 }
		value = te_jmap_unacc_lg_span_r divide = 64 add = 5
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_unacc_lg_span_r < 256 }
		value = te_jmap_unacc_lg_span_r divide = 128 add = 6
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_unacc_lg_span_r < 512 }
		value = te_jmap_unacc_lg_span_r divide = 256 add = 7
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_unacc_lg_span_r < 1024 }
		value = te_jmap_unacc_lg_span_r divide = 512 add = 8
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_unacc_lg_span_r < 2048 }
		value = te_jmap_unacc_lg_span_r divide = 1024 add = 9
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_unacc_lg_span_r < 4096 }
		value = te_jmap_unacc_lg_span_r divide = 2048 add = 10
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_unacc_lg_span_r < 8192 }
		value = te_jmap_unacc_lg_span_r divide = 4096 add = 11
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_unacc_lg_span_r < 16384 }
		value = te_jmap_unacc_lg_span_r divide = 8192 add = 12
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_unacc_lg_span_r < 32768 }
		value = te_jmap_unacc_lg_span_r divide = 16384 add = 13
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_unacc_lg_span_r < 65536 }
		value = te_jmap_unacc_lg_span_r divide = 32768 add = 14
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_unacc_lg_span_r < 131072 }
		value = te_jmap_unacc_lg_span_r divide = 65536 add = 15
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_unacc_lg_span_r < 262144 }
		value = te_jmap_unacc_lg_span_r divide = 131072 add = 16
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_unacc_lg_span_r < 524288 }
		value = te_jmap_unacc_lg_span_r divide = 262144 add = 17
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_unacc_lg_span_r < 1048576 }
		value = te_jmap_unacc_lg_span_r divide = 524288 add = 18
	}
	else = {
		value = te_jmap_unacc_lg_span_r divide = 1048576 add = 19
	}
	min = 0.001
}
te_jmap_unacc_factor = {
	if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_scale = 0 }
		value = te_jmap_unacc_share subtract = te_jmap_unacc_lo divide = te_jmap_unacc_d0
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_scale = 1 }
		value = te_jmap_unacc_share
		subtract = te_jmap_unacc_lo
		divide = te_jmap_unacc_span
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_scale = 2 }
		value = te_jmap_unacc_lg_t
		divide = te_jmap_unacc_lg_top
	}
	else = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = te_jmap_rank }
			value = var:te_jmap_rank
		}
	}
	min = 0
	max = 1
}

# Aristocrats, their people (the yearly walk's): the same share of the color for each doubling from the world's low (at least 10 people) to its high.
# A doubling at a time, fitted to the world; before the first measure, 250 to 32000.
te_jmap_class_aristocrats_input = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_dg_cls_aristocrats }
		value = var:te_dg_cls_aristocrats
	}
}
te_jmap_class_aristocrats_input_neg = {
	value = te_jmap_class_aristocrats_input
	multiply = -1
}
te_jmap_class_aristocrats_lo = {
	value = 250
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = te_jmap_rng_class_aristocrats_lo }
		value = global_var:te_jmap_rng_class_aristocrats_lo
	}
	min = 10
}
te_jmap_class_aristocrats_hi = {
	value = 32000
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = te_jmap_rng_class_aristocrats_hi }
		value = global_var:te_jmap_rng_class_aristocrats_hi
	}
	min = te_jmap_class_aristocrats_hi_floor
}
te_jmap_class_aristocrats_hi_floor = {
	value = te_jmap_class_aristocrats_lo
	multiply = 4
}
te_jmap_class_aristocrats_ratio = {
	value = var:te_dg_cls_aristocrats
	divide = te_jmap_class_aristocrats_lo
}

			value = te_jmap_class_aristocrats_log
			divide = te_jmap_class_aristocrats_log_span
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { te_jmap_scale = 1 }
			value = var:te_dg_cls_aristocrats
			subtract = te_jmap_class_aristocrats_lo
			divide = te_jmap_class_aristocrats_span
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { te_jmap_scale = 2 }
			value = te_jmap_class_aristocrats_log
			divide = te_jmap_class_aristocrats_log_span
		}
		else = {
			value = 0
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = te_jmap_rank }
				value = var:te_jmap_rank
			}
		}
	}
	min = 0
	max = 1
}

# Aristocrats, their share of the state's people (the yearly walk's).
# Fitted to the world; before the first measure, 0 to 0.04.
te_jmap_class_aristocrats_share_input = {
	value = te_jmap_share_aristocrats
}
te_jmap_class_aristocrats_share_input_neg = {
	value = te_jmap_class_aristocrats_share_input
	multiply = -1
}
te_jmap_class_aristocrats_share_lo = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = te_jmap_rng_class_aristocrats_share_lo }
		value = global_var:te_jmap_rng_class_aristocrats_share_lo
	}
}
te_jmap_class_aristocrats_share_hi = {
	value = 0.04
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = te_jmap_rng_class_aristocrats_share_hi }
		value = global_var:te_jmap_rng_class_aristocrats_share_hi
	}
	min = te_jmap_class_aristocrats_share_hi_floor
}
te_jmap_class_aristocrats_share_hi_floor = {
	value = te_jmap_class_aristocrats_share_lo
	add = 0.005
}
te_jmap_class_aristocrats_share_span = {
	value = te_jmap_class_aristocrats_share_hi
	subtract = te_jmap_class_aristocrats_share_lo
}
te_jmap_class_aristocrats_share_d0 = {
	value = te_jmap_class_aristocrats_share_span
	multiply = 1
}
te_jmap_class_aristocrats_share_lg_min = {
	value = te_jmap_class_aristocrats_share_hi
	divide = 64
}
te_jmap_class_aristocrats_share_lg_r = {
	value = te_jmap_share_aristocrats
	multiply = 64
	divide = te_jmap_class_aristocrats_share_hi
	if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_aristocrats_share_lo > te_jmap_class_aristocrats_share_lg_min }
		value = te_jmap_share_aristocrats
		divide = te_jmap_class_aristocrats_share_lo
	}
}

	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_aristocrats_share_lg_span_r < 8192 }
		value = te_jmap_class_aristocrats_share_lg_span_r divide = 4096 add = 11
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_aristocrats_share_lg_span_r < 16384 }
		value = te_jmap_class_aristocrats_share_lg_span_r divide = 8192 add = 12
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_aristocrats_share_lg_span_r < 32768 }
		value = te_jmap_class_aristocrats_share_lg_span_r divide = 16384 add = 13
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_aristocrats_share_lg_span_r < 65536 }
		value = te_jmap_class_aristocrats_share_lg_span_r divide = 32768 add = 14
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_aristocrats_share_lg_span_r < 131072 }
		value = te_jmap_class_aristocrats_share_lg_span_r divide = 65536 add = 15
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_aristocrats_share_lg_span_r < 262144 }
		value = te_jmap_class_aristocrats_share_lg_span_r divide = 131072 add = 16
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_aristocrats_share_lg_span_r < 524288 }
		value = te_jmap_class_aristocrats_share_lg_span_r divide = 262144 add = 17
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_aristocrats_share_lg_span_r < 1048576 }
		value = te_jmap_class_aristocrats_share_lg_span_r divide = 524288 add = 18
	}
	else = {
		value = te_jmap_class_aristocrats_share_lg_span_r divide = 1048576 add = 19
	}
	min = 0.001
}
te_jmap_class_aristocrats_share_factor = {
	if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_scale = 0 }
		value = te_jmap_share_aristocrats subtract = te_jmap_class_aristocrats_share_lo divide = te_jmap_class_aristocrats_share_d0
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_scale = 1 }
		value = te_jmap_share_aristocrats
		subtract = te_jmap_class_aristocrats_share_lo
		divide = te_jmap_class_aristocrats_share_span
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_scale = 2 }
		value = te_jmap_class_aristocrats_share_lg_t
		divide = te_jmap_class_aristocrats_share_lg_top
	}
	else = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = te_jmap_rank }
			value = var:te_jmap_rank
		}
	}
	min = 0
	max = 1
}

# Capitalists, their people (the yearly walk's): the same share of the color for each doubling from the world's low (at least 10 people) to its high.
# A doubling at a time, fitted to the world; before the first measure, 50 to 6400.
te_jmap_class_capitalists_input = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_dg_cls_capitalists }
		value = var:te_dg_cls_capitalists
	}
}
te_jmap_class_capitalists_input_neg = {
	value = te_jmap_class_capitalists_input
	multiply = -1
}
te_jmap_class_capitalists_lo = {
	value = 50
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = te_jmap_rng_class_capitalists_lo }
		value = global_var:te_jmap_rng_class_capitalists_lo
	}
	min = 10
}
te_jmap_class_capitalists_hi = {
	value = 6400
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = te_jmap_rng_class_capitalists_hi }
		value = global_var:te_jmap_rng_class_capitalists_hi
	}
	min = te_jmap_class_capitalists_hi_floor
}
te_jmap_class_capitalists_hi_floor = {
	value = te_jmap_class_capitalists_lo
	multiply = 4
}
te_jmap_class_capitalists_ratio = {
	value = var:te_dg_cls_capitalists
	divide = te_jmap_class_capitalists_lo
}
te_jmap_class_capitalists_log = {
	if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_capitalists_ratio < 2 }
		value = te_jmap_class_capitalists_ratio subtract = 1
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_capitalists_ratio < 4 }
		value = te_jmap_class_capitalists_ratio divide = 2
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_capitalists_ratio < 8 }
		value = te_jmap_class_capitalists_ratio divide = 4 add = 1
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_capitalists_ratio < 16 }
		value = te_jmap_class_capitalists_ratio divide = 8 add = 2
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_capitalists_ratio < 32 }
		value = te_jmap_class_capitalists_ratio divide = 16 add = 3
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_capitalists_ratio < 64 }
		value = te_jmap_class_capitalists_ratio divide = 32 add = 4
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_capitalists_ratio < 128 }
		value = te_jmap_class_capitalists_ratio divide = 64 add = 5
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_capitalists_ratio < 256 }
		value = te_jmap_class_capitalists_ratio divide = 128 add = 6
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_capitalists_ratio < 512 }
		value = te_jmap_class_capitalists_ratio divide = 256 add = 7
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_capitalists_ratio < 1024 }
		value = te_jmap_class_capitalists_ratio divide = 512 add = 8
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_capitalists_ratio < 2048 }
		value = te_jmap_class_capitalists_ratio divide = 1024 add = 9
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_capitalists_ratio < 4096 }
		value = te_jmap_class_capitalists_ratio divide = 2048 add = 10
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_capitalists_ratio < 8192 }
		value = te_jmap_class_capitalists_ratio divide = 4096 add = 11
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_capitalists_ratio < 16384 }
		value = te_jmap_class_capitalists_ratio divide = 8192 add = 12
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_capitalists_ratio < 32768 }
		value = te_jmap_class_capitalists_ratio divide = 16384 add = 13
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_capitalists_ratio < 65536 }
		value = te_jmap_class_capitalists_ratio divide = 32768 add = 14
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_capitalists_ratio < 131072 }
		value = te_jmap_class_capitalists_ratio divide = 65536 add = 15
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_capitalists_ratio < 262144 }
		value = te_jmap_class_capitalists_ratio divide = 131072 add = 16
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_capitalists_ratio < 524288 }
		value = te_jmap_class_capitalists_ratio divide = 262144 add = 17
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_capitalists_ratio < 1048576 }
		value = te_jmap_class_capitalists_ratio divide = 524288 add = 18
	}
	else = {
		value = te_jmap_class_capitalists_ratio divide = 1048576 add = 19
	}
}

	value = te_jmap_class_capitalists_hi
	divide = te_jmap_class_capitalists_lo
}

te_jmap_class_capitalists_span = {
	value = te_jmap_class_capitalists_hi
	subtract = te_jmap_class_capitalists_lo
}
te_jmap_class_capitalists_factor = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_dg_cls_capitalists }
		if = {
			limit = { te_jmap_scale = 0 }
			value = te_jmap_class_capitalists_log
			divide = te_jmap_class_capitalists_log_span
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { te_jmap_scale = 1 }
			value = var:te_dg_cls_capitalists
			subtract = te_jmap_class_capitalists_lo
			divide = te_jmap_class_capitalists_span
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { te_jmap_scale = 2 }
			value = te_jmap_class_capitalists_log
			divide = te_jmap_class_capitalists_log_span
		}
		else = {
			value = 0
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = te_jmap_rank }
				value = var:te_jmap_rank
			}
		}
	}
	min = 0
	max = 1
}

# Capitalists, their share of the state's people (the yearly walk's): half the color by a fifth of the world's range.
# Fitted to the world; before the first measure, 0 to 0.01.
te_jmap_class_capitalists_share_input = {
	value = te_jmap_share_capitalists
}
te_jmap_class_capitalists_share_input_neg = {
	value = te_jmap_class_capitalists_share_input
	multiply = -1
}
te_jmap_class_capitalists_share_lo = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = te_jmap_rng_class_capitalists_share_lo }
		value = global_var:te_jmap_rng_class_capitalists_share_lo
	}
}
te_jmap_class_capitalists_share_hi = {
	value = 0.01
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = te_jmap_rng_class_capitalists_share_hi }
		value = global_var:te_jmap_rng_class_capitalists_share_hi
	}
	min = te_jmap_class_capitalists_share_hi_floor
}
te_jmap_class_capitalists_share_hi_floor = {
	value = te_jmap_class_capitalists_share_lo
	add = 0.002
}
te_jmap_class_capitalists_share_span = {
	value = te_jmap_class_capitalists_share_hi
	subtract = te_jmap_class_capitalists_share_lo
}
te_jmap_class_capitalists_share_k1 = {
	value = te_jmap_class_capitalists_share_span
	multiply = 0.2
	add = te_jmap_class_capitalists_share_lo
}
te_jmap_class_capitalists_share_d0 = {
	value = te_jmap_class_capitalists_share_span
	multiply = 0.4
}
te_jmap_class_capitalists_share_d1 = {
	value = te_jmap_class_capitalists_share_span
	multiply = 1.6
}
te_jmap_class_capitalists_share_lg_min = {
	value = te_jmap_class_capitalists_share_hi
	divide = 64
}
te_jmap_class_capitalists_share_lg_r = {
	value = te_jmap_share_capitalists
	multiply = 64
	divide = te_jmap_class_capitalists_share_hi
	if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_capitalists_share_lo > te_jmap_class_capitalists_share_lg_min }
		value = te_jmap_share_capitalists
		divide = te_jmap_class_capitalists_share_lo
	}
}

	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_capitalists_share_lg_r < 8 }
		value = te_jmap_class_capitalists_share_lg_r divide = 4 add = 1
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_capitalists_share_lg_r < 16 }
		value = te_jmap_class_capitalists_share_lg_r divide = 8 add = 2

	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_capitalists_share_lg_r < 32 }

	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_capitalists_share_lg_r < 64 }
		value = te_jmap_class_capitalists_share_lg_r divide = 32 add = 4
	}

		limit = { te_jmap_class_capitalists_share_lg_r < 128 }

	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_capitalists_share_lg_r < 512 }
		value = te_jmap_class_capitalists_share_lg_r divide = 256 add = 7
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_capitalists_share_lg_r < 1024 }
		value = te_jmap_class_capitalists_share_lg_r divide = 512 add = 8
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_capitalists_share_lg_r < 2048 }

	if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_scale = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { te_jmap_share_capitalists < te_jmap_class_capitalists_share_k1 }
			value = te_jmap_share_capitalists subtract = te_jmap_class_capitalists_share_lo divide = te_jmap_class_capitalists_share_d0
		}
		else = {
			value = te_jmap_share_capitalists subtract = te_jmap_class_capitalists_share_k1 divide = te_jmap_class_capitalists_share_d1 add = 0.5
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_scale = 1 }
		value = te_jmap_share_capitalists
		subtract = te_jmap_class_capitalists_share_lo
		divide = te_jmap_class_capitalists_share_span
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_scale = 2 }
		value = te_jmap_class_capitalists_share_lg_t
		divide = te_jmap_class_capitalists_share_lg_top
	}
	else = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = te_jmap_rank }
			value = var:te_jmap_rank
		}
	}
	min = 0
	max = 1
}

# Shopkeepers, their people (the yearly walk's): the same share of the color for each doubling from the world's low (at least 10 people) to its high.
# A doubling at a time, fitted to the world; before the first measure, 250 to 32000.

	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_dg_cls_shopkeepers }
		value = var:te_dg_cls_shopkeepers
	}

	value = te_jmap_class_shopkeepers_input
	multiply = -1
}

	value = 250
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = te_jmap_rng_class_shopkeepers_lo }

	}
	min = 10
}
te_jmap_class_shopkeepers_hi = {
	value = 32000
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = te_jmap_rng_class_shopkeepers_hi }

	}
	min = te_jmap_class_shopkeepers_hi_floor
}

	value = te_jmap_class_shopkeepers_lo
	multiply = 4
}

	value = var:te_dg_cls_shopkeepers
	divide = te_jmap_class_shopkeepers_lo
}

	}

		limit = { te_jmap_class_shopkeepers_ratio < 4 }
		value = te_jmap_class_shopkeepers_ratio divide = 2
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_shopkeepers_ratio < 8 }
		value = te_jmap_class_shopkeepers_ratio divide = 4 add = 1
	}

	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_shopkeepers_ratio < 1024 }

	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_shopkeepers_ratio < 2048 }

	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_shopkeepers_ratio < 4096 }

	}

	}
	else = {

		value = te_jmap_class_academics_ratio subtract = 1
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_academics_ratio < 4 }
		value = te_jmap_class_academics_ratio divide = 2
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_academics_ratio < 8 }
		value = te_jmap_class_academics_ratio divide = 4 add = 1
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_academics_ratio < 16 }
		value = te_jmap_class_academics_ratio divide = 8 add = 2
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_academics_ratio < 32 }
		value = te_jmap_class_academics_ratio divide = 16 add = 3
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_academics_ratio < 64 }
		value = te_jmap_class_academics_ratio divide = 32 add = 4
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_academics_ratio < 128 }
		value = te_jmap_class_academics_ratio divide = 64 add = 5
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_academics_ratio < 256 }
		value = te_jmap_class_academics_ratio divide = 128 add = 6
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_academics_ratio < 512 }
		value = te_jmap_class_academics_ratio divide = 256 add = 7
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_academics_ratio < 1024 }
		value = te_jmap_class_academics_ratio divide = 512 add = 8
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_academics_ratio < 2048 }
		value = te_jmap_class_academics_ratio divide = 1024 add = 9
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_academics_ratio < 4096 }
		value = te_jmap_class_academics_ratio divide = 2048 add = 10
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_academics_ratio < 8192 }
		value = te_jmap_class_academics_ratio divide = 4096 add = 11
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_academics_ratio < 16384 }
		value = te_jmap_class_academics_ratio divide = 8192 add = 12
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_academics_ratio < 32768 }
		value = te_jmap_class_academics_ratio divide = 16384 add = 13
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_academics_ratio < 65536 }
		value = te_jmap_class_academics_ratio divide = 32768 add = 14
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_academics_ratio < 131072 }
		value = te_jmap_class_academics_ratio divide = 65536 add = 15
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_academics_ratio < 262144 }
		value = te_jmap_class_academics_ratio divide = 131072 add = 16
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_academics_ratio < 524288 }
		value = te_jmap_class_academics_ratio divide = 262144 add = 17
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_academics_ratio < 1048576 }
		value = te_jmap_class_academics_ratio divide = 524288 add = 18
	}
	else = {
		value = te_jmap_class_academics_ratio divide = 1048576 add = 19
	}
}
te_jmap_class_academics_span_ratio = {
	value = te_jmap_class_academics_hi
	divide = te_jmap_class_academics_lo
}
te_jmap_class_academics_log_span = {
	if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_academics_span_ratio < 2 }
		value = te_jmap_class_academics_span_ratio subtract = 1
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_academics_span_ratio < 4 }
		value = te_jmap_class_academics_span_ratio divide = 2
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_academics_span_ratio < 8 }
		value = te_jmap_class_academics_span_ratio divide = 4 add = 1
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_academics_span_ratio < 16 }
		value = te_jmap_class_academics_span_ratio divide = 8 add = 2
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_academics_span_ratio < 32 }
		value = te_jmap_class_academics_span_ratio divide = 16 add = 3
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_academics_span_ratio < 64 }

		limit = { te_jmap_class_academics_span_ratio < 128 }

	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_academics_span_ratio < 256 }
		value = te_jmap_class_academics_span_ratio divide = 128 add = 6
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_academics_span_ratio < 512 }
		value = te_jmap_class_academics_span_ratio divide = 256 add = 7
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_academics_span_ratio < 1024 }
		value = te_jmap_class_academics_span_ratio divide = 512 add = 8
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_academics_span_ratio < 2048 }
		value = te_jmap_class_academics_span_ratio divide = 1024 add = 9
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_academics_span_ratio < 4096 }
		value = te_jmap_class_academics_span_ratio divide = 2048 add = 10
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_academics_span_ratio < 8192 }
		value = te_jmap_class_academics_span_ratio divide = 4096 add = 11
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_academics_span_ratio < 16384 }
		value = te_jmap_class_academics_span_ratio divide = 8192 add = 12
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_academics_span_ratio < 32768 }
		value = te_jmap_class_academics_span_ratio divide = 16384 add = 13
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_academics_span_ratio < 65536 }
		value = te_jmap_class_academics_span_ratio divide = 32768 add = 14
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_academics_span_ratio < 131072 }
		value = te_jmap_class_academics_span_ratio divide = 65536 add = 15
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_academics_span_ratio < 262144 }
		value = te_jmap_class_academics_span_ratio divide = 131072 add = 16
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_academics_span_ratio < 524288 }
		value = te_jmap_class_academics_span_ratio divide = 262144 add = 17
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_academics_span_ratio < 1048576 }
		value = te_jmap_class_academics_span_ratio divide = 524288 add = 18
	}
	else = {
		value = te_jmap_class_academics_span_ratio divide = 1048576 add = 19
	}
	min = 1
}
te_jmap_class_academics_span = {
	value = te_jmap_class_academics_hi
	subtract = te_jmap_class_academics_lo
}
te_jmap_class_academics_factor = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_dg_cls_academics }
		if = {
			limit = { te_jmap_scale = 0 }
			value = te_jmap_class_academics_log
			divide = te_jmap_class_academics_log_span
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { te_jmap_scale = 1 }
			value = var:te_dg_cls_academics
			subtract = te_jmap_class_academics_lo
			divide = te_jmap_class_academics_span
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { te_jmap_scale = 2 }
			value = te_jmap_class_academics_log
			divide = te_jmap_class_academics_log_span
		}
		else = {
			value = 0
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = te_jmap_rank }
				value = var:te_jmap_rank
			}
		}
	}
	min = 0
	max = 1
}

# Academics, their share of the state's people (the yearly walk's): half the color by a fifth of the world's range.
# Fitted to the world; before the first measure, 0 to 0.01.
te_jmap_class_academics_share_input = {
	value = te_jmap_share_academics
}
te_jmap_class_academics_share_input_neg = {
	value = te_jmap_class_academics_share_input
	multiply = -1
}
te_jmap_class_academics_share_lo = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = te_jmap_rng_class_academics_share_lo }
		value = global_var:te_jmap_rng_class_academics_share_lo
	}
}
te_jmap_class_academics_share_hi = {
	value = 0.01
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = te_jmap_rng_class_academics_share_hi }
		value = global_var:te_jmap_rng_class_academics_share_hi
	}
	min = te_jmap_class_academics_share_hi_floor
}
te_jmap_class_academics_share_hi_floor = {
	value = te_jmap_class_academics_share_lo
	add = 0.002
}
te_jmap_class_academics_share_span = {
	value = te_jmap_class_academics_share_hi
	subtract = te_jmap_class_academics_share_lo
}
te_jmap_class_academics_share_k1 = {
	value = te_jmap_class_academics_share_span
	multiply = 0.2
	add = te_jmap_class_academics_share_lo
}
te_jmap_class_academics_share_d0 = {
	value = te_jmap_class_academics_share_span
	multiply = 0.4
}
te_jmap_class_academics_share_d1 = {
	value = te_jmap_class_academics_share_span
	multiply = 1.6
}
te_jmap_class_academics_share_lg_min = {
	value = te_jmap_class_academics_share_hi
	divide = 64
}
te_jmap_class_academics_share_lg_r = {
	value = te_jmap_share_academics
	multiply = 64
	divide = te_jmap_class_academics_share_hi
	if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_academics_share_lo > te_jmap_class_academics_share_lg_min }
		value = te_jmap_share_academics
		divide = te_jmap_class_academics_share_lo
	}
}
te_jmap_class_academics_share_lg_t = {
	if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_academics_share_lg_r < 2 }
		value = te_jmap_class_academics_share_lg_r subtract = 1
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_academics_share_lg_r < 4 }
		value = te_jmap_class_academics_share_lg_r divide = 2
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_academics_share_lg_r < 8 }
		value = te_jmap_class_academics_share_lg_r divide = 4 add = 1
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_academics_share_lg_r < 16 }
		value = te_jmap_class_academics_share_lg_r divide = 8 add = 2
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_academics_share_lg_r < 32 }
		value = te_jmap_class_academics_share_lg_r divide = 16 add = 3
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_academics_share_lg_r < 64 }
		value = te_jmap_class_academics_share_lg_r divide = 32 add = 4
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_academics_share_lg_r < 128 }
		value = te_jmap_class_academics_share_lg_r divide = 64 add = 5
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_academics_share_lg_r < 256 }
		value = te_jmap_class_academics_share_lg_r divide = 128 add = 6
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_academics_share_lg_r < 512 }
		value = te_jmap_class_academics_share_lg_r divide = 256 add = 7
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_academics_share_lg_r < 1024 }
		value = te_jmap_class_academics_share_lg_r divide = 512 add = 8
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_academics_share_lg_r < 2048 }
		value = te_jmap_class_academics_share_lg_r divide = 1024 add = 9
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_academics_share_lg_r < 4096 }
		value = te_jmap_class_academics_share_lg_r divide = 2048 add = 10
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_academics_share_lg_r < 8192 }
		value = te_jmap_class_academics_share_lg_r divide = 4096 add = 11
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_academics_share_lg_r < 16384 }
		value = te_jmap_class_academics_share_lg_r divide = 8192 add = 12
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_academics_share_lg_r < 32768 }
		value = te_jmap_class_academics_share_lg_r divide = 16384 add = 13
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_academics_share_lg_r < 65536 }
		value = te_jmap_class_academics_share_lg_r divide = 32768 add = 14
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_academics_share_lg_r < 131072 }
		value = te_jmap_class_academics_share_lg_r divide = 65536 add = 15
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_academics_share_lg_r < 262144 }
		value = te_jmap_class_academics_share_lg_r divide = 131072 add = 16
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_academics_share_lg_r < 524288 }
		value = te_jmap_class_academics_share_lg_r divide = 262144 add = 17
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_academics_share_lg_r < 1048576 }
		value = te_jmap_class_academics_share_lg_r divide = 524288 add = 18
	}
	else = {
		value = te_jmap_class_academics_share_lg_r divide = 1048576 add = 19
	}
}
te_jmap_class_academics_share_lg_span_r = {
	value = 64
	if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_academics_share_lo > te_jmap_class_academics_share_lg_min }
		value = te_jmap_class_academics_share_hi
		divide = te_jmap_class_academics_share_lo
	}
}
te_jmap_class_academics_share_lg_top = {
	if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_academics_share_lg_span_r < 2 }
		value = te_jmap_class_academics_share_lg_span_r subtract = 1
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_academics_share_lg_span_r < 4 }
		value = te_jmap_class_academics_share_lg_span_r divide = 2
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_academics_share_lg_span_r < 8 }
		value = te_jmap_class_academics_share_lg_span_r divide = 4 add = 1
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_academics_share_lg_span_r < 16 }
		value = te_jmap_class_academics_share_lg_span_r divide = 8 add = 2
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_academics_share_lg_span_r < 32 }
		value = te_jmap_class_academics_share_lg_span_r divide = 16 add = 3
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_academics_share_lg_span_r < 64 }
		value = te_jmap_class_academics_share_lg_span_r divide = 32 add = 4
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_academics_share_lg_span_r < 128 }
		value = te_jmap_class_academics_share_lg_span_r divide = 64 add = 5
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_academics_share_lg_span_r < 256 }
		value = te_jmap_class_academics_share_lg_span_r divide = 128 add = 6
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_academics_share_lg_span_r < 512 }
		value = te_jmap_class_academics_share_lg_span_r divide = 256 add = 7
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_academics_share_lg_span_r < 1024 }
		value = te_jmap_class_academics_share_lg_span_r divide = 512 add = 8
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_academics_share_lg_span_r < 2048 }
		value = te_jmap_class_academics_share_lg_span_r divide = 1024 add = 9
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_academics_share_lg_span_r < 4096 }
		value = te_jmap_class_academics_share_lg_span_r divide = 2048 add = 10
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_academics_share_lg_span_r < 8192 }
		value = te_jmap_class_academics_share_lg_span_r divide = 4096 add = 11
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_academics_share_lg_span_r < 16384 }
		value = te_jmap_class_academics_share_lg_span_r divide = 8192 add = 12
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_academics_share_lg_span_r < 32768 }
		value = te_jmap_class_academics_share_lg_span_r divide = 16384 add = 13
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_academics_share_lg_span_r < 65536 }
		value = te_jmap_class_academics_share_lg_span_r divide = 32768 add = 14
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_academics_share_lg_span_r < 131072 }
		value = te_jmap_class_academics_share_lg_span_r divide = 65536 add = 15
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_academics_share_lg_span_r < 262144 }
		value = te_jmap_class_academics_share_lg_span_r divide = 131072 add = 16
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_academics_share_lg_span_r < 524288 }
		value = te_jmap_class_academics_share_lg_span_r divide = 262144 add = 17
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_academics_share_lg_span_r < 1048576 }
		value = te_jmap_class_academics_share_lg_span_r divide = 524288 add = 18
	}
	else = {
		value = te_jmap_class_academics_share_lg_span_r divide = 1048576 add = 19
	}
	min = 0.001
}
te_jmap_class_academics_share_factor = {
	if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_scale = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { te_jmap_share_academics < te_jmap_class_academics_share_k1 }
			value = te_jmap_share_academics subtract = te_jmap_class_academics_share_lo divide = te_jmap_class_academics_share_d0
		}
		else = {
			value = te_jmap_share_academics subtract = te_jmap_class_academics_share_k1 divide = te_jmap_class_academics_share_d1 add = 0.5
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_scale = 1 }
		value = te_jmap_share_academics
		subtract = te_jmap_class_academics_share_lo
		divide = te_jmap_class_academics_share_span
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_scale = 2 }
		value = te_jmap_class_academics_share_lg_t
		divide = te_jmap_class_academics_share_lg_top
	}
	else = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = te_jmap_rank }
			value = var:te_jmap_rank
		}
	}
	min = 0
	max = 1
}

# Clergymen, their people (the yearly walk's): the same share of the color for each doubling from the world's low (at least 10 people) to its high.
# A doubling at a time, fitted to the world; before the first measure, 250 to 32000.
te_jmap_class_clergymen_input = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_dg_cls_clergymen }
		value = var:te_dg_cls_clergymen
	}
}
te_jmap_class_clergymen_input_neg = {
	value = te_jmap_class_clergymen_input
	multiply = -1
}
te_jmap_class_clergymen_lo = {
	value = 250
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = te_jmap_rng_class_clergymen_lo }
		value = global_var:te_jmap_rng_class_clergymen_lo
	}
	min = 10
}
te_jmap_class_clergymen_hi = {
	value = 32000
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = te_jmap_rng_class_clergymen_hi }
		value = global_var:te_jmap_rng_class_clergymen_hi
	}
	min = te_jmap_class_clergymen_hi_floor
}
te_jmap_class_clergymen_hi_floor = {
	value = te_jmap_class_clergymen_lo
	multiply = 4
}
te_jmap_class_clergymen_ratio = {
	value = var:te_dg_cls_clergymen
	divide = te_jmap_class_clergymen_lo
}
te_jmap_class_clergymen_log = {
	if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_clergymen_ratio < 2 }
		value = te_jmap_class_clergymen_ratio subtract = 1
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_clergymen_ratio < 4 }
		value = te_jmap_class_clergymen_ratio divide = 2
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_clergymen_ratio < 8 }
		value = te_jmap_class_clergymen_ratio divide = 4 add = 1
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_clergymen_ratio < 16 }
		value = te_jmap_class_clergymen_ratio divide = 8 add = 2
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_clergymen_ratio < 32 }
		value = te_jmap_class_clergymen_ratio divide = 16 add = 3
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_clergymen_ratio < 64 }
		value = te_jmap_class_clergymen_ratio divide = 32 add = 4
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_clergymen_ratio < 128 }
		value = te_jmap_class_clergymen_ratio divide = 64 add = 5
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_clergymen_ratio < 256 }
		value = te_jmap_class_clergymen_ratio divide = 128 add = 6
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_clergymen_ratio < 512 }
		value = te_jmap_class_clergymen_ratio divide = 256 add = 7
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_clergymen_ratio < 1024 }
		value = te_jmap_class_clergymen_ratio divide = 512 add = 8
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_clergymen_ratio < 2048 }
		value = te_jmap_class_clergymen_ratio divide = 1024 add = 9
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_clergymen_ratio < 4096 }
		value = te_jmap_class_clergymen_ratio divide = 2048 add = 10
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_clergymen_ratio < 8192 }
		value = te_jmap_class_clergymen_ratio divide = 4096 add = 11
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_clergymen_ratio < 16384 }
		value = te_jmap_class_clergymen_ratio divide = 8192 add = 12
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_clergymen_ratio < 32768 }
		value = te_jmap_class_clergymen_ratio divide = 16384 add = 13
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_clergymen_ratio < 65536 }
		value = te_jmap_class_clergymen_ratio divide = 32768 add = 14
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_clergymen_ratio < 131072 }
		value = te_jmap_class_clergymen_ratio divide = 65536 add = 15
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_clergymen_ratio < 262144 }
		value = te_jmap_class_clergymen_ratio divide = 131072 add = 16
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_clergymen_ratio < 524288 }
		value = te_jmap_class_clergymen_ratio divide = 262144 add = 17
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_clergymen_ratio < 1048576 }
		value = te_jmap_class_clergymen_ratio divide = 524288 add = 18
	}
	else = {
		value = te_jmap_class_clergymen_ratio divide = 1048576 add = 19
	}
}
te_jmap_class_clergymen_span_ratio = {
	value = te_jmap_class_clergymen_hi
	divide = te_jmap_class_clergymen_lo
}

	if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_clergymen_span_ratio < 2 }

	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_clergymen_span_ratio < 4 }
		value = te_jmap_class_clergymen_span_ratio divide = 2
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_clergymen_span_ratio < 8 }
		value = te_jmap_class_clergymen_span_ratio divide = 4 add = 1
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_clergymen_span_ratio < 16 }

	else_if = {

	else_if = {

		value = te_jmap_class_clergymen_span_ratio divide = 2048 add = 10
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_clergymen_span_ratio < 8192 }
		value = te_jmap_class_clergymen_span_ratio divide = 4096 add = 11
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_clergymen_span_ratio < 16384 }
		value = te_jmap_class_clergymen_span_ratio divide = 8192 add = 12
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_clergymen_span_ratio < 32768 }
		value = te_jmap_class_clergymen_span_ratio divide = 16384 add = 13

	else_if = {

	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_clergymen_span_ratio < 262144 }
		value = te_jmap_class_clergymen_span_ratio divide = 131072 add = 16
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_clergymen_span_ratio < 524288 }
		value = te_jmap_class_clergymen_span_ratio divide = 262144 add = 17
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_clergymen_span_ratio < 1048576 }
		value = te_jmap_class_clergymen_span_ratio divide = 524288 add = 18
	}
	else = {
		value = te_jmap_class_clergymen_span_ratio divide = 1048576 add = 19
	}
	min = 1
}
te_jmap_class_clergymen_span = {
	value = te_jmap_class_clergymen_hi
	subtract = te_jmap_class_clergymen_lo
}
te_jmap_class_clergymen_factor = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_dg_cls_clergymen }
		if = {
			limit = { te_jmap_scale = 0 }
			value = te_jmap_class_clergymen_log
			divide = te_jmap_class_clergymen_log_span
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { te_jmap_scale = 1 }
			value = var:te_dg_cls_clergymen
			subtract = te_jmap_class_clergymen_lo
			divide = te_jmap_class_clergymen_span
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { te_jmap_scale = 2 }
			value = te_jmap_class_clergymen_log
			divide = te_jmap_class_clergymen_log_span
		}
		else = {
			value = 0
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = te_jmap_rank }
				value = var:te_jmap_rank
			}
		}
	}
	min = 0
	max = 1
}

# Clergymen, their share of the state's people (the yearly walk's).
# Fitted to the world; before the first measure, 0 to 0.04.
te_jmap_class_clergymen_share_input = {
	value = te_jmap_share_clergymen
}

	value = te_jmap_class_clergymen_share_input
	multiply = -1
}
te_jmap_class_clergymen_share_lo = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = te_jmap_rng_class_clergymen_share_lo }
		value = global_var:te_jmap_rng_class_clergymen_share_lo
	}
}
te_jmap_class_clergymen_share_hi = {
	value = 0.04
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = te_jmap_rng_class_clergymen_share_hi }
		value = global_var:te_jmap_rng_class_clergymen_share_hi
	}
	min = te_jmap_class_clergymen_share_hi_floor
}

	value = te_jmap_class_clergymen_share_lo
	add = 0.005
}
te_jmap_class_clergymen_share_span = {
	value = te_jmap_class_clergymen_share_hi
	subtract = te_jmap_class_clergymen_share_lo
}
te_jmap_class_clergymen_share_d0 = {
	value = te_jmap_class_clergymen_share_span
	multiply = 1
}

	value = te_jmap_class_clergymen_share_hi
	divide = 64
}
te_jmap_class_clergymen_share_lg_r = {

	multiply = 64
	divide = te_jmap_class_clergymen_share_hi

		limit = { te_jmap_class_clergymen_share_lo > te_jmap_class_clergymen_share_lg_min }
		value = te_jmap_share_clergymen
		divide = te_jmap_class_clergymen_share_lo
	}
}

		limit = { te_jmap_scale = 0 }
		value = te_jmap_share_clergymen subtract = te_jmap_class_clergymen_share_lo divide = te_jmap_class_clergymen_share_d0
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_scale = 1 }
		value = te_jmap_share_clergymen
		subtract = te_jmap_class_clergymen_share_lo
		divide = te_jmap_class_clergymen_share_span
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_scale = 2 }
		value = te_jmap_class_clergymen_share_lg_t
		divide = te_jmap_class_clergymen_share_lg_top
	}
	else = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = te_jmap_rank }
			value = var:te_jmap_rank
		}
	}
	min = 0
	max = 1
}

# Bureaucrats, their people (the yearly walk's): the same share of the color for each doubling from the world's low (at least 10 people) to its high.
# A doubling at a time, fitted to the world; before the first measure, 100 to 25600.
te_jmap_class_bureaucrats_input = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_dg_cls_bureaucrats }
		value = var:te_dg_cls_bureaucrats
	}
}
te_jmap_class_bureaucrats_input_neg = {
	value = te_jmap_class_bureaucrats_input
	multiply = -1
}
te_jmap_class_bureaucrats_lo = {
	value = 100
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = te_jmap_rng_class_bureaucrats_lo }
		value = global_var:te_jmap_rng_class_bureaucrats_lo
	}
	min = 10
}
te_jmap_class_bureaucrats_hi = {
	value = 25600
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = te_jmap_rng_class_bureaucrats_hi }
		value = global_var:te_jmap_rng_class_bureaucrats_hi
	}
	min = te_jmap_class_bureaucrats_hi_floor
}

	value = te_jmap_class_bureaucrats_lo
	multiply = 4
}

	value = var:te_dg_cls_bureaucrats
	divide = te_jmap_class_bureaucrats_lo
}

	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_bureaucrats_ratio < 16384 }
		value = te_jmap_class_bureaucrats_ratio divide = 8192 add = 12
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_bureaucrats_ratio < 32768 }
		value = te_jmap_class_bureaucrats_ratio divide = 16384 add = 13
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_bureaucrats_ratio < 65536 }
		value = te_jmap_class_bureaucrats_ratio divide = 32768 add = 14
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_bureaucrats_ratio < 131072 }
		value = te_jmap_class_bureaucrats_ratio divide = 65536 add = 15
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_bureaucrats_ratio < 262144 }
		value = te_jmap_class_bureaucrats_ratio divide = 131072 add = 16
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_bureaucrats_ratio < 524288 }
		value = te_jmap_class_bureaucrats_ratio divide = 262144 add = 17
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_bureaucrats_ratio < 1048576 }
		value = te_jmap_class_bureaucrats_ratio divide = 524288 add = 18
	}
	else = {
		value = te_jmap_class_bureaucrats_ratio divide = 1048576 add = 19
	}
}
te_jmap_class_bureaucrats_span_ratio = {
	value = te_jmap_class_bureaucrats_hi
	divide = te_jmap_class_bureaucrats_lo
}
te_jmap_class_bureaucrats_log_span = {
	if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_bureaucrats_span_ratio < 2 }
		value = te_jmap_class_bureaucrats_span_ratio subtract = 1
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_bureaucrats_span_ratio < 4 }
		value = te_jmap_class_bureaucrats_span_ratio divide = 2
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_bureaucrats_span_ratio < 8 }
		value = te_jmap_class_bureaucrats_span_ratio divide = 4 add = 1
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_bureaucrats_span_ratio < 16 }
		value = te_jmap_class_bureaucrats_span_ratio divide = 8 add = 2
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_bureaucrats_span_ratio < 32 }
		value = te_jmap_class_bureaucrats_span_ratio divide = 16 add = 3
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_bureaucrats_span_ratio < 64 }
		value = te_jmap_class_bureaucrats_span_ratio divide = 32 add = 4
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_bureaucrats_span_ratio < 128 }
		value = te_jmap_class_bureaucrats_span_ratio divide = 64 add = 5
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_bureaucrats_span_ratio < 256 }
		value = te_jmap_class_bureaucrats_span_ratio divide = 128 add = 6
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_bureaucrats_span_ratio < 512 }
		value = te_jmap_class_bureaucrats_span_ratio divide = 256 add = 7
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_bureaucrats_span_ratio < 1024 }
		value = te_jmap_class_bureaucrats_span_ratio divide = 512 add = 8
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_bureaucrats_span_ratio < 2048 }
		value = te_jmap_class_bureaucrats_span_ratio divide = 1024 add = 9
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_bureaucrats_span_ratio < 4096 }
		value = te_jmap_class_bureaucrats_span_ratio divide = 2048 add = 10
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_bureaucrats_span_ratio < 8192 }
		value = te_jmap_class_bureaucrats_span_ratio divide = 4096 add = 11
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_bureaucrats_span_ratio < 16384 }
		value = te_jmap_class_bureaucrats_span_ratio divide = 8192 add = 12
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_bureaucrats_span_ratio < 32768 }
		value = te_jmap_class_bureaucrats_span_ratio divide = 16384 add = 13
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_bureaucrats_span_ratio < 65536 }
		value = te_jmap_class_bureaucrats_span_ratio divide = 32768 add = 14
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_bureaucrats_span_ratio < 131072 }
		value = te_jmap_class_bureaucrats_span_ratio divide = 65536 add = 15
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_bureaucrats_span_ratio < 262144 }
		value = te_jmap_class_bureaucrats_span_ratio divide = 131072 add = 16
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_bureaucrats_span_ratio < 524288 }
		value = te_jmap_class_bureaucrats_span_ratio divide = 262144 add = 17
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_bureaucrats_span_ratio < 1048576 }
		value = te_jmap_class_bureaucrats_span_ratio divide = 524288 add = 18
	}
	else = {
		value = te_jmap_class_bureaucrats_span_ratio divide = 1048576 add = 19
	}
	min = 1
}
te_jmap_class_bureaucrats_span = {
	value = te_jmap_class_bureaucrats_hi
	subtract = te_jmap_class_bureaucrats_lo
}
te_jmap_class_bureaucrats_factor = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_dg_cls_bureaucrats }
		if = {
			limit = { te_jmap_scale = 0 }
			value = te_jmap_class_bureaucrats_log
			divide = te_jmap_class_bureaucrats_log_span
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { te_jmap_scale = 1 }
			value = var:te_dg_cls_bureaucrats
			subtract = te_jmap_class_bureaucrats_lo
			divide = te_jmap_class_bureaucrats_span
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { te_jmap_scale = 2 }
			value = te_jmap_class_bureaucrats_log
			divide = te_jmap_class_bureaucrats_log_span
		}
		else = {
			value = 0
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = te_jmap_rank }
				value = var:te_jmap_rank
			}
		}
	}
	min = 0
	max = 1
}

# Bureaucrats, their share of the state's people (the yearly walk's).
# Fitted to the world; before the first measure, 0 to 0.02.
te_jmap_class_bureaucrats_share_input = {
	value = te_jmap_share_bureaucrats
}
te_jmap_class_bureaucrats_share_input_neg = {
	value = te_jmap_class_bureaucrats_share_input
	multiply = -1
}
te_jmap_class_bureaucrats_share_lo = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = te_jmap_rng_class_bureaucrats_share_lo }
		value = global_var:te_jmap_rng_class_bureaucrats_share_lo
	}
}
te_jmap_class_bureaucrats_share_hi = {
	value = 0.02
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = te_jmap_rng_class_bureaucrats_share_hi }
		value = global_var:te_jmap_rng_class_bureaucrats_share_hi
	}
	min = te_jmap_class_bureaucrats_share_hi_floor
}
te_jmap_class_bureaucrats_share_hi_floor = {
	value = te_jmap_class_bureaucrats_share_lo
	add = 0.003
}
te_jmap_class_bureaucrats_share_span = {
	value = te_jmap_class_bureaucrats_share_hi
	subtract = te_jmap_class_bureaucrats_share_lo
}
te_jmap_class_bureaucrats_share_d0 = {
	value = te_jmap_class_bureaucrats_share_span
	multiply = 1
}
te_jmap_class_bureaucrats_share_lg_min = {
	value = te_jmap_class_bureaucrats_share_hi
	divide = 64
}
te_jmap_class_bureaucrats_share_lg_r = {
	value = te_jmap_share_bureaucrats
	multiply = 64
	divide = te_jmap_class_bureaucrats_share_hi
	if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_bureaucrats_share_lo > te_jmap_class_bureaucrats_share_lg_min }
		value = te_jmap_share_bureaucrats
		divide = te_jmap_class_bureaucrats_share_lo
	}
}

		limit = { te_jmap_scale = 0 }
		value = te_jmap_share_bureaucrats subtract = te_jmap_class_bureaucrats_share_lo divide = te_jmap_class_bureaucrats_share_d0
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_scale = 1 }
		value = te_jmap_share_bureaucrats
		subtract = te_jmap_class_bureaucrats_share_lo
		divide = te_jmap_class_bureaucrats_share_span
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_scale = 2 }
		value = te_jmap_class_bureaucrats_share_lg_t
		divide = te_jmap_class_bureaucrats_share_lg_top
	}
	else = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = te_jmap_rank }
			value = var:te_jmap_rank
		}
	}
	min = 0
	max = 1
}

# Engineers, their people (the yearly walk's): the same share of the color for each doubling from the world's low (at least 10 people) to its high.
# A doubling at a time, fitted to the world; before the first measure, 25 to 6400.
te_jmap_class_engineers_input = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_dg_cls_engineers }
		value = var:te_dg_cls_engineers
	}
}
te_jmap_class_engineers_input_neg = {
	value = te_jmap_class_engineers_input
	multiply = -1
}
te_jmap_class_engineers_lo = {
	value = 25
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = te_jmap_rng_class_engineers_lo }
		value = global_var:te_jmap_rng_class_engineers_lo
	}
	min = 10
}
te_jmap_class_engineers_hi = {
	value = 6400
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = te_jmap_rng_class_engineers_hi }
		value = global_var:te_jmap_rng_class_engineers_hi
	}
	min = te_jmap_class_engineers_hi_floor
}
te_jmap_class_engineers_hi_floor = {
	value = te_jmap_class_engineers_lo
	multiply = 4
}
te_jmap_class_engineers_ratio = {
	value = var:te_dg_cls_engineers
	divide = te_jmap_class_engineers_lo
}
te_jmap_class_engineers_log = {
	if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_engineers_ratio < 2 }
		value = te_jmap_class_engineers_ratio subtract = 1
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_engineers_ratio < 4 }
		value = te_jmap_class_engineers_ratio divide = 2
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_engineers_ratio < 8 }
		value = te_jmap_class_engineers_ratio divide = 4 add = 1
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_engineers_ratio < 16 }
		value = te_jmap_class_engineers_ratio divide = 8 add = 2
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_engineers_ratio < 32 }
		value = te_jmap_class_engineers_ratio divide = 16 add = 3
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_engineers_ratio < 64 }
		value = te_jmap_class_engineers_ratio divide = 32 add = 4
	}

		limit = { te_jmap_class_engineers_ratio < 128 }

		limit = { te_jmap_class_engineers_ratio < 512 }
		value = te_jmap_class_engineers_ratio divide = 256 add = 7
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_engineers_ratio < 1024 }
		value = te_jmap_class_engineers_ratio divide = 512 add = 8
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_engineers_ratio < 2048 }
		value = te_jmap_class_engineers_ratio divide = 1024 add = 9
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_engineers_ratio < 4096 }
		value = te_jmap_class_engineers_ratio divide = 2048 add = 10
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_engineers_ratio < 8192 }
		value = te_jmap_class_engineers_ratio divide = 4096 add = 11
	}

		limit = { te_jmap_class_engineers_ratio < 16384 }

	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_engineers_ratio < 32768 }
		value = te_jmap_class_engineers_ratio divide = 16384 add = 13
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_engineers_ratio < 65536 }
		value = te_jmap_class_engineers_ratio divide = 32768 add = 14
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_engineers_ratio < 131072 }
		value = te_jmap_class_engineers_ratio divide = 65536 add = 15
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_engineers_ratio < 262144 }
		value = te_jmap_class_engineers_ratio divide = 131072 add = 16
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_engineers_ratio < 524288 }
		value = te_jmap_class_engineers_ratio divide = 262144 add = 17
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_engineers_ratio < 1048576 }
		value = te_jmap_class_engineers_ratio divide = 524288 add = 18
	}
	else = {
		value = te_jmap_class_engineers_ratio divide = 1048576 add = 19
	}
}
te_jmap_class_engineers_span_ratio = {
	value = te_jmap_class_engineers_hi
	divide = te_jmap_class_engineers_lo
}
te_jmap_class_engineers_log_span = {
	if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_engineers_span_ratio < 2 }
		value = te_jmap_class_engineers_span_ratio subtract = 1
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_engineers_span_ratio < 4 }
		value = te_jmap_class_engineers_span_ratio divide = 2
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_engineers_span_ratio < 8 }
		value = te_jmap_class_engineers_span_ratio divide = 4 add = 1
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_engineers_span_ratio < 16 }
		value = te_jmap_class_engineers_span_ratio divide = 8 add = 2
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_engineers_span_ratio < 32 }
		value = te_jmap_class_engineers_span_ratio divide = 16 add = 3
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_engineers_span_ratio < 64 }
		value = te_jmap_class_engineers_span_ratio divide = 32 add = 4
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_engineers_span_ratio < 128 }
		value = te_jmap_class_engineers_span_ratio divide = 64 add = 5
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_engineers_span_ratio < 256 }
		value = te_jmap_class_engineers_span_ratio divide = 128 add = 6
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_engineers_span_ratio < 512 }
		value = te_jmap_class_engineers_span_ratio divide = 256 add = 7
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_engineers_span_ratio < 1024 }
		value = te_jmap_class_engineers_span_ratio divide = 512 add = 8
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_engineers_span_ratio < 2048 }
		value = te_jmap_class_engineers_span_ratio divide = 1024 add = 9
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_engineers_span_ratio < 4096 }
		value = te_jmap_class_engineers_span_ratio divide = 2048 add = 10
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_engineers_span_ratio < 8192 }
		value = te_jmap_class_engineers_span_ratio divide = 4096 add = 11
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_engineers_span_ratio < 16384 }
		value = te_jmap_class_engineers_span_ratio divide = 8192 add = 12
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_engineers_span_ratio < 32768 }
		value = te_jmap_class_engineers_span_ratio divide = 16384 add = 13
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_engineers_span_ratio < 65536 }
		value = te_jmap_class_engineers_span_ratio divide = 32768 add = 14
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_engineers_span_ratio < 131072 }
		value = te_jmap_class_engineers_span_ratio divide = 65536 add = 15
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_engineers_span_ratio < 262144 }
		value = te_jmap_class_engineers_span_ratio divide = 131072 add = 16
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_engineers_span_ratio < 524288 }
		value = te_jmap_class_engineers_span_ratio divide = 262144 add = 17
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_engineers_span_ratio < 1048576 }
		value = te_jmap_class_engineers_span_ratio divide = 524288 add = 18
	}
	else = {
		value = te_jmap_class_engineers_span_ratio divide = 1048576 add = 19
	}
	min = 1
}
te_jmap_class_engineers_span = {
	value = te_jmap_class_engineers_hi
	subtract = te_jmap_class_engineers_lo
}
te_jmap_class_engineers_factor = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_dg_cls_engineers }
		if = {
			limit = { te_jmap_scale = 0 }
			value = te_jmap_class_engineers_log
			divide = te_jmap_class_engineers_log_span
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { te_jmap_scale = 1 }
			value = var:te_dg_cls_engineers
			subtract = te_jmap_class_engineers_lo
			divide = te_jmap_class_engineers_span
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { te_jmap_scale = 2 }
			value = te_jmap_class_engineers_log
			divide = te_jmap_class_engineers_log_span
		}
		else = {
			value = 0
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = te_jmap_rank }
				value = var:te_jmap_rank
			}
		}
	}
	min = 0
	max = 1
}

# Engineers, their share of the state's people (the yearly walk's): half the color by a fifth of the world's range.
# Fitted to the world; before the first measure, 0 to 0.03.
te_jmap_class_engineers_share_input = {
	value = te_jmap_share_engineers
}
te_jmap_class_engineers_share_input_neg = {
	value = te_jmap_class_engineers_share_input
	multiply = -1
}
te_jmap_class_engineers_share_lo = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = te_jmap_rng_class_engineers_share_lo }
		value = global_var:te_jmap_rng_class_engineers_share_lo
	}
}
te_jmap_class_engineers_share_hi = {
	value = 0.03
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = te_jmap_rng_class_engineers_share_hi }
		value = global_var:te_jmap_rng_class_engineers_share_hi
	}
	min = te_jmap_class_engineers_share_hi_floor
}
te_jmap_class_engineers_share_hi_floor = {
	value = te_jmap_class_engineers_share_lo
	add = 0.002
}
te_jmap_class_engineers_share_span = {
	value = te_jmap_class_engineers_share_hi
	subtract = te_jmap_class_engineers_share_lo
}
te_jmap_class_engineers_share_k1 = {
	value = te_jmap_class_engineers_share_span
	multiply = 0.2
	add = te_jmap_class_engineers_share_lo
}
te_jmap_class_engineers_share_d0 = {
	value = te_jmap_class_engineers_share_span
	multiply = 0.4
}
te_jmap_class_engineers_share_d1 = {
	value = te_jmap_class_engineers_share_span
	multiply = 1.6
}
te_jmap_class_engineers_share_lg_min = {
	value = te_jmap_class_engineers_share_hi
	divide = 64
}
te_jmap_class_engineers_share_lg_r = {
	value = te_jmap_share_engineers
	multiply = 64
	divide = te_jmap_class_engineers_share_hi
	if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_engineers_share_lo > te_jmap_class_engineers_share_lg_min }
		value = te_jmap_share_engineers
		divide = te_jmap_class_engineers_share_lo
	}
}
te_jmap_class_engineers_share_lg_t = {
	if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_engineers_share_lg_r < 2 }
		value = te_jmap_class_engineers_share_lg_r subtract = 1
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_engineers_share_lg_r < 4 }
		value = te_jmap_class_engineers_share_lg_r divide = 2
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_engineers_share_lg_r < 8 }
		value = te_jmap_class_engineers_share_lg_r divide = 4 add = 1
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_engineers_share_lg_r < 16 }
		value = te_jmap_class_engineers_share_lg_r divide = 8 add = 2
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_engineers_share_lg_r < 32 }
		value = te_jmap_class_engineers_share_lg_r divide = 16 add = 3
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_engineers_share_lg_r < 64 }
		value = te_jmap_class_engineers_share_lg_r divide = 32 add = 4
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_engineers_share_lg_r < 128 }
		value = te_jmap_class_engineers_share_lg_r divide = 64 add = 5
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_engineers_share_lg_r < 256 }
		value = te_jmap_class_engineers_share_lg_r divide = 128 add = 6
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_engineers_share_lg_r < 512 }
		value = te_jmap_class_engineers_share_lg_r divide = 256 add = 7
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_engineers_share_lg_r < 1024 }
		value = te_jmap_class_engineers_share_lg_r divide = 512 add = 8
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_engineers_share_lg_r < 2048 }
		value = te_jmap_class_engineers_share_lg_r divide = 1024 add = 9
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_engineers_share_lg_r < 4096 }
		value = te_jmap_class_engineers_share_lg_r divide = 2048 add = 10
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_engineers_share_lg_r < 8192 }
		value = te_jmap_class_engineers_share_lg_r divide = 4096 add = 11
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_engineers_share_lg_r < 16384 }
		value = te_jmap_class_engineers_share_lg_r divide = 8192 add = 12
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_engineers_share_lg_r < 32768 }
		value = te_jmap_class_engineers_share_lg_r divide = 16384 add = 13
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_engineers_share_lg_r < 65536 }
		value = te_jmap_class_engineers_share_lg_r divide = 32768 add = 14
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_engineers_share_lg_r < 131072 }
		value = te_jmap_class_engineers_share_lg_r divide = 65536 add = 15
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_engineers_share_lg_r < 262144 }
		value = te_jmap_class_engineers_share_lg_r divide = 131072 add = 16
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_engineers_share_lg_r < 524288 }
		value = te_jmap_class_engineers_share_lg_r divide = 262144 add = 17
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_engineers_share_lg_r < 1048576 }
		value = te_jmap_class_engineers_share_lg_r divide = 524288 add = 18
	}
	else = {
		value = te_jmap_class_engineers_share_lg_r divide = 1048576 add = 19
	}
}
te_jmap_class_engineers_share_lg_span_r = {
	value = 64
	if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_engineers_share_lo > te_jmap_class_engineers_share_lg_min }
		value = te_jmap_class_engineers_share_hi
		divide = te_jmap_class_engineers_share_lo
	}
}
te_jmap_class_engineers_share_lg_top = {
	if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_engineers_share_lg_span_r < 2 }
		value = te_jmap_class_engineers_share_lg_span_r subtract = 1
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_engineers_share_lg_span_r < 4 }
		value = te_jmap_class_engineers_share_lg_span_r divide = 2
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_engineers_share_lg_span_r < 8 }
		value = te_jmap_class_engineers_share_lg_span_r divide = 4 add = 1
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_engineers_share_lg_span_r < 16 }
		value = te_jmap_class_engineers_share_lg_span_r divide = 8 add = 2
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_engineers_share_lg_span_r < 32 }
		value = te_jmap_class_engineers_share_lg_span_r divide = 16 add = 3
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_engineers_share_lg_span_r < 64 }
		value = te_jmap_class_engineers_share_lg_span_r divide = 32 add = 4
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_engineers_share_lg_span_r < 128 }
		value = te_jmap_class_engineers_share_lg_span_r divide = 64 add = 5
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_engineers_share_lg_span_r < 256 }
		value = te_jmap_class_engineers_share_lg_span_r divide = 128 add = 6
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_engineers_share_lg_span_r < 512 }
		value = te_jmap_class_engineers_share_lg_span_r divide = 256 add = 7
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_engineers_share_lg_span_r < 1024 }
		value = te_jmap_class_engineers_share_lg_span_r divide = 512 add = 8
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_engineers_share_lg_span_r < 2048 }
		value = te_jmap_class_engineers_share_lg_span_r divide = 1024 add = 9
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_engineers_share_lg_span_r < 4096 }
		value = te_jmap_class_engineers_share_lg_span_r divide = 2048 add = 10
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_engineers_share_lg_span_r < 8192 }
		value = te_jmap_class_engineers_share_lg_span_r divide = 4096 add = 11
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_engineers_share_lg_span_r < 16384 }
		value = te_jmap_class_engineers_share_lg_span_r divide = 8192 add = 12
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_engineers_share_lg_span_r < 32768 }
		value = te_jmap_class_engineers_share_lg_span_r divide = 16384 add = 13
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_engineers_share_lg_span_r < 65536 }
		value = te_jmap_class_engineers_share_lg_span_r divide = 32768 add = 14
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_engineers_share_lg_span_r < 131072 }
		value = te_jmap_class_engineers_share_lg_span_r divide = 65536 add = 15
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_engineers_share_lg_span_r < 262144 }
		value = te_jmap_class_engineers_share_lg_span_r divide = 131072 add = 16
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_engineers_share_lg_span_r < 524288 }
		value = te_jmap_class_engineers_share_lg_span_r divide = 262144 add = 17
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_engineers_share_lg_span_r < 1048576 }
		value = te_jmap_class_engineers_share_lg_span_r divide = 524288 add = 18
	}
	else = {
		value = te_jmap_class_engineers_share_lg_span_r divide = 1048576 add = 19
	}
	min = 0.001
}
te_jmap_class_engineers_share_factor = {
	if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_scale = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { te_jmap_share_engineers < te_jmap_class_engineers_share_k1 }
			value = te_jmap_share_engineers subtract = te_jmap_class_engineers_share_lo divide = te_jmap_class_engineers_share_d0
		}
		else = {
			value = te_jmap_share_engineers subtract = te_jmap_class_engineers_share_k1 divide = te_jmap_class_engineers_share_d1 add = 0.5
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_scale = 1 }
		value = te_jmap_share_engineers
		subtract = te_jmap_class_engineers_share_lo
		divide = te_jmap_class_engineers_share_span
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_scale = 2 }
		value = te_jmap_class_engineers_share_lg_t
		divide = te_jmap_class_engineers_share_lg_top
	}
	else = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = te_jmap_rank }
			value = var:te_jmap_rank
		}
	}
	min = 0
	max = 1
}

# Machinists, their people (the yearly walk's): the same share of the color for each doubling from the world's low (at least 10 people) to its high.
# A doubling at a time, fitted to the world; before the first measure, 250 to 64000.

	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_dg_cls_machinists }

	}
