		value = te_jmap_class_machinists_span_ratio divide = 16 add = 3
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_machinists_span_ratio < 64 }
		value = te_jmap_class_machinists_span_ratio divide = 32 add = 4
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_machinists_span_ratio < 128 }
		value = te_jmap_class_machinists_span_ratio divide = 64 add = 5
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_machinists_span_ratio < 256 }
		value = te_jmap_class_machinists_span_ratio divide = 128 add = 6
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_machinists_span_ratio < 512 }
		value = te_jmap_class_machinists_span_ratio divide = 256 add = 7
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_machinists_span_ratio < 1024 }
		value = te_jmap_class_machinists_span_ratio divide = 512 add = 8
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_machinists_span_ratio < 2048 }
		value = te_jmap_class_machinists_span_ratio divide = 1024 add = 9
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_machinists_span_ratio < 4096 }
		value = te_jmap_class_machinists_span_ratio divide = 2048 add = 10
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_machinists_span_ratio < 8192 }
		value = te_jmap_class_machinists_span_ratio divide = 4096 add = 11
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_machinists_span_ratio < 16384 }
		value = te_jmap_class_machinists_span_ratio divide = 8192 add = 12
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_machinists_span_ratio < 32768 }
		value = te_jmap_class_machinists_span_ratio divide = 16384 add = 13
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_machinists_span_ratio < 65536 }
		value = te_jmap_class_machinists_span_ratio divide = 32768 add = 14
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_machinists_span_ratio < 131072 }
		value = te_jmap_class_machinists_span_ratio divide = 65536 add = 15
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_machinists_span_ratio < 262144 }
		value = te_jmap_class_machinists_span_ratio divide = 131072 add = 16
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_machinists_span_ratio < 524288 }
		value = te_jmap_class_machinists_span_ratio divide = 262144 add = 17
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_machinists_span_ratio < 1048576 }
		value = te_jmap_class_machinists_span_ratio divide = 524288 add = 18
	}
	else = {
		value = te_jmap_class_machinists_span_ratio divide = 1048576 add = 19
	}
	min = 1
}
te_jmap_class_machinists_span = {
	value = te_jmap_class_machinists_hi
	subtract = te_jmap_class_machinists_lo
}
te_jmap_class_machinists_factor = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_dg_cls_machinists }
		if = {
			limit = { te_jmap_scale = 0 }
			value = te_jmap_class_machinists_log
			divide = te_jmap_class_machinists_log_span
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { te_jmap_scale = 1 }
			value = var:te_dg_cls_machinists
			subtract = te_jmap_class_machinists_lo
			divide = te_jmap_class_machinists_span
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { te_jmap_scale = 2 }
			value = te_jmap_class_machinists_log
			divide = te_jmap_class_machinists_log_span
		}
		else = {
			value = 0
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = te_jmap_rank }
				value = var:te_jmap_rank
			}
		}
	}
	min = 0
	max = 1
}

# Machinists, their share of the state's people (the yearly walk's): half the color by a fifth of the world's range.
# Fitted to the world; before the first measure, 0 to 0.2.
te_jmap_class_machinists_share_input = {
	value = te_jmap_share_machinists
}
te_jmap_class_machinists_share_input_neg = {
	value = te_jmap_class_machinists_share_input
	multiply = -1
}
te_jmap_class_machinists_share_lo = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = te_jmap_rng_class_machinists_share_lo }
		value = global_var:te_jmap_rng_class_machinists_share_lo
	}
}
te_jmap_class_machinists_share_hi = {
	value = 0.2
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = te_jmap_rng_class_machinists_share_hi }
		value = global_var:te_jmap_rng_class_machinists_share_hi
	}
	min = te_jmap_class_machinists_share_hi_floor
}
te_jmap_class_machinists_share_hi_floor = {
	value = te_jmap_class_machinists_share_lo
	add = 0.01
}
te_jmap_class_machinists_share_span = {
	value = te_jmap_class_machinists_share_hi
	subtract = te_jmap_class_machinists_share_lo
}
te_jmap_class_machinists_share_k1 = {
	value = te_jmap_class_machinists_share_span
	multiply = 0.2
	add = te_jmap_class_machinists_share_lo
}
te_jmap_class_machinists_share_d0 = {
	value = te_jmap_class_machinists_share_span
	multiply = 0.4
}
te_jmap_class_machinists_share_d1 = {
	value = te_jmap_class_machinists_share_span
	multiply = 1.6
}
te_jmap_class_machinists_share_lg_min = {
	value = te_jmap_class_machinists_share_hi
	divide = 64
}
te_jmap_class_machinists_share_lg_r = {
	value = te_jmap_share_machinists
	multiply = 64
	divide = te_jmap_class_machinists_share_hi
	if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_machinists_share_lo > te_jmap_class_machinists_share_lg_min }
		value = te_jmap_share_machinists
		divide = te_jmap_class_machinists_share_lo
	}
}
te_jmap_class_machinists_share_lg_t = {
	if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_machinists_share_lg_r < 2 }
		value = te_jmap_class_machinists_share_lg_r subtract = 1
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_machinists_share_lg_r < 4 }
		value = te_jmap_class_machinists_share_lg_r divide = 2
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_machinists_share_lg_r < 8 }
		value = te_jmap_class_machinists_share_lg_r divide = 4 add = 1
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_machinists_share_lg_r < 16 }
		value = te_jmap_class_machinists_share_lg_r divide = 8 add = 2
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_machinists_share_lg_r < 32 }
		value = te_jmap_class_machinists_share_lg_r divide = 16 add = 3
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_machinists_share_lg_r < 64 }
		value = te_jmap_class_machinists_share_lg_r divide = 32 add = 4
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_machinists_share_lg_r < 128 }
		value = te_jmap_class_machinists_share_lg_r divide = 64 add = 5
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_machinists_share_lg_r < 256 }
		value = te_jmap_class_machinists_share_lg_r divide = 128 add = 6
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_machinists_share_lg_r < 512 }
		value = te_jmap_class_machinists_share_lg_r divide = 256 add = 7
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_machinists_share_lg_r < 1024 }
		value = te_jmap_class_machinists_share_lg_r divide = 512 add = 8
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_machinists_share_lg_r < 2048 }
		value = te_jmap_class_machinists_share_lg_r divide = 1024 add = 9
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_machinists_share_lg_r < 4096 }
		value = te_jmap_class_machinists_share_lg_r divide = 2048 add = 10
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_machinists_share_lg_r < 8192 }
		value = te_jmap_class_machinists_share_lg_r divide = 4096 add = 11
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_machinists_share_lg_r < 16384 }
		value = te_jmap_class_machinists_share_lg_r divide = 8192 add = 12
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_machinists_share_lg_r < 32768 }
		value = te_jmap_class_machinists_share_lg_r divide = 16384 add = 13
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_machinists_share_lg_r < 65536 }
		value = te_jmap_class_machinists_share_lg_r divide = 32768 add = 14
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_machinists_share_lg_r < 131072 }
		value = te_jmap_class_machinists_share_lg_r divide = 65536 add = 15
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_machinists_share_lg_r < 262144 }
		value = te_jmap_class_machinists_share_lg_r divide = 131072 add = 16
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_machinists_share_lg_r < 524288 }
		value = te_jmap_class_machinists_share_lg_r divide = 262144 add = 17
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_machinists_share_lg_r < 1048576 }
		value = te_jmap_class_machinists_share_lg_r divide = 524288 add = 18
	}
	else = {
		value = te_jmap_class_machinists_share_lg_r divide = 1048576 add = 19
	}
}
te_jmap_class_machinists_share_lg_span_r = {
	value = 64
	if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_machinists_share_lo > te_jmap_class_machinists_share_lg_min }
		value = te_jmap_class_machinists_share_hi
		divide = te_jmap_class_machinists_share_lo
	}
}
te_jmap_class_machinists_share_lg_top = {
	if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_machinists_share_lg_span_r < 2 }
		value = te_jmap_class_machinists_share_lg_span_r subtract = 1
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_machinists_share_lg_span_r < 4 }
		value = te_jmap_class_machinists_share_lg_span_r divide = 2
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_machinists_share_lg_span_r < 8 }
		value = te_jmap_class_machinists_share_lg_span_r divide = 4 add = 1
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_machinists_share_lg_span_r < 16 }
		value = te_jmap_class_machinists_share_lg_span_r divide = 8 add = 2
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_machinists_share_lg_span_r < 32 }
		value = te_jmap_class_machinists_share_lg_span_r divide = 16 add = 3
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_machinists_share_lg_span_r < 64 }
		value = te_jmap_class_machinists_share_lg_span_r divide = 32 add = 4
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_machinists_share_lg_span_r < 128 }
		value = te_jmap_class_machinists_share_lg_span_r divide = 64 add = 5
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_machinists_share_lg_span_r < 256 }
		value = te_jmap_class_machinists_share_lg_span_r divide = 128 add = 6
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_machinists_share_lg_span_r < 512 }
		value = te_jmap_class_machinists_share_lg_span_r divide = 256 add = 7
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_machinists_share_lg_span_r < 1024 }
		value = te_jmap_class_machinists_share_lg_span_r divide = 512 add = 8
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_machinists_share_lg_span_r < 2048 }
		value = te_jmap_class_machinists_share_lg_span_r divide = 1024 add = 9
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_machinists_share_lg_span_r < 4096 }
		value = te_jmap_class_machinists_share_lg_span_r divide = 2048 add = 10
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_machinists_share_lg_span_r < 8192 }
		value = te_jmap_class_machinists_share_lg_span_r divide = 4096 add = 11
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_machinists_share_lg_span_r < 16384 }
		value = te_jmap_class_machinists_share_lg_span_r divide = 8192 add = 12
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_machinists_share_lg_span_r < 32768 }
		value = te_jmap_class_machinists_share_lg_span_r divide = 16384 add = 13
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_machinists_share_lg_span_r < 65536 }
		value = te_jmap_class_machinists_share_lg_span_r divide = 32768 add = 14
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_machinists_share_lg_span_r < 131072 }
		value = te_jmap_class_machinists_share_lg_span_r divide = 65536 add = 15
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_machinists_share_lg_span_r < 262144 }
		value = te_jmap_class_machinists_share_lg_span_r divide = 131072 add = 16
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_machinists_share_lg_span_r < 524288 }
		value = te_jmap_class_machinists_share_lg_span_r divide = 262144 add = 17
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_machinists_share_lg_span_r < 1048576 }
		value = te_jmap_class_machinists_share_lg_span_r divide = 524288 add = 18
	}
	else = {
		value = te_jmap_class_machinists_share_lg_span_r divide = 1048576 add = 19
	}
	min = 0.001
}
te_jmap_class_machinists_share_factor = {
	if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_scale = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { te_jmap_share_machinists < te_jmap_class_machinists_share_k1 }
			value = te_jmap_share_machinists subtract = te_jmap_class_machinists_share_lo divide = te_jmap_class_machinists_share_d0
		}
		else = {
			value = te_jmap_share_machinists subtract = te_jmap_class_machinists_share_k1 divide = te_jmap_class_machinists_share_d1 add = 0.5
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_scale = 1 }
		value = te_jmap_share_machinists
		subtract = te_jmap_class_machinists_share_lo
		divide = te_jmap_class_machinists_share_span
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_scale = 2 }
		value = te_jmap_class_machinists_share_lg_t
		divide = te_jmap_class_machinists_share_lg_top
	}
	else = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = te_jmap_rank }
			value = var:te_jmap_rank
		}
	}
	min = 0
	max = 1
}

# Laborers, their people (the yearly walk's): the same share of the color for each doubling from the world's low (at least 10 people) to its high.
# A doubling at a time, fitted to the world; before the first measure, 2000 to 512000.
te_jmap_class_laborers_input = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_dg_cls_laborers }
		value = var:te_dg_cls_laborers
	}
}
te_jmap_class_laborers_input_neg = {
	value = te_jmap_class_laborers_input
	multiply = -1
}
te_jmap_class_laborers_lo = {
	value = 2000
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = te_jmap_rng_class_laborers_lo }
		value = global_var:te_jmap_rng_class_laborers_lo
	}
	min = 10
}
te_jmap_class_laborers_hi = {
	value = 512000
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = te_jmap_rng_class_laborers_hi }
		value = global_var:te_jmap_rng_class_laborers_hi
	}
	min = te_jmap_class_laborers_hi_floor
}
te_jmap_class_laborers_hi_floor = {
	value = te_jmap_class_laborers_lo
	multiply = 4
}
te_jmap_class_laborers_ratio = {
	value = var:te_dg_cls_laborers
	divide = te_jmap_class_laborers_lo
}
te_jmap_class_laborers_log = {
	if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_laborers_ratio < 2 }
		value = te_jmap_class_laborers_ratio subtract = 1
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_laborers_ratio < 4 }
		value = te_jmap_class_laborers_ratio divide = 2
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_laborers_ratio < 8 }
		value = te_jmap_class_laborers_ratio divide = 4 add = 1
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_laborers_ratio < 16 }
		value = te_jmap_class_laborers_ratio divide = 8 add = 2
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_laborers_ratio < 32 }
		value = te_jmap_class_laborers_ratio divide = 16 add = 3
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_laborers_ratio < 64 }
		value = te_jmap_class_laborers_ratio divide = 32 add = 4
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_laborers_ratio < 128 }
		value = te_jmap_class_laborers_ratio divide = 64 add = 5
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_laborers_ratio < 256 }
		value = te_jmap_class_laborers_ratio divide = 128 add = 6
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_laborers_ratio < 512 }
		value = te_jmap_class_laborers_ratio divide = 256 add = 7
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_laborers_ratio < 1024 }
		value = te_jmap_class_laborers_ratio divide = 512 add = 8
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_laborers_ratio < 2048 }
		value = te_jmap_class_laborers_ratio divide = 1024 add = 9
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_laborers_ratio < 4096 }
		value = te_jmap_class_laborers_ratio divide = 2048 add = 10
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_laborers_ratio < 8192 }
		value = te_jmap_class_laborers_ratio divide = 4096 add = 11
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_laborers_ratio < 16384 }
		value = te_jmap_class_laborers_ratio divide = 8192 add = 12
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_laborers_ratio < 32768 }
		value = te_jmap_class_laborers_ratio divide = 16384 add = 13
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_laborers_ratio < 65536 }
		value = te_jmap_class_laborers_ratio divide = 32768 add = 14
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_laborers_ratio < 131072 }
		value = te_jmap_class_laborers_ratio divide = 65536 add = 15
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_laborers_ratio < 262144 }
		value = te_jmap_class_laborers_ratio divide = 131072 add = 16
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_laborers_ratio < 524288 }
		value = te_jmap_class_laborers_ratio divide = 262144 add = 17
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_laborers_ratio < 1048576 }
		value = te_jmap_class_laborers_ratio divide = 524288 add = 18
	}
	else = {
		value = te_jmap_class_laborers_ratio divide = 1048576 add = 19
	}
}
te_jmap_class_laborers_span_ratio = {
	value = te_jmap_class_laborers_hi
	divide = te_jmap_class_laborers_lo
}
te_jmap_class_laborers_log_span = {
	if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_laborers_span_ratio < 2 }
		value = te_jmap_class_laborers_span_ratio subtract = 1
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_laborers_span_ratio < 4 }

	}

	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_laborers_span_ratio < 1024 }
		value = te_jmap_class_laborers_span_ratio divide = 512 add = 8
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_laborers_span_ratio < 2048 }
		value = te_jmap_class_laborers_span_ratio divide = 1024 add = 9
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_laborers_span_ratio < 4096 }
		value = te_jmap_class_laborers_span_ratio divide = 2048 add = 10
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_laborers_span_ratio < 8192 }
		value = te_jmap_class_laborers_span_ratio divide = 4096 add = 11
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_laborers_span_ratio < 16384 }
		value = te_jmap_class_laborers_span_ratio divide = 8192 add = 12
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_laborers_span_ratio < 32768 }
		value = te_jmap_class_laborers_span_ratio divide = 16384 add = 13
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_laborers_span_ratio < 65536 }
		value = te_jmap_class_laborers_span_ratio divide = 32768 add = 14
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_laborers_span_ratio < 131072 }
		value = te_jmap_class_laborers_span_ratio divide = 65536 add = 15
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_laborers_span_ratio < 262144 }
		value = te_jmap_class_laborers_span_ratio divide = 131072 add = 16
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_laborers_span_ratio < 524288 }
		value = te_jmap_class_laborers_span_ratio divide = 262144 add = 17
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_laborers_span_ratio < 1048576 }
		value = te_jmap_class_laborers_span_ratio divide = 524288 add = 18
	}
	else = {
		value = te_jmap_class_laborers_span_ratio divide = 1048576 add = 19
	}
	min = 1
}
te_jmap_class_laborers_span = {
	value = te_jmap_class_laborers_hi
	subtract = te_jmap_class_laborers_lo
}
te_jmap_class_laborers_factor = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_dg_cls_laborers }
		if = {
			limit = { te_jmap_scale = 0 }
			value = te_jmap_class_laborers_log
			divide = te_jmap_class_laborers_log_span
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { te_jmap_scale = 1 }
			value = var:te_dg_cls_laborers
			subtract = te_jmap_class_laborers_lo
			divide = te_jmap_class_laborers_span
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { te_jmap_scale = 2 }
			value = te_jmap_class_laborers_log
			divide = te_jmap_class_laborers_log_span
		}
		else = {
			value = 0
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = te_jmap_rank }
				value = var:te_jmap_rank
			}
		}
	}
	min = 0
	max = 1
}

# Laborers, their share of the state's people (the yearly walk's).
# Fitted to the world; before the first measure, 0 to 0.5.
te_jmap_class_laborers_share_input = {
	value = te_jmap_share_laborers
}
te_jmap_class_laborers_share_input_neg = {
	value = te_jmap_class_laborers_share_input
	multiply = -1
}
te_jmap_class_laborers_share_lo = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = te_jmap_rng_class_laborers_share_lo }
		value = global_var:te_jmap_rng_class_laborers_share_lo
	}
}
te_jmap_class_laborers_share_hi = {
	value = 0.5
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = te_jmap_rng_class_laborers_share_hi }
		value = global_var:te_jmap_rng_class_laborers_share_hi
	}
	min = te_jmap_class_laborers_share_hi_floor
}
te_jmap_class_laborers_share_hi_floor = {
	value = te_jmap_class_laborers_share_lo
	add = 0.05
}
te_jmap_class_laborers_share_span = {
	value = te_jmap_class_laborers_share_hi
	subtract = te_jmap_class_laborers_share_lo
}
te_jmap_class_laborers_share_d0 = {
	value = te_jmap_class_laborers_share_span
	multiply = 1
}
te_jmap_class_laborers_share_lg_min = {
	value = te_jmap_class_laborers_share_hi
	divide = 64
}
te_jmap_class_laborers_share_lg_r = {
	value = te_jmap_share_laborers
	multiply = 64
	divide = te_jmap_class_laborers_share_hi
	if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_laborers_share_lo > te_jmap_class_laborers_share_lg_min }
		value = te_jmap_share_laborers
		divide = te_jmap_class_laborers_share_lo
	}
}
te_jmap_class_laborers_share_lg_t = {
	if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_laborers_share_lg_r < 2 }
		value = te_jmap_class_laborers_share_lg_r subtract = 1
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_laborers_share_lg_r < 4 }
		value = te_jmap_class_laborers_share_lg_r divide = 2
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_laborers_share_lg_r < 8 }
		value = te_jmap_class_laborers_share_lg_r divide = 4 add = 1
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_laborers_share_lg_r < 16 }
		value = te_jmap_class_laborers_share_lg_r divide = 8 add = 2
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_laborers_share_lg_r < 32 }
		value = te_jmap_class_laborers_share_lg_r divide = 16 add = 3
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_laborers_share_lg_r < 64 }
		value = te_jmap_class_laborers_share_lg_r divide = 32 add = 4
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_laborers_share_lg_r < 128 }
		value = te_jmap_class_laborers_share_lg_r divide = 64 add = 5
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_laborers_share_lg_r < 256 }
		value = te_jmap_class_laborers_share_lg_r divide = 128 add = 6
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_laborers_share_lg_r < 512 }
		value = te_jmap_class_laborers_share_lg_r divide = 256 add = 7
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_laborers_share_lg_r < 1024 }
		value = te_jmap_class_laborers_share_lg_r divide = 512 add = 8
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_laborers_share_lg_r < 2048 }
		value = te_jmap_class_laborers_share_lg_r divide = 1024 add = 9
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_laborers_share_lg_r < 4096 }
		value = te_jmap_class_laborers_share_lg_r divide = 2048 add = 10
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_laborers_share_lg_r < 8192 }
		value = te_jmap_class_laborers_share_lg_r divide = 4096 add = 11
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_laborers_share_lg_r < 16384 }
		value = te_jmap_class_laborers_share_lg_r divide = 8192 add = 12
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_laborers_share_lg_r < 32768 }
		value = te_jmap_class_laborers_share_lg_r divide = 16384 add = 13
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_laborers_share_lg_r < 65536 }
		value = te_jmap_class_laborers_share_lg_r divide = 32768 add = 14
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_laborers_share_lg_r < 131072 }
		value = te_jmap_class_laborers_share_lg_r divide = 65536 add = 15
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_laborers_share_lg_r < 262144 }
		value = te_jmap_class_laborers_share_lg_r divide = 131072 add = 16
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_laborers_share_lg_r < 524288 }
		value = te_jmap_class_laborers_share_lg_r divide = 262144 add = 17
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_laborers_share_lg_r < 1048576 }
		value = te_jmap_class_laborers_share_lg_r divide = 524288 add = 18
	}
	else = {
		value = te_jmap_class_laborers_share_lg_r divide = 1048576 add = 19
	}
}
te_jmap_class_laborers_share_lg_span_r = {
	value = 64
	if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_laborers_share_lo > te_jmap_class_laborers_share_lg_min }
		value = te_jmap_class_laborers_share_hi
		divide = te_jmap_class_laborers_share_lo
	}
}
te_jmap_class_laborers_share_lg_top = {
	if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_laborers_share_lg_span_r < 2 }
		value = te_jmap_class_laborers_share_lg_span_r subtract = 1
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_laborers_share_lg_span_r < 4 }
		value = te_jmap_class_laborers_share_lg_span_r divide = 2
	}

		limit = { te_jmap_class_laborers_share_lg_span_r < 8 }
		value = te_jmap_class_laborers_share_lg_span_r divide = 4 add = 1
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_laborers_share_lg_span_r < 16 }
		value = te_jmap_class_laborers_share_lg_span_r divide = 8 add = 2
	}

	}

		limit = { te_jmap_class_laborers_share_lg_span_r < 1024 }

	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_laborers_share_lg_span_r < 2048 }
		value = te_jmap_class_laborers_share_lg_span_r divide = 1024 add = 9
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_laborers_share_lg_span_r < 4096 }
		value = te_jmap_class_laborers_share_lg_span_r divide = 2048 add = 10
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_laborers_share_lg_span_r < 8192 }
		value = te_jmap_class_laborers_share_lg_span_r divide = 4096 add = 11
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_laborers_share_lg_span_r < 16384 }
		value = te_jmap_class_laborers_share_lg_span_r divide = 8192 add = 12
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_laborers_share_lg_span_r < 32768 }
		value = te_jmap_class_laborers_share_lg_span_r divide = 16384 add = 13
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_laborers_share_lg_span_r < 65536 }

		limit = { te_jmap_class_laborers_share_lg_span_r < 131072 }
		value = te_jmap_class_laborers_share_lg_span_r divide = 65536 add = 15
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_laborers_share_lg_span_r < 262144 }
		value = te_jmap_class_laborers_share_lg_span_r divide = 131072 add = 16
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_laborers_share_lg_span_r < 524288 }
		value = te_jmap_class_laborers_share_lg_span_r divide = 262144 add = 17
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_laborers_share_lg_span_r < 1048576 }
		value = te_jmap_class_laborers_share_lg_span_r divide = 524288 add = 18
	}
	else = {
		value = te_jmap_class_laborers_share_lg_span_r divide = 1048576 add = 19
	}
	min = 0.001
}
te_jmap_class_laborers_share_factor = {
	if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_scale = 0 }
		value = te_jmap_share_laborers subtract = te_jmap_class_laborers_share_lo divide = te_jmap_class_laborers_share_d0
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_scale = 1 }
		value = te_jmap_share_laborers
		subtract = te_jmap_class_laborers_share_lo
		divide = te_jmap_class_laborers_share_span
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_scale = 2 }
		value = te_jmap_class_laborers_share_lg_t
		divide = te_jmap_class_laborers_share_lg_top
	}
	else = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = te_jmap_rank }
			value = var:te_jmap_rank
		}
	}
	min = 0
	max = 1
}

# Farmers, their people (the yearly walk's): the same share of the color for each doubling from the world's low (at least 10 people) to its high.
# A doubling at a time, fitted to the world; before the first measure, 2000 to 512000.
te_jmap_class_farmers_input = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_dg_cls_farmers }
		value = var:te_dg_cls_farmers
	}
}
te_jmap_class_farmers_input_neg = {
	value = te_jmap_class_farmers_input
	multiply = -1
}
te_jmap_class_farmers_lo = {
	value = 2000
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = te_jmap_rng_class_farmers_lo }
		value = global_var:te_jmap_rng_class_farmers_lo
	}
	min = 10
}
te_jmap_class_farmers_hi = {
	value = 512000
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = te_jmap_rng_class_farmers_hi }
		value = global_var:te_jmap_rng_class_farmers_hi
	}
	min = te_jmap_class_farmers_hi_floor
}
te_jmap_class_farmers_hi_floor = {
	value = te_jmap_class_farmers_lo
	multiply = 4
}
te_jmap_class_farmers_ratio = {
	value = var:te_dg_cls_farmers
	divide = te_jmap_class_farmers_lo
}

	if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_farmers_ratio < 2 }
		value = te_jmap_class_farmers_ratio subtract = 1
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_farmers_ratio < 4 }
		value = te_jmap_class_farmers_ratio divide = 2
	}

		limit = { te_jmap_class_farmers_ratio < 8 }

te_jmap_class_farmers_factor = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_dg_cls_farmers }
		if = {
			limit = { te_jmap_scale = 0 }
			value = te_jmap_class_farmers_log
			divide = te_jmap_class_farmers_log_span
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { te_jmap_scale = 1 }
			value = var:te_dg_cls_farmers
			subtract = te_jmap_class_farmers_lo
			divide = te_jmap_class_farmers_span
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { te_jmap_scale = 2 }
			value = te_jmap_class_farmers_log
			divide = te_jmap_class_farmers_log_span
		}
		else = {
			value = 0
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = te_jmap_rank }
				value = var:te_jmap_rank
			}
		}
	}
	min = 0
	max = 1
}

# Farmers, their share of the state's people (the yearly walk's).
# Fitted to the world; before the first measure, 0 to 0.4.
te_jmap_class_farmers_share_input = {
	value = te_jmap_share_farmers
}
te_jmap_class_farmers_share_input_neg = {
	value = te_jmap_class_farmers_share_input
	multiply = -1
}
te_jmap_class_farmers_share_lo = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = te_jmap_rng_class_farmers_share_lo }
		value = global_var:te_jmap_rng_class_farmers_share_lo
	}
}
te_jmap_class_farmers_share_hi = {
	value = 0.4
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = te_jmap_rng_class_farmers_share_hi }
		value = global_var:te_jmap_rng_class_farmers_share_hi
	}
	min = te_jmap_class_farmers_share_hi_floor
}
te_jmap_class_farmers_share_hi_floor = {
	value = te_jmap_class_farmers_share_lo
	add = 0.05
}
te_jmap_class_farmers_share_span = {
	value = te_jmap_class_farmers_share_hi
	subtract = te_jmap_class_farmers_share_lo
}
te_jmap_class_farmers_share_d0 = {
	value = te_jmap_class_farmers_share_span
	multiply = 1
}
te_jmap_class_farmers_share_lg_min = {
	value = te_jmap_class_farmers_share_hi
	divide = 64
}
te_jmap_class_farmers_share_lg_r = {
	value = te_jmap_share_farmers
	multiply = 64
	divide = te_jmap_class_farmers_share_hi
	if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_farmers_share_lo > te_jmap_class_farmers_share_lg_min }
		value = te_jmap_share_farmers
		divide = te_jmap_class_farmers_share_lo
	}
}
te_jmap_class_farmers_share_lg_t = {
	if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_farmers_share_lg_r < 2 }
		value = te_jmap_class_farmers_share_lg_r subtract = 1
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_farmers_share_lg_r < 4 }
		value = te_jmap_class_farmers_share_lg_r divide = 2
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_farmers_share_lg_r < 8 }
		value = te_jmap_class_farmers_share_lg_r divide = 4 add = 1
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_farmers_share_lg_r < 16 }
		value = te_jmap_class_farmers_share_lg_r divide = 8 add = 2
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_farmers_share_lg_r < 32 }
		value = te_jmap_class_farmers_share_lg_r divide = 16 add = 3
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_farmers_share_lg_r < 64 }
		value = te_jmap_class_farmers_share_lg_r divide = 32 add = 4
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_farmers_share_lg_r < 128 }
		value = te_jmap_class_farmers_share_lg_r divide = 64 add = 5
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_farmers_share_lg_r < 256 }
		value = te_jmap_class_farmers_share_lg_r divide = 128 add = 6
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_farmers_share_lg_r < 512 }
		value = te_jmap_class_farmers_share_lg_r divide = 256 add = 7
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_farmers_share_lg_r < 1024 }
		value = te_jmap_class_farmers_share_lg_r divide = 512 add = 8
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_farmers_share_lg_r < 2048 }
		value = te_jmap_class_farmers_share_lg_r divide = 1024 add = 9
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_farmers_share_lg_r < 4096 }
		value = te_jmap_class_farmers_share_lg_r divide = 2048 add = 10
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_farmers_share_lg_r < 8192 }
		value = te_jmap_class_farmers_share_lg_r divide = 4096 add = 11
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_farmers_share_lg_r < 16384 }
		value = te_jmap_class_farmers_share_lg_r divide = 8192 add = 12
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_farmers_share_lg_r < 32768 }
		value = te_jmap_class_farmers_share_lg_r divide = 16384 add = 13
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_farmers_share_lg_r < 65536 }
		value = te_jmap_class_farmers_share_lg_r divide = 32768 add = 14
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_farmers_share_lg_r < 131072 }
		value = te_jmap_class_farmers_share_lg_r divide = 65536 add = 15
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_farmers_share_lg_r < 262144 }
		value = te_jmap_class_farmers_share_lg_r divide = 131072 add = 16
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_farmers_share_lg_r < 524288 }
		value = te_jmap_class_farmers_share_lg_r divide = 262144 add = 17
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_farmers_share_lg_r < 1048576 }
		value = te_jmap_class_farmers_share_lg_r divide = 524288 add = 18
	}
	else = {
		value = te_jmap_class_farmers_share_lg_r divide = 1048576 add = 19
	}
}
te_jmap_class_farmers_share_lg_span_r = {
	value = 64
	if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_farmers_share_lo > te_jmap_class_farmers_share_lg_min }
		value = te_jmap_class_farmers_share_hi
		divide = te_jmap_class_farmers_share_lo
	}
}
te_jmap_class_farmers_share_lg_top = {
	if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_farmers_share_lg_span_r < 2 }
		value = te_jmap_class_farmers_share_lg_span_r subtract = 1
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_farmers_share_lg_span_r < 4 }
		value = te_jmap_class_farmers_share_lg_span_r divide = 2
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_farmers_share_lg_span_r < 8 }
		value = te_jmap_class_farmers_share_lg_span_r divide = 4 add = 1
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_farmers_share_lg_span_r < 16 }
		value = te_jmap_class_farmers_share_lg_span_r divide = 8 add = 2
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_farmers_share_lg_span_r < 32 }
		value = te_jmap_class_farmers_share_lg_span_r divide = 16 add = 3
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_farmers_share_lg_span_r < 64 }
		value = te_jmap_class_farmers_share_lg_span_r divide = 32 add = 4
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_farmers_share_lg_span_r < 128 }
		value = te_jmap_class_farmers_share_lg_span_r divide = 64 add = 5
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_farmers_share_lg_span_r < 256 }
		value = te_jmap_class_farmers_share_lg_span_r divide = 128 add = 6
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_farmers_share_lg_span_r < 512 }
		value = te_jmap_class_farmers_share_lg_span_r divide = 256 add = 7
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_farmers_share_lg_span_r < 1024 }
		value = te_jmap_class_farmers_share_lg_span_r divide = 512 add = 8
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_farmers_share_lg_span_r < 2048 }
		value = te_jmap_class_farmers_share_lg_span_r divide = 1024 add = 9
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_farmers_share_lg_span_r < 4096 }
		value = te_jmap_class_farmers_share_lg_span_r divide = 2048 add = 10
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_farmers_share_lg_span_r < 8192 }
		value = te_jmap_class_farmers_share_lg_span_r divide = 4096 add = 11
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_farmers_share_lg_span_r < 16384 }
		value = te_jmap_class_farmers_share_lg_span_r divide = 8192 add = 12
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_farmers_share_lg_span_r < 32768 }
		value = te_jmap_class_farmers_share_lg_span_r divide = 16384 add = 13
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_farmers_share_lg_span_r < 65536 }
		value = te_jmap_class_farmers_share_lg_span_r divide = 32768 add = 14
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_farmers_share_lg_span_r < 131072 }
		value = te_jmap_class_farmers_share_lg_span_r divide = 65536 add = 15
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_farmers_share_lg_span_r < 262144 }
		value = te_jmap_class_farmers_share_lg_span_r divide = 131072 add = 16
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_farmers_share_lg_span_r < 524288 }
		value = te_jmap_class_farmers_share_lg_span_r divide = 262144 add = 17
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_farmers_share_lg_span_r < 1048576 }
		value = te_jmap_class_farmers_share_lg_span_r divide = 524288 add = 18
	}
	else = {
		value = te_jmap_class_farmers_share_lg_span_r divide = 1048576 add = 19
	}
	min = 0.001
}
te_jmap_class_farmers_share_factor = {
	if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_scale = 0 }
		value = te_jmap_share_farmers subtract = te_jmap_class_farmers_share_lo divide = te_jmap_class_farmers_share_d0
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_scale = 1 }
		value = te_jmap_share_farmers
		subtract = te_jmap_class_farmers_share_lo
		divide = te_jmap_class_farmers_share_span
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_scale = 2 }
		value = te_jmap_class_farmers_share_lg_t
		divide = te_jmap_class_farmers_share_lg_top
	}
	else = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = te_jmap_rank }
			value = var:te_jmap_rank
		}
	}
	min = 0
	max = 1
}

# Peasants, their people (the yearly walk's): the same share of the color for each doubling from the world's low (at least 10 people) to its high.
# A doubling at a time, fitted to the world; before the first measure, 8000 to 2048000.
te_jmap_class_peasants_input = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_dg_cls_peasants }
		value = var:te_dg_cls_peasants
	}
}
te_jmap_class_peasants_input_neg = {
	value = te_jmap_class_peasants_input
	multiply = -1
}
te_jmap_class_peasants_lo = {
	value = 8000
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = te_jmap_rng_class_peasants_lo }
		value = global_var:te_jmap_rng_class_peasants_lo
	}
	min = 10
}
te_jmap_class_peasants_hi = {
	value = 2048000
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = te_jmap_rng_class_peasants_hi }
		value = global_var:te_jmap_rng_class_peasants_hi
	}
	min = te_jmap_class_peasants_hi_floor
}
te_jmap_class_peasants_hi_floor = {
	value = te_jmap_class_peasants_lo
	multiply = 4
}
te_jmap_class_peasants_ratio = {
	value = var:te_dg_cls_peasants
	divide = te_jmap_class_peasants_lo
}
te_jmap_class_peasants_log = {
	if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_peasants_ratio < 2 }
		value = te_jmap_class_peasants_ratio subtract = 1
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_peasants_ratio < 4 }
		value = te_jmap_class_peasants_ratio divide = 2
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_peasants_ratio < 8 }
		value = te_jmap_class_peasants_ratio divide = 4 add = 1
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_peasants_ratio < 16 }
		value = te_jmap_class_peasants_ratio divide = 8 add = 2
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_peasants_ratio < 32 }
		value = te_jmap_class_peasants_ratio divide = 16 add = 3
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_peasants_ratio < 64 }
		value = te_jmap_class_peasants_ratio divide = 32 add = 4
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_peasants_ratio < 128 }
		value = te_jmap_class_peasants_ratio divide = 64 add = 5
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_peasants_ratio < 256 }
		value = te_jmap_class_peasants_ratio divide = 128 add = 6
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_peasants_ratio < 512 }
		value = te_jmap_class_peasants_ratio divide = 256 add = 7
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_peasants_ratio < 1024 }
		value = te_jmap_class_peasants_ratio divide = 512 add = 8
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_peasants_ratio < 2048 }
		value = te_jmap_class_peasants_ratio divide = 1024 add = 9
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_peasants_ratio < 4096 }
		value = te_jmap_class_peasants_ratio divide = 2048 add = 10
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_peasants_ratio < 8192 }
		value = te_jmap_class_peasants_ratio divide = 4096 add = 11
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_peasants_ratio < 16384 }
		value = te_jmap_class_peasants_ratio divide = 8192 add = 12
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_peasants_ratio < 32768 }
		value = te_jmap_class_peasants_ratio divide = 16384 add = 13
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_peasants_ratio < 65536 }
		value = te_jmap_class_peasants_ratio divide = 32768 add = 14
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_peasants_ratio < 131072 }
		value = te_jmap_class_peasants_ratio divide = 65536 add = 15
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_peasants_ratio < 262144 }
		value = te_jmap_class_peasants_ratio divide = 131072 add = 16
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_peasants_ratio < 524288 }
		value = te_jmap_class_peasants_ratio divide = 262144 add = 17
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_peasants_ratio < 1048576 }
		value = te_jmap_class_peasants_ratio divide = 524288 add = 18
	}
	else = {
		value = te_jmap_class_peasants_ratio divide = 1048576 add = 19
	}
}
te_jmap_class_peasants_span_ratio = {
	value = te_jmap_class_peasants_hi
	divide = te_jmap_class_peasants_lo
}

	if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_peasants_span_ratio < 2 }
		value = te_jmap_class_peasants_span_ratio subtract = 1
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_peasants_span_ratio < 4 }
		value = te_jmap_class_peasants_span_ratio divide = 2
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_peasants_span_ratio < 8 }
		value = te_jmap_class_peasants_span_ratio divide = 4 add = 1
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_peasants_span_ratio < 16 }

	}
	else_if = {

	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_peasants_span_ratio < 4096 }
		value = te_jmap_class_peasants_span_ratio divide = 2048 add = 10
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_peasants_span_ratio < 8192 }
		value = te_jmap_class_peasants_span_ratio divide = 4096 add = 11
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_peasants_span_ratio < 16384 }
		value = te_jmap_class_peasants_span_ratio divide = 8192 add = 12
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_peasants_span_ratio < 32768 }
		value = te_jmap_class_peasants_span_ratio divide = 16384 add = 13
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_peasants_span_ratio < 65536 }

	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_peasants_span_ratio < 131072 }

	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_peasants_span_ratio < 262144 }
		value = te_jmap_class_peasants_span_ratio divide = 131072 add = 16
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_peasants_span_ratio < 524288 }
		value = te_jmap_class_peasants_span_ratio divide = 262144 add = 17
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_peasants_span_ratio < 1048576 }
		value = te_jmap_class_peasants_span_ratio divide = 524288 add = 18
	}
	else = {
		value = te_jmap_class_peasants_span_ratio divide = 1048576 add = 19
	}
	min = 1
}
te_jmap_class_peasants_span = {
	value = te_jmap_class_peasants_hi
	subtract = te_jmap_class_peasants_lo
}
te_jmap_class_peasants_factor = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_dg_cls_peasants }
		if = {
			limit = { te_jmap_scale = 0 }
			value = te_jmap_class_peasants_log
			divide = te_jmap_class_peasants_log_span
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { te_jmap_scale = 1 }
			value = var:te_dg_cls_peasants
			subtract = te_jmap_class_peasants_lo
			divide = te_jmap_class_peasants_span
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { te_jmap_scale = 2 }
			value = te_jmap_class_peasants_log
			divide = te_jmap_class_peasants_log_span
		}
		else = {
			value = 0
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = te_jmap_rank }
				value = var:te_jmap_rank
			}
		}
	}
	min = 0
	max = 1
}

# Peasants, their share of the state's people (the yearly walk's).
# Fitted to the world; before the first measure, 0 to 1.
te_jmap_class_peasants_share_input = {
	value = te_jmap_share_peasants
}
te_jmap_class_peasants_share_input_neg = {
	value = te_jmap_class_peasants_share_input
	multiply = -1
}
te_jmap_class_peasants_share_lo = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = te_jmap_rng_class_peasants_share_lo }
		value = global_var:te_jmap_rng_class_peasants_share_lo
	}
}
te_jmap_class_peasants_share_hi = {
	value = 1
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = te_jmap_rng_class_peasants_share_hi }
		value = global_var:te_jmap_rng_class_peasants_share_hi
	}
	min = te_jmap_class_peasants_share_hi_floor
}
te_jmap_class_peasants_share_hi_floor = {
	value = te_jmap_class_peasants_share_lo
	add = 0.1
}
te_jmap_class_peasants_share_span = {
	value = te_jmap_class_peasants_share_hi
	subtract = te_jmap_class_peasants_share_lo
}
te_jmap_class_peasants_share_d0 = {
	value = te_jmap_class_peasants_share_span
	multiply = 1
}
te_jmap_class_peasants_share_lg_min = {
	value = te_jmap_class_peasants_share_hi
	divide = 64
}
te_jmap_class_peasants_share_lg_r = {
	value = te_jmap_share_peasants
	multiply = 64
	divide = te_jmap_class_peasants_share_hi
	if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_peasants_share_lo > te_jmap_class_peasants_share_lg_min }
		value = te_jmap_share_peasants
		divide = te_jmap_class_peasants_share_lo
	}
}
te_jmap_class_peasants_share_lg_t = {
	if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_peasants_share_lg_r < 2 }
		value = te_jmap_class_peasants_share_lg_r subtract = 1
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_peasants_share_lg_r < 4 }
		value = te_jmap_class_peasants_share_lg_r divide = 2
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_peasants_share_lg_r < 8 }
		value = te_jmap_class_peasants_share_lg_r divide = 4 add = 1
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_peasants_share_lg_r < 16 }
		value = te_jmap_class_peasants_share_lg_r divide = 8 add = 2
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_peasants_share_lg_r < 32 }
		value = te_jmap_class_peasants_share_lg_r divide = 16 add = 3
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_peasants_share_lg_r < 64 }
		value = te_jmap_class_peasants_share_lg_r divide = 32 add = 4
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_peasants_share_lg_r < 128 }
		value = te_jmap_class_peasants_share_lg_r divide = 64 add = 5
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_peasants_share_lg_r < 256 }
		value = te_jmap_class_peasants_share_lg_r divide = 128 add = 6
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_peasants_share_lg_r < 512 }
		value = te_jmap_class_peasants_share_lg_r divide = 256 add = 7
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_peasants_share_lg_r < 1024 }
		value = te_jmap_class_peasants_share_lg_r divide = 512 add = 8
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_peasants_share_lg_r < 2048 }
		value = te_jmap_class_peasants_share_lg_r divide = 1024 add = 9
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_peasants_share_lg_r < 4096 }
		value = te_jmap_class_peasants_share_lg_r divide = 2048 add = 10
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_peasants_share_lg_r < 8192 }
		value = te_jmap_class_peasants_share_lg_r divide = 4096 add = 11
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_peasants_share_lg_r < 16384 }
		value = te_jmap_class_peasants_share_lg_r divide = 8192 add = 12
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_peasants_share_lg_r < 32768 }
		value = te_jmap_class_peasants_share_lg_r divide = 16384 add = 13
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_peasants_share_lg_r < 65536 }
		value = te_jmap_class_peasants_share_lg_r divide = 32768 add = 14
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_peasants_share_lg_r < 131072 }
		value = te_jmap_class_peasants_share_lg_r divide = 65536 add = 15
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_peasants_share_lg_r < 262144 }
		value = te_jmap_class_peasants_share_lg_r divide = 131072 add = 16
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_peasants_share_lg_r < 524288 }
		value = te_jmap_class_peasants_share_lg_r divide = 262144 add = 17
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_peasants_share_lg_r < 1048576 }
		value = te_jmap_class_peasants_share_lg_r divide = 524288 add = 18
	}
	else = {
		value = te_jmap_class_peasants_share_lg_r divide = 1048576 add = 19
	}
}
te_jmap_class_peasants_share_lg_span_r = {
	value = 64
	if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_peasants_share_lo > te_jmap_class_peasants_share_lg_min }
		value = te_jmap_class_peasants_share_hi
		divide = te_jmap_class_peasants_share_lo
	}
}
te_jmap_class_peasants_share_lg_top = {
	if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_peasants_share_lg_span_r < 2 }
		value = te_jmap_class_peasants_share_lg_span_r subtract = 1
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_peasants_share_lg_span_r < 4 }
		value = te_jmap_class_peasants_share_lg_span_r divide = 2
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_peasants_share_lg_span_r < 8 }
		value = te_jmap_class_peasants_share_lg_span_r divide = 4 add = 1
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_peasants_share_lg_span_r < 16 }
		value = te_jmap_class_peasants_share_lg_span_r divide = 8 add = 2
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_peasants_share_lg_span_r < 32 }
		value = te_jmap_class_peasants_share_lg_span_r divide = 16 add = 3
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_peasants_share_lg_span_r < 64 }
		value = te_jmap_class_peasants_share_lg_span_r divide = 32 add = 4
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_peasants_share_lg_span_r < 128 }
		value = te_jmap_class_peasants_share_lg_span_r divide = 64 add = 5
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_peasants_share_lg_span_r < 256 }
		value = te_jmap_class_peasants_share_lg_span_r divide = 128 add = 6
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_peasants_share_lg_span_r < 512 }
		value = te_jmap_class_peasants_share_lg_span_r divide = 256 add = 7
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_peasants_share_lg_span_r < 1024 }
		value = te_jmap_class_peasants_share_lg_span_r divide = 512 add = 8
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_peasants_share_lg_span_r < 2048 }
		value = te_jmap_class_peasants_share_lg_span_r divide = 1024 add = 9
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_peasants_share_lg_span_r < 4096 }
		value = te_jmap_class_peasants_share_lg_span_r divide = 2048 add = 10
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_peasants_share_lg_span_r < 8192 }
		value = te_jmap_class_peasants_share_lg_span_r divide = 4096 add = 11
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_peasants_share_lg_span_r < 16384 }
		value = te_jmap_class_peasants_share_lg_span_r divide = 8192 add = 12
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_peasants_share_lg_span_r < 32768 }
		value = te_jmap_class_peasants_share_lg_span_r divide = 16384 add = 13
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_peasants_share_lg_span_r < 65536 }
		value = te_jmap_class_peasants_share_lg_span_r divide = 32768 add = 14
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_peasants_share_lg_span_r < 131072 }
		value = te_jmap_class_peasants_share_lg_span_r divide = 65536 add = 15
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_peasants_share_lg_span_r < 262144 }
		value = te_jmap_class_peasants_share_lg_span_r divide = 131072 add = 16
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_peasants_share_lg_span_r < 524288 }
		value = te_jmap_class_peasants_share_lg_span_r divide = 262144 add = 17
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_peasants_share_lg_span_r < 1048576 }
		value = te_jmap_class_peasants_share_lg_span_r divide = 524288 add = 18
	}
	else = {
		value = te_jmap_class_peasants_share_lg_span_r divide = 1048576 add = 19
	}
	min = 0.001
}
te_jmap_class_peasants_share_factor = {
	if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_scale = 0 }
		value = te_jmap_share_peasants subtract = te_jmap_class_peasants_share_lo divide = te_jmap_class_peasants_share_d0
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_scale = 1 }
		value = te_jmap_share_peasants
		subtract = te_jmap_class_peasants_share_lo
		divide = te_jmap_class_peasants_share_span
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_scale = 2 }
		value = te_jmap_class_peasants_share_lg_t
		divide = te_jmap_class_peasants_share_lg_top
	}
	else = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = te_jmap_rank }
			value = var:te_jmap_rank
		}
	}
	min = 0
	max = 1
}

# Slaves, their people (the yearly walk's): the same share of the color for each doubling from the world's low (at least 10 people) to its high.
# A doubling at a time, fitted to the world; before the first measure, 500 to 256000.
te_jmap_class_slaves_input = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_dg_cls_slaves }
		value = var:te_dg_cls_slaves
	}
}
te_jmap_class_slaves_input_neg = {
	value = te_jmap_class_slaves_input
	multiply = -1
}
te_jmap_class_slaves_lo = {
	value = 500
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = te_jmap_rng_class_slaves_lo }
		value = global_var:te_jmap_rng_class_slaves_lo
	}
	min = 10
}
te_jmap_class_slaves_hi = {
	value = 256000
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = te_jmap_rng_class_slaves_hi }
		value = global_var:te_jmap_rng_class_slaves_hi
	}
	min = te_jmap_class_slaves_hi_floor
}
te_jmap_class_slaves_hi_floor = {
	value = te_jmap_class_slaves_lo
	multiply = 4
}
te_jmap_class_slaves_ratio = {
	value = var:te_dg_cls_slaves
	divide = te_jmap_class_slaves_lo
}

		limit = { te_jmap_class_slaves_ratio < 2 }

		limit = { te_jmap_class_slaves_ratio < 4 }
		value = te_jmap_class_slaves_ratio divide = 2
	}
	else_if = {

		value = te_jmap_class_slaves_ratio divide = 4 add = 1
	}

		limit = { te_jmap_class_slaves_ratio < 16 }

		limit = { te_jmap_class_slaves_ratio < 32 }

		limit = { te_jmap_class_slaves_ratio < 64 }

		limit = { te_jmap_class_slaves_ratio < 128 }

		limit = { te_jmap_class_slaves_ratio < 256 }

	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_slaves_ratio < 512 }
		value = te_jmap_class_slaves_ratio divide = 256 add = 7
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_slaves_ratio < 1024 }
		value = te_jmap_class_slaves_ratio divide = 512 add = 8
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_slaves_ratio < 2048 }
		value = te_jmap_class_slaves_ratio divide = 1024 add = 9
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_slaves_ratio < 4096 }
		value = te_jmap_class_slaves_ratio divide = 2048 add = 10
	}
	else_if = {

	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_slaves_ratio < 65536 }
		value = te_jmap_class_slaves_ratio divide = 32768 add = 14
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_slaves_ratio < 131072 }
		value = te_jmap_class_slaves_ratio divide = 65536 add = 15
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_slaves_ratio < 262144 }
		value = te_jmap_class_slaves_ratio divide = 131072 add = 16
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_slaves_ratio < 524288 }
		value = te_jmap_class_slaves_ratio divide = 262144 add = 17
	}
	else_if = {

		value = te_jmap_class_slaves_ratio divide = 524288 add = 18
	}
	else = {
		value = te_jmap_class_slaves_ratio divide = 1048576 add = 19
	}
}

	subtract = te_jmap_class_slaves_lo

	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_dg_cls_slaves }
		if = {
			limit = { te_jmap_scale = 0 }
			value = te_jmap_class_slaves_log
			divide = te_jmap_class_slaves_log_span
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { te_jmap_scale = 1 }
			value = var:te_dg_cls_slaves
			subtract = te_jmap_class_slaves_lo
			divide = te_jmap_class_slaves_span
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { te_jmap_scale = 2 }
			value = te_jmap_class_slaves_log
			divide = te_jmap_class_slaves_log_span
		}
		else = {
			value = 0
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = te_jmap_rank }
				value = var:te_jmap_rank
			}
		}
	}
	min = 0
	max = 1
}

# Slaves, their share of the state's people (the yearly walk's).
# Fitted to the world; before the first measure, 0 to 0.5.
te_jmap_class_slaves_share_input = {
	value = te_jmap_share_slaves
}
te_jmap_class_slaves_share_input_neg = {
	value = te_jmap_class_slaves_share_input
	multiply = -1
}
te_jmap_class_slaves_share_lo = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = te_jmap_rng_class_slaves_share_lo }
		value = global_var:te_jmap_rng_class_slaves_share_lo
	}
}
te_jmap_class_slaves_share_hi = {
	value = 0.5
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = te_jmap_rng_class_slaves_share_hi }
		value = global_var:te_jmap_rng_class_slaves_share_hi
	}
	min = te_jmap_class_slaves_share_hi_floor
}
te_jmap_class_slaves_share_hi_floor = {
	value = te_jmap_class_slaves_share_lo
	add = 0.05
}
te_jmap_class_slaves_share_span = {
	value = te_jmap_class_slaves_share_hi
	subtract = te_jmap_class_slaves_share_lo
}
te_jmap_class_slaves_share_d0 = {
	value = te_jmap_class_slaves_share_span
	multiply = 1
}
te_jmap_class_slaves_share_lg_min = {
	value = te_jmap_class_slaves_share_hi
	divide = 64
}
te_jmap_class_slaves_share_lg_r = {
	value = te_jmap_share_slaves
	multiply = 64
	divide = te_jmap_class_slaves_share_hi
	if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_slaves_share_lo > te_jmap_class_slaves_share_lg_min }
		value = te_jmap_share_slaves
		divide = te_jmap_class_slaves_share_lo
	}
}
te_jmap_class_slaves_share_lg_t = {
	if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_slaves_share_lg_r < 2 }
		value = te_jmap_class_slaves_share_lg_r subtract = 1
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_slaves_share_lg_r < 4 }
		value = te_jmap_class_slaves_share_lg_r divide = 2
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_slaves_share_lg_r < 8 }
		value = te_jmap_class_slaves_share_lg_r divide = 4 add = 1
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_slaves_share_lg_r < 16 }
		value = te_jmap_class_slaves_share_lg_r divide = 8 add = 2
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_slaves_share_lg_r < 32 }
		value = te_jmap_class_slaves_share_lg_r divide = 16 add = 3
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_slaves_share_lg_r < 64 }
		value = te_jmap_class_slaves_share_lg_r divide = 32 add = 4
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_slaves_share_lg_r < 128 }
		value = te_jmap_class_slaves_share_lg_r divide = 64 add = 5
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_slaves_share_lg_r < 256 }
		value = te_jmap_class_slaves_share_lg_r divide = 128 add = 6
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_slaves_share_lg_r < 512 }
		value = te_jmap_class_slaves_share_lg_r divide = 256 add = 7
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_slaves_share_lg_r < 1024 }
		value = te_jmap_class_slaves_share_lg_r divide = 512 add = 8
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_slaves_share_lg_r < 2048 }
		value = te_jmap_class_slaves_share_lg_r divide = 1024 add = 9
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_slaves_share_lg_r < 4096 }
		value = te_jmap_class_slaves_share_lg_r divide = 2048 add = 10
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_slaves_share_lg_r < 8192 }
		value = te_jmap_class_slaves_share_lg_r divide = 4096 add = 11
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_slaves_share_lg_r < 16384 }
		value = te_jmap_class_slaves_share_lg_r divide = 8192 add = 12
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_slaves_share_lg_r < 32768 }
		value = te_jmap_class_slaves_share_lg_r divide = 16384 add = 13
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_slaves_share_lg_r < 65536 }
		value = te_jmap_class_slaves_share_lg_r divide = 32768 add = 14
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_slaves_share_lg_r < 131072 }
		value = te_jmap_class_slaves_share_lg_r divide = 65536 add = 15
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_slaves_share_lg_r < 262144 }
		value = te_jmap_class_slaves_share_lg_r divide = 131072 add = 16
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_slaves_share_lg_r < 524288 }
		value = te_jmap_class_slaves_share_lg_r divide = 262144 add = 17
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_slaves_share_lg_r < 1048576 }
		value = te_jmap_class_slaves_share_lg_r divide = 524288 add = 18
	}
	else = {
		value = te_jmap_class_slaves_share_lg_r divide = 1048576 add = 19
	}
}
te_jmap_class_slaves_share_lg_span_r = {
	value = 64
	if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_slaves_share_lo > te_jmap_class_slaves_share_lg_min }
		value = te_jmap_class_slaves_share_hi
		divide = te_jmap_class_slaves_share_lo
	}
}
te_jmap_class_slaves_share_lg_top = {
	if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_slaves_share_lg_span_r < 2 }
		value = te_jmap_class_slaves_share_lg_span_r subtract = 1
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_slaves_share_lg_span_r < 4 }
		value = te_jmap_class_slaves_share_lg_span_r divide = 2
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_slaves_share_lg_span_r < 8 }
		value = te_jmap_class_slaves_share_lg_span_r divide = 4 add = 1
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_slaves_share_lg_span_r < 16 }
		value = te_jmap_class_slaves_share_lg_span_r divide = 8 add = 2
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_slaves_share_lg_span_r < 32 }
		value = te_jmap_class_slaves_share_lg_span_r divide = 16 add = 3
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_slaves_share_lg_span_r < 64 }
		value = te_jmap_class_slaves_share_lg_span_r divide = 32 add = 4
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_slaves_share_lg_span_r < 128 }
		value = te_jmap_class_slaves_share_lg_span_r divide = 64 add = 5
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_slaves_share_lg_span_r < 256 }
		value = te_jmap_class_slaves_share_lg_span_r divide = 128 add = 6
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_slaves_share_lg_span_r < 512 }
		value = te_jmap_class_slaves_share_lg_span_r divide = 256 add = 7
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_slaves_share_lg_span_r < 1024 }
		value = te_jmap_class_slaves_share_lg_span_r divide = 512 add = 8
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_slaves_share_lg_span_r < 2048 }
		value = te_jmap_class_slaves_share_lg_span_r divide = 1024 add = 9
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_slaves_share_lg_span_r < 4096 }
		value = te_jmap_class_slaves_share_lg_span_r divide = 2048 add = 10
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_slaves_share_lg_span_r < 8192 }
		value = te_jmap_class_slaves_share_lg_span_r divide = 4096 add = 11
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_slaves_share_lg_span_r < 16384 }
		value = te_jmap_class_slaves_share_lg_span_r divide = 8192 add = 12
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_slaves_share_lg_span_r < 32768 }
		value = te_jmap_class_slaves_share_lg_span_r divide = 16384 add = 13
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_slaves_share_lg_span_r < 65536 }
		value = te_jmap_class_slaves_share_lg_span_r divide = 32768 add = 14
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_slaves_share_lg_span_r < 131072 }
		value = te_jmap_class_slaves_share_lg_span_r divide = 65536 add = 15
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_slaves_share_lg_span_r < 262144 }
		value = te_jmap_class_slaves_share_lg_span_r divide = 131072 add = 16
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_slaves_share_lg_span_r < 524288 }
		value = te_jmap_class_slaves_share_lg_span_r divide = 262144 add = 17
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_slaves_share_lg_span_r < 1048576 }
		value = te_jmap_class_slaves_share_lg_span_r divide = 524288 add = 18
	}
	else = {
		value = te_jmap_class_slaves_share_lg_span_r divide = 1048576 add = 19
	}
	min = 0.001
}
te_jmap_class_slaves_share_factor = {
	if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_scale = 0 }
		value = te_jmap_share_slaves subtract = te_jmap_class_slaves_share_lo divide = te_jmap_class_slaves_share_d0
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_scale = 1 }
		value = te_jmap_share_slaves
		subtract = te_jmap_class_slaves_share_lo
		divide = te_jmap_class_slaves_share_span
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_scale = 2 }
		value = te_jmap_class_slaves_share_lg_t
		divide = te_jmap_class_slaves_share_lg_top
	}
	else = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = te_jmap_rank }
			value = var:te_jmap_rank
		}
	}
	min = 0
	max = 1
}

# Clerks, their people (the yearly walk's): the same share of the color for each doubling from the world's low (at least 10 people) to its high.
# A doubling at a time, fitted to the world; before the first measure, 100 to 25600.
te_jmap_class_clerks_input = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_dg_cls_clerks }
		value = var:te_dg_cls_clerks
	}
}
te_jmap_class_clerks_input_neg = {
	value = te_jmap_class_clerks_input
	multiply = -1
}
te_jmap_class_clerks_lo = {
	value = 100
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = te_jmap_rng_class_clerks_lo }
		value = global_var:te_jmap_rng_class_clerks_lo
	}
	min = 10
}
te_jmap_class_clerks_hi = {
	value = 25600
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = te_jmap_rng_class_clerks_hi }
		value = global_var:te_jmap_rng_class_clerks_hi
	}
	min = te_jmap_class_clerks_hi_floor
}
te_jmap_class_clerks_hi_floor = {
	value = te_jmap_class_clerks_lo
	multiply = 4
}
te_jmap_class_clerks_ratio = {
	value = var:te_dg_cls_clerks
	divide = te_jmap_class_clerks_lo
}
te_jmap_class_clerks_log = {
	if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_clerks_ratio < 2 }
		value = te_jmap_class_clerks_ratio subtract = 1
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_clerks_ratio < 4 }
		value = te_jmap_class_clerks_ratio divide = 2
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_clerks_ratio < 8 }
		value = te_jmap_class_clerks_ratio divide = 4 add = 1
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_clerks_ratio < 16 }
		value = te_jmap_class_clerks_ratio divide = 8 add = 2

		limit = { te_jmap_class_clerks_ratio < 32 }
		value = te_jmap_class_clerks_ratio divide = 16 add = 3
	}

		limit = { te_jmap_class_clerks_ratio < 64 }
		value = te_jmap_class_clerks_ratio divide = 32 add = 4
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_clerks_ratio < 128 }
		value = te_jmap_class_clerks_ratio divide = 64 add = 5
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_clerks_ratio < 256 }
		value = te_jmap_class_clerks_ratio divide = 128 add = 6
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_clerks_ratio < 512 }
		value = te_jmap_class_clerks_ratio divide = 256 add = 7
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_clerks_ratio < 1024 }
		value = te_jmap_class_clerks_ratio divide = 512 add = 8
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_clerks_ratio < 2048 }
		value = te_jmap_class_clerks_ratio divide = 1024 add = 9
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_clerks_ratio < 4096 }
		value = te_jmap_class_clerks_ratio divide = 2048 add = 10
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_clerks_ratio < 8192 }
		value = te_jmap_class_clerks_ratio divide = 4096 add = 11
	}
	else_if = {

	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_clerks_ratio < 65536 }
		value = te_jmap_class_clerks_ratio divide = 32768 add = 14
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_clerks_ratio < 131072 }
		value = te_jmap_class_clerks_ratio divide = 65536 add = 15
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_clerks_ratio < 262144 }
		value = te_jmap_class_clerks_ratio divide = 131072 add = 16
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_clerks_ratio < 524288 }
		value = te_jmap_class_clerks_ratio divide = 262144 add = 17
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_clerks_ratio < 1048576 }
		value = te_jmap_class_clerks_ratio divide = 524288 add = 18
	}
	else = {
		value = te_jmap_class_clerks_ratio divide = 1048576 add = 19
	}
}

	value = 0

		limit = { has_variable = te_dg_cls_clerks }

			limit = { te_jmap_scale = 0 }
			value = te_jmap_class_clerks_log
			divide = te_jmap_class_clerks_log_span
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { te_jmap_scale = 1 }
			value = var:te_dg_cls_clerks
			subtract = te_jmap_class_clerks_lo
			divide = te_jmap_class_clerks_span
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { te_jmap_scale = 2 }
			value = te_jmap_class_clerks_log
			divide = te_jmap_class_clerks_log_span
		}
		else = {
			value = 0
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = te_jmap_rank }
				value = var:te_jmap_rank
			}
		}
	}
	min = 0
	max = 1
}

# Clerks, their share of the state's people (the yearly walk's).
# Fitted to the world; before the first measure, 0 to 0.1.
te_jmap_class_clerks_share_input = {
	value = te_jmap_share_clerks
}
te_jmap_class_clerks_share_input_neg = {
	value = te_jmap_class_clerks_share_input
	multiply = -1
}
te_jmap_class_clerks_share_lo = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = te_jmap_rng_class_clerks_share_lo }
		value = global_var:te_jmap_rng_class_clerks_share_lo
	}
}
te_jmap_class_clerks_share_hi = {
	value = 0.1
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = te_jmap_rng_class_clerks_share_hi }
		value = global_var:te_jmap_rng_class_clerks_share_hi
	}
	min = te_jmap_class_clerks_share_hi_floor
}
te_jmap_class_clerks_share_hi_floor = {
	value = te_jmap_class_clerks_share_lo
	add = 0.01
}
te_jmap_class_clerks_share_span = {
	value = te_jmap_class_clerks_share_hi
	subtract = te_jmap_class_clerks_share_lo
}
te_jmap_class_clerks_share_d0 = {
	value = te_jmap_class_clerks_share_span
	multiply = 1
}
te_jmap_class_clerks_share_lg_min = {
	value = te_jmap_class_clerks_share_hi
	divide = 64
}
te_jmap_class_clerks_share_lg_r = {
	value = te_jmap_share_clerks
	multiply = 64
	divide = te_jmap_class_clerks_share_hi
	if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_clerks_share_lo > te_jmap_class_clerks_share_lg_min }
		value = te_jmap_share_clerks
		divide = te_jmap_class_clerks_share_lo
	}
}

		value = te_jmap_class_clerks_share_lg_r divide = 2

		value = te_jmap_class_clerks_share_lg_r divide = 8 add = 2

	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_clerks_share_lg_r < 32 }
		value = te_jmap_class_clerks_share_lg_r divide = 16 add = 3
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_clerks_share_lg_r < 64 }
		value = te_jmap_class_clerks_share_lg_r divide = 32 add = 4
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_clerks_share_lg_r < 128 }
		value = te_jmap_class_clerks_share_lg_r divide = 64 add = 5
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_clerks_share_lg_r < 256 }
		value = te_jmap_class_clerks_share_lg_r divide = 128 add = 6
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_clerks_share_lg_r < 512 }
		value = te_jmap_class_clerks_share_lg_r divide = 256 add = 7
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_clerks_share_lg_r < 1024 }
		value = te_jmap_class_clerks_share_lg_r divide = 512 add = 8
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_clerks_share_lg_r < 2048 }
		value = te_jmap_class_clerks_share_lg_r divide = 1024 add = 9
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_clerks_share_lg_r < 4096 }
		value = te_jmap_class_clerks_share_lg_r divide = 2048 add = 10
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_clerks_share_lg_r < 8192 }
		value = te_jmap_class_clerks_share_lg_r divide = 4096 add = 11
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_clerks_share_lg_r < 16384 }
		value = te_jmap_class_clerks_share_lg_r divide = 8192 add = 12
	}
	else_if = {

	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_clerks_share_lg_r < 65536 }
		value = te_jmap_class_clerks_share_lg_r divide = 32768 add = 14
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_clerks_share_lg_r < 131072 }
		value = te_jmap_class_clerks_share_lg_r divide = 65536 add = 15

		value = te_jmap_class_clerks_share_lg_r divide = 131072 add = 16
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_clerks_share_lg_r < 524288 }
		value = te_jmap_class_clerks_share_lg_r divide = 262144 add = 17
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_clerks_share_lg_r < 1048576 }
		value = te_jmap_class_clerks_share_lg_r divide = 524288 add = 18
	}
	else = {
		value = te_jmap_class_clerks_share_lg_r divide = 1048576 add = 19
	}
}
te_jmap_class_clerks_share_lg_span_r = {
	value = 64
	if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_clerks_share_lo > te_jmap_class_clerks_share_lg_min }
		value = te_jmap_class_clerks_share_hi
		divide = te_jmap_class_clerks_share_lo
	}
}
te_jmap_class_clerks_share_lg_top = {
	if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_clerks_share_lg_span_r < 2 }
		value = te_jmap_class_clerks_share_lg_span_r subtract = 1
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_clerks_share_lg_span_r < 4 }
		value = te_jmap_class_clerks_share_lg_span_r divide = 2
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_clerks_share_lg_span_r < 8 }
		value = te_jmap_class_clerks_share_lg_span_r divide = 4 add = 1
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_clerks_share_lg_span_r < 16 }
		value = te_jmap_class_clerks_share_lg_span_r divide = 8 add = 2
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_clerks_share_lg_span_r < 32 }
		value = te_jmap_class_clerks_share_lg_span_r divide = 16 add = 3
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_clerks_share_lg_span_r < 64 }
		value = te_jmap_class_clerks_share_lg_span_r divide = 32 add = 4
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_clerks_share_lg_span_r < 128 }
		value = te_jmap_class_clerks_share_lg_span_r divide = 64 add = 5
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_clerks_share_lg_span_r < 256 }
		value = te_jmap_class_clerks_share_lg_span_r divide = 128 add = 6
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_clerks_share_lg_span_r < 512 }
		value = te_jmap_class_clerks_share_lg_span_r divide = 256 add = 7
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_clerks_share_lg_span_r < 1024 }
		value = te_jmap_class_clerks_share_lg_span_r divide = 512 add = 8
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_clerks_share_lg_span_r < 2048 }
		value = te_jmap_class_clerks_share_lg_span_r divide = 1024 add = 9
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_clerks_share_lg_span_r < 4096 }
		value = te_jmap_class_clerks_share_lg_span_r divide = 2048 add = 10
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_clerks_share_lg_span_r < 8192 }
		value = te_jmap_class_clerks_share_lg_span_r divide = 4096 add = 11
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_clerks_share_lg_span_r < 16384 }
		value = te_jmap_class_clerks_share_lg_span_r divide = 8192 add = 12
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_clerks_share_lg_span_r < 32768 }
		value = te_jmap_class_clerks_share_lg_span_r divide = 16384 add = 13
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_clerks_share_lg_span_r < 65536 }
		value = te_jmap_class_clerks_share_lg_span_r divide = 32768 add = 14
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_clerks_share_lg_span_r < 131072 }
		value = te_jmap_class_clerks_share_lg_span_r divide = 65536 add = 15
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_clerks_share_lg_span_r < 262144 }
		value = te_jmap_class_clerks_share_lg_span_r divide = 131072 add = 16
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_clerks_share_lg_span_r < 524288 }
		value = te_jmap_class_clerks_share_lg_span_r divide = 262144 add = 17
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_clerks_share_lg_span_r < 1048576 }
		value = te_jmap_class_clerks_share_lg_span_r divide = 524288 add = 18
	}
	else = {
		value = te_jmap_class_clerks_share_lg_span_r divide = 1048576 add = 19
	}
	min = 0.001
}
te_jmap_class_clerks_share_factor = {
	if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_scale = 0 }
		value = te_jmap_share_clerks subtract = te_jmap_class_clerks_share_lo divide = te_jmap_class_clerks_share_d0
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_scale = 1 }
		value = te_jmap_share_clerks
		subtract = te_jmap_class_clerks_share_lo
		divide = te_jmap_class_clerks_share_span
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_scale = 2 }
		value = te_jmap_class_clerks_share_lg_t
		divide = te_jmap_class_clerks_share_lg_top
	}
	else = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = te_jmap_rank }
			value = var:te_jmap_rank
		}
	}
	min = 0
	max = 1
}

# Officers, their people (the yearly walk's): the same share of the color for each doubling from the world's low (at least 10 people) to its high.
# A doubling at a time, fitted to the world; before the first measure, 25 to 3200.
te_jmap_class_officers_input = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_dg_cls_officers }
		value = var:te_dg_cls_officers
	}
}
te_jmap_class_officers_input_neg = {
	value = te_jmap_class_officers_input
	multiply = -1
}
te_jmap_class_officers_lo = {
	value = 25
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = te_jmap_rng_class_officers_lo }
		value = global_var:te_jmap_rng_class_officers_lo
	}
	min = 10
}
te_jmap_class_officers_hi = {
	value = 3200
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = te_jmap_rng_class_officers_hi }
		value = global_var:te_jmap_rng_class_officers_hi
	}
	min = te_jmap_class_officers_hi_floor
}
te_jmap_class_officers_hi_floor = {
	value = te_jmap_class_officers_lo
	multiply = 4
}
te_jmap_class_officers_ratio = {
	value = var:te_dg_cls_officers
	divide = te_jmap_class_officers_lo
}
te_jmap_class_officers_log = {

		limit = { te_jmap_class_officers_ratio < 2 }
		value = te_jmap_class_officers_ratio subtract = 1
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_officers_ratio < 4 }
		value = te_jmap_class_officers_ratio divide = 2
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_officers_ratio < 8 }
		value = te_jmap_class_officers_ratio divide = 4 add = 1

		limit = { te_jmap_class_officers_ratio < 1024 }

	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_officers_ratio < 2048 }
		value = te_jmap_class_officers_ratio divide = 1024 add = 9

		limit = { has_variable = te_dg_cls_officers }

			limit = { te_jmap_scale = 0 }
			value = te_jmap_class_officers_log
			divide = te_jmap_class_officers_log_span
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { te_jmap_scale = 1 }
			value = var:te_dg_cls_officers
			subtract = te_jmap_class_officers_lo
			divide = te_jmap_class_officers_span
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { te_jmap_scale = 2 }
			value = te_jmap_class_officers_log
			divide = te_jmap_class_officers_log_span
		}
		else = {
			value = 0
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = te_jmap_rank }
				value = var:te_jmap_rank
			}
		}
	}
	min = 0
	max = 1
}

# Officers, their share of the state's people (the yearly walk's).
# Fitted to the world; before the first measure, 0 to 0.005.
te_jmap_class_officers_share_input = {
	value = te_jmap_share_officers
}
te_jmap_class_officers_share_input_neg = {
	value = te_jmap_class_officers_share_input
	multiply = -1
}
te_jmap_class_officers_share_lo = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = te_jmap_rng_class_officers_share_lo }
		value = global_var:te_jmap_rng_class_officers_share_lo
	}
}
te_jmap_class_officers_share_hi = {
	value = 0.005
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = te_jmap_rng_class_officers_share_hi }
		value = global_var:te_jmap_rng_class_officers_share_hi
	}
	min = te_jmap_class_officers_share_hi_floor
}
te_jmap_class_officers_share_hi_floor = {
	value = te_jmap_class_officers_share_lo
	add = 0.002
}
te_jmap_class_officers_share_span = {
	value = te_jmap_class_officers_share_hi
	subtract = te_jmap_class_officers_share_lo
}
te_jmap_class_officers_share_d0 = {
	value = te_jmap_class_officers_share_span
	multiply = 1
}

	value = te_jmap_class_officers_share_hi
	divide = 64
}
te_jmap_class_officers_share_lg_r = {
	value = te_jmap_share_officers
	multiply = 64
	divide = te_jmap_class_officers_share_hi
	if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_officers_share_lo > te_jmap_class_officers_share_lg_min }

		divide = te_jmap_class_officers_share_lo
	}
}
