	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_officers_share_lg_span_r < 1024 }
		value = te_jmap_class_officers_share_lg_span_r divide = 512 add = 8
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_officers_share_lg_span_r < 2048 }
		value = te_jmap_class_officers_share_lg_span_r divide = 1024 add = 9
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_officers_share_lg_span_r < 4096 }
		value = te_jmap_class_officers_share_lg_span_r divide = 2048 add = 10
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_officers_share_lg_span_r < 8192 }
		value = te_jmap_class_officers_share_lg_span_r divide = 4096 add = 11
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_officers_share_lg_span_r < 16384 }
		value = te_jmap_class_officers_share_lg_span_r divide = 8192 add = 12
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_officers_share_lg_span_r < 32768 }
		value = te_jmap_class_officers_share_lg_span_r divide = 16384 add = 13
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_officers_share_lg_span_r < 65536 }
		value = te_jmap_class_officers_share_lg_span_r divide = 32768 add = 14
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_officers_share_lg_span_r < 131072 }
		value = te_jmap_class_officers_share_lg_span_r divide = 65536 add = 15
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_officers_share_lg_span_r < 262144 }
		value = te_jmap_class_officers_share_lg_span_r divide = 131072 add = 16
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_officers_share_lg_span_r < 524288 }
		value = te_jmap_class_officers_share_lg_span_r divide = 262144 add = 17
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_officers_share_lg_span_r < 1048576 }
		value = te_jmap_class_officers_share_lg_span_r divide = 524288 add = 18
	}
	else = {
		value = te_jmap_class_officers_share_lg_span_r divide = 1048576 add = 19
	}
	min = 0.001
}
te_jmap_class_officers_share_factor = {
	if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_scale = 0 }
		value = te_jmap_share_officers subtract = te_jmap_class_officers_share_lo divide = te_jmap_class_officers_share_d0
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_scale = 1 }
		value = te_jmap_share_officers
		subtract = te_jmap_class_officers_share_lo
		divide = te_jmap_class_officers_share_span
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_scale = 2 }
		value = te_jmap_class_officers_share_lg_t
		divide = te_jmap_class_officers_share_lg_top
	}
	else = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = te_jmap_rank }
			value = var:te_jmap_rank
		}
	}
	min = 0
	max = 1
}

# Soldiers, their people (the yearly walk's): the same share of the color for each doubling from the world's low (at least 10 people) to its high.
# A doubling at a time, fitted to the world; before the first measure, 500 to 64000.
te_jmap_class_soldiers_input = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_dg_cls_soldiers }
		value = var:te_dg_cls_soldiers
	}
}
te_jmap_class_soldiers_input_neg = {
	value = te_jmap_class_soldiers_input
	multiply = -1
}
te_jmap_class_soldiers_lo = {
	value = 500
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = te_jmap_rng_class_soldiers_lo }
		value = global_var:te_jmap_rng_class_soldiers_lo
	}
	min = 10
}
te_jmap_class_soldiers_hi = {
	value = 64000
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = te_jmap_rng_class_soldiers_hi }
		value = global_var:te_jmap_rng_class_soldiers_hi
	}
	min = te_jmap_class_soldiers_hi_floor
}
te_jmap_class_soldiers_hi_floor = {
	value = te_jmap_class_soldiers_lo
	multiply = 4
}
te_jmap_class_soldiers_ratio = {
	value = var:te_dg_cls_soldiers
	divide = te_jmap_class_soldiers_lo
}
te_jmap_class_soldiers_log = {
	if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_soldiers_ratio < 2 }
		value = te_jmap_class_soldiers_ratio subtract = 1
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_soldiers_ratio < 4 }
		value = te_jmap_class_soldiers_ratio divide = 2
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_soldiers_ratio < 8 }
		value = te_jmap_class_soldiers_ratio divide = 4 add = 1
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_soldiers_ratio < 16 }
		value = te_jmap_class_soldiers_ratio divide = 8 add = 2
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_soldiers_ratio < 32 }
		value = te_jmap_class_soldiers_ratio divide = 16 add = 3
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_soldiers_ratio < 64 }
		value = te_jmap_class_soldiers_ratio divide = 32 add = 4
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_soldiers_ratio < 128 }
		value = te_jmap_class_soldiers_ratio divide = 64 add = 5
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_soldiers_ratio < 256 }
		value = te_jmap_class_soldiers_ratio divide = 128 add = 6
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_soldiers_ratio < 512 }
		value = te_jmap_class_soldiers_ratio divide = 256 add = 7
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_soldiers_ratio < 1024 }
		value = te_jmap_class_soldiers_ratio divide = 512 add = 8
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_soldiers_ratio < 2048 }
		value = te_jmap_class_soldiers_ratio divide = 1024 add = 9
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_soldiers_ratio < 4096 }
		value = te_jmap_class_soldiers_ratio divide = 2048 add = 10
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_soldiers_ratio < 8192 }
		value = te_jmap_class_soldiers_ratio divide = 4096 add = 11
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_soldiers_ratio < 16384 }
		value = te_jmap_class_soldiers_ratio divide = 8192 add = 12
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_soldiers_ratio < 32768 }
		value = te_jmap_class_soldiers_ratio divide = 16384 add = 13
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_soldiers_ratio < 65536 }
		value = te_jmap_class_soldiers_ratio divide = 32768 add = 14
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_soldiers_ratio < 131072 }
		value = te_jmap_class_soldiers_ratio divide = 65536 add = 15
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_soldiers_ratio < 262144 }
		value = te_jmap_class_soldiers_ratio divide = 131072 add = 16
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_soldiers_ratio < 524288 }
		value = te_jmap_class_soldiers_ratio divide = 262144 add = 17
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_soldiers_ratio < 1048576 }
		value = te_jmap_class_soldiers_ratio divide = 524288 add = 18
	}
	else = {
		value = te_jmap_class_soldiers_ratio divide = 1048576 add = 19
	}
}

			value = te_jmap_class_soldiers_log
			divide = te_jmap_class_soldiers_log_span
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { te_jmap_scale = 1 }
			value = var:te_dg_cls_soldiers
			subtract = te_jmap_class_soldiers_lo
			divide = te_jmap_class_soldiers_span
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { te_jmap_scale = 2 }
			value = te_jmap_class_soldiers_log
			divide = te_jmap_class_soldiers_log_span
		}
		else = {
			value = 0
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = te_jmap_rank }
				value = var:te_jmap_rank
			}
		}
	}
	min = 0
	max = 1
}

# Soldiers, their share of the state's people (the yearly walk's).
# Fitted to the world; before the first measure, 0 to 0.04.
te_jmap_class_soldiers_share_input = {
	value = te_jmap_share_soldiers
}
te_jmap_class_soldiers_share_input_neg = {
	value = te_jmap_class_soldiers_share_input
	multiply = -1
}
te_jmap_class_soldiers_share_lo = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = te_jmap_rng_class_soldiers_share_lo }
		value = global_var:te_jmap_rng_class_soldiers_share_lo
	}
}
te_jmap_class_soldiers_share_hi = {
	value = 0.04
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = te_jmap_rng_class_soldiers_share_hi }
		value = global_var:te_jmap_rng_class_soldiers_share_hi
	}
	min = te_jmap_class_soldiers_share_hi_floor
}
te_jmap_class_soldiers_share_hi_floor = {
	value = te_jmap_class_soldiers_share_lo
	add = 0.005
}
te_jmap_class_soldiers_share_span = {
	value = te_jmap_class_soldiers_share_hi
	subtract = te_jmap_class_soldiers_share_lo
}
te_jmap_class_soldiers_share_d0 = {
	value = te_jmap_class_soldiers_share_span
	multiply = 1
}
te_jmap_class_soldiers_share_lg_min = {
	value = te_jmap_class_soldiers_share_hi
	divide = 64
}
te_jmap_class_soldiers_share_lg_r = {
	value = te_jmap_share_soldiers
	multiply = 64
	divide = te_jmap_class_soldiers_share_hi
	if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_soldiers_share_lo > te_jmap_class_soldiers_share_lg_min }
		value = te_jmap_share_soldiers
		divide = te_jmap_class_soldiers_share_lo
	}
}

		limit = { te_jmap_class_soldiers_share_lg_r < 2 }

		limit = { te_jmap_class_soldiers_share_lg_r < 64 }
		value = te_jmap_class_soldiers_share_lg_r divide = 32 add = 4
	}

		limit = { te_jmap_class_soldiers_share_lg_r < 128 }

	else_if = {

	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_class_soldiers_share_lg_r < 2048 }

	else_if = {

		limit = { te_jmap_scale = 0 }
		value = te_jmap_share_soldiers subtract = te_jmap_class_soldiers_share_lo divide = te_jmap_class_soldiers_share_d0
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_scale = 1 }
		value = te_jmap_share_soldiers
		subtract = te_jmap_class_soldiers_share_lo
		divide = te_jmap_class_soldiers_share_span
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_scale = 2 }
		value = te_jmap_class_soldiers_share_lg_t
		divide = te_jmap_class_soldiers_share_lg_top
	}
	else = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = te_jmap_rank }
			value = var:te_jmap_rank
		}
	}
	min = 0
	max = 1
}

# ---- The Map Room's options (the generator's header): what a range counts and leaves out ----
# The states with a figure the range being measured counted (te_jmap_n, set by te_jmap_range_<map>).
te_jmap_states = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = te_jmap_n }
		value = global_var:te_jmap_n
	}
}
# The states each end of it leaves out (te_jmap_k, from te_jmap_trim_count or _entry).
te_jmap_cut = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = te_jmap_k }
		value = global_var:te_jmap_k
	}
}
# The most an end can leave out with two states still left to span: a short list is never trimmed past
# its middle (ordered_state's position past the end takes the last state, it doesn't skip).
te_jmap_trim_most = {
	value = te_jmap_states
	subtract = 2
	divide = 2
	floor = yes
	min = 0
}
# The Map Room's trim, by its Outliers option (te_jmap_trim): 4 at each end by default, and under a
# limited area at most one state in 10; none; or 5% of the states with a figure. Never past
# te_jmap_trim_most, nor 80, the last literal position te_jmap_measure_at holds.
te_jmap_trim_count = {
	value = 4
	if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_trim = 1 }
		value = 0
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_trim = 2 }
		value = te_jmap_states
		multiply = 0.05
		floor = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_area > 0 }
		value = te_jmap_states
		divide = 10
		floor = yes
		max = 4
	}
	max = te_jmap_trim_most
	max = 80
}
# A system's own entry: the default trim over the whole world, whatever the Map Room's options.
te_jmap_trim_count_entry = {
	value = 4
	max = te_jmap_trim_most
}
# What the pick's map was last measured over, for the Map Room's page (te_jmap_shown_n, te_jmap_shown_k:
# a copy the Map Room's ranges keep, since the entries' ranges count into te_jmap_n and te_jmap_k too).
te_jmap_shown_states = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = te_jmap_shown_n }
		value = global_var:te_jmap_shown_n
	}
}
te_jmap_shown_cut = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = te_jmap_shown_k }
		value = global_var:te_jmap_shown_k
	}
}
# ---- The Scale option's Ranked setting: what te_jmap_rank_<map>'s walk reads and writes ----
# The place the walk has reached (te_jmap_i: the number of distinct figures so far, less one on a map
# ranked from its lowest, where the first place is 0) and the figure of the state before
# (te_jmap_prev). Read through these, never as bare globals: a tooltip that walked an option's effect
# would find them unset.
te_jmap_rank_place = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = te_jmap_i }
		value = global_var:te_jmap_i
	}
}
te_jmap_rank_prev = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = te_jmap_prev }
		value = global_var:te_jmap_prev
	}
}
# The divisor that turns a place into 0-1: the last place, at least 1 (one distinct figure: every state
# at the low color, or at the midpoint's on a side with one figure).
te_jmap_rank_top = {
	value = te_jmap_rank_place
	min = 1
}
# A state's place as its factor (state scope: the walk stored the place itself in te_jmap_rank). From
# the lowest: 0 to 1. On a side of a midpoint, outward: 0.5 down to 0 below it, 0.5 up to 1 above.
te_jmap_rank_share = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_jmap_rank }
		value = var:te_jmap_rank
		divide = te_jmap_rank_top
	}
}
te_jmap_rank_share_low = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_jmap_rank }
		value = var:te_jmap_rank
		divide = te_jmap_rank_top
		multiply = -0.5
		add = 0.5
	}
}
te_jmap_rank_share_up = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_jmap_rank }
		value = var:te_jmap_rank
		divide = te_jmap_rank_top
		multiply = 0.5
		add = 0.5
	}
}

# ---- The Color option (the generator's header): the pick's ramp and factor, for the shared branches ----
# 0 where the pick's own lerp branch wouldn't paint this state (no figure, none, off the scale, or a
# pick with no range), 1 where it would and the pick runs one way, 2 where it would and the pick runs both
# ways from a midpoint. Each row repeats its lerp branch's limit; a figure is read only inside its
# has_variable guard.
te_jmap_pick_ramp = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_selector = 1 }
		value = 1
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_selector = 2 }
		value = 1
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_selector = 3 has_variable = te_dg_e0 }
		if = {
			limit = { var:te_dg_e0 > 0 }
			value = 1
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_selector = 4 has_variable = te_dg_tfr }
		if = {
			limit = { var:te_dg_tfr > 0 }
			value = 2
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_selector = 5 has_variable = te_dg_median }
		if = {
			limit = { var:te_dg_median > 0 }
			value = 1
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_selector = 6 }
		value = 1
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_selector = 7 has_variable = te_dg_stepped has_variable = te_dg_cbr has_variable = te_dg_cdr }
		if = {
			limit = { var:te_dg_stepped > 0 }

		value = 2
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_selector = 82 }
		value = 2
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_selector = 83 }
		value = 1
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_selector = 84 }
		if = {
			limit = { te_jmap_pollution > 0 }
			value = 1
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_selector = 85 }
		if = {
			limit = { te_jmap_vacant_jobs > 0 }
			value = 1
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_selector = 86 }
		value = 1
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_selector = 87 has_variable = te_dg_unacc has_variable = te_dg_walk_pop }
		if = {
			limit = { var:te_dg_walk_pop > 0 }
			value = 1
		}
	}
}

# The factor along each of a shared ramp's 4 lerps: the paint takes the first whose end the factor is
# under (te_jmap_pick_factor < 0.25, 0.5, 0.75; the last takes the rest).
te_jmap_pick_q1 = {
	value = te_jmap_pick_factor
	multiply = 4
	min = 0
	max = 1
}
te_jmap_pick_q2 = {
	value = te_jmap_pick_factor
	subtract = 0.25
	multiply = 4
	min = 0
	max = 1
}
te_jmap_pick_q3 = {
	value = te_jmap_pick_factor
	subtract = 0.5
	multiply = 4
	min = 0
	max = 1
}
te_jmap_pick_q4 = {
	value = te_jmap_pick_factor
	subtract = 0.75
	multiply = 4
	min = 0
	max = 1
}
